body.translated_text:
<s>Śrī Harināma-cintāmaṇi</s>
Obeisance to the Moon of <s>Śrī Godruma</s>

(1)
First Chapter
Indication of the Glory of the Holy Name

children.text: gadāi gaurāṅga jaya jāhnavā jīvana /
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Gadāi Gaurāṅga</s>, the life of the <s>Jāhnavī</s> (Gaṅgā),

children.text: sītādvaita jaya śrīvāsādi bhakta gaṇa // HNC_1.1 //
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Sītā</s>, <s>Advaita</s>, <s>Śrīvāsa</s>, and all the devotees! // HNC 1.1 //

children.text: lavaṇa jaladhi tīre nīlācale śrī mandire
children.translated_text: On the shore of the salt ocean, at the splendid temple on <s>Nīlācala</s>,

children.text: dāru brahma puruṣa pradhāna /
children.translated_text: the wooden form of <s>Brahman</s>, the supreme Person, presides.

children.text: jīve nistārite hari arcā rūpe avatari
children.translated_text: To deliver the <s>jīvas</s>, <s>Hari</s> descends in the form of the <s>Arcā</s> (deity),

children.text: bhoga mokṣa karena pradāna // HNC_1.2 //
children.translated_text: bestowing both enjoyment (<s>bhoga</s>) and liberation (<s>mokṣa</s>). // HNC 1.2 //

children.text: sei dhāme śrī caitanya mānave karite dhanya
children.translated_text: In that holy abode, <s>Śrī Caitanya</s>, to bless humanity,

children.text: sannyāsī rūpete bhagavān /
children.translated_text: the Lord Himself in the guise of a <s>sannyāsī</s>,

children.text: kalite ye yuga dharma bujhāite tāra marma
children.translated_text: to make known the essence of the <s>yuga-dharma</s> in <s>Kali</s>,

children.text: kāśī miśra ghare adhiṣṭhāna // HNC_1.3 //
children.translated_text: took residence in the house of <s>Kāśī Miśra</s>. // HNC 1.3 //

children.text: nija bhakta vṛnda laye nije kalpa taru haye
children.translated_text: Taking His own circle of devotees, He Himself became a wish-fulfilling tree (<s>kalpa-taru</s>),

children.text: kṛṣṇa prema dena sarva jane /
children.translated_text: giving <s>Kṛṣṇa-prema</s> (love of Kṛṣṇa) to all people.

children.text: nānā mate bhakta mukhe bhakta katha śuni sukhe
children.translated_text: In various ways, hearing devotional topics from the mouths of devotees with delight,

children.text: jīva śikṣā dena suyatane // HNC_1.4 //
children.translated_text: He carefully imparted instruction to the <s>jīvas</s>. // HNC 1.4 //

children.text: eka dina bhagavān samudre kariyā snāna
children.translated_text: One day, the Lord, having bathed in the ocean,

children.text: śrī siddha bakule hari dāse /
children.translated_text: met <s>Haridāsa</s> at the auspicious <s>Siddha Bakula</s> tree.

children.text: mili ānandita mane jijñāsilā sa-yatane
children.translated_text: Meeting him, with a joyful heart, He carefully inquired:

children.text: kise jīva tare anāyāse // HNC_1.5 //
children.translated_text: "By what means does a <s>jīva</s> easily cross over (saṃsāra)?" // HNC 1.5 //

children.text: prabhura caraṇa dhari' aneka vinaya kari'
children.translated_text: Clasping the feet of the Lord, making many humble entreaties,

children.text: galad-aśru pulaka śarīra /
children.translated_text: with tears streaming and <s>pulaka</s> (ecstatic horripilation) on his body,

children.text: hari-dāsa mahāśaya kāṅdite kāṅdite kaya
children.translated_text: <s>Haridāsa Mahāśaya</s>, weeping and weeping, said:

children.text: prabhu tava līlā sugabhīra // HNC_1.6 //
children.translated_text: "O Lord, Your <s>līlā</s> (divine play) is very deep! // HNC 1.6 //

children.text: āmi ati akiñcana nāhi mora vidyā dhana
children.translated_text: I am utterly destitute; I have neither learning nor wealth.

children.text: tava pada āmāra sambala /
children.translated_text: Your lotus feet are my only provision.

children.text: e hena ayogya jane praśna kari' akāraṇe
children.translated_text: To such an unworthy person, asking without cause —

children.text: bala prabhu habe kibā phala // HNC_1.7 //
children.translated_text: tell me, O Lord, what fruit will come of it? // HNC 1.7 //

children.text: tumi kṛṣṇa svayaṃ prabho jīva uddhārite vibho
children.translated_text: You are <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> Himself, O Lord! To deliver the <s>jīvas</s>, O all-pervading one,

children.text: navadvīpa dhāme avatāra /
children.translated_text: You have descended in the abode of <s>Navadvīpa</s>.

children.text: kṛpā kari' rāṅgā pāya rākha more gaura rāya
children.translated_text: By Your mercy, keep me at Your reddened lotus feet, O <s>Gaura Rāya</s>,

children.text: tabe citta praphulla āmāra // HNC_1.8 //
children.translated_text: then my heart will blossom with joy. // HNC 1.8 //

children.text: tomāra ananta nāma tavānanta guṇa grāma
children.translated_text: Your names are infinite, Your qualities are an infinite multitude,

children.text: tava rūpa sukhera sāgara /
children.translated_text: Your form is an ocean of bliss.

children.text: ananta tomāra līlā kṛpā kari' prakāśilā
children.translated_text: Your infinite <s>līlā</s> You have mercifully manifested,

children.text: tāi āsvādaye e pāmara // HNC_1.9 //
children.translated_text: and this wretch relishes them. // HNC 1.9 //

children.text: cinmaya bhāskara tumi kiraṇera kaṇa āmi
children.translated_text: You are the spiritual sun; I am a particle of Your rays.

children.text: tumi prabhu, āmi nitya dāsa /
children.translated_text: You are the Lord; I am Your eternal servant.

children.text: caraṇa pīyūṣa tava mama sukha suvaibhava
children.translated_text: The nectar of Your feet is my happiness and splendor;

children.text: tava nāmāmṛte mora āśa // HNC_1.10 //
children.translated_text: my hope rests in the nectar of Your Name. // HNC 1.10 //

children.text: e mata adhama āmi ki balite jāni svāmī
children.translated_text: Being so fallen, what can I say, O Master?

children.text: tabu ājñā kariba pālana /
children.translated_text: Still, I shall carry out Your command.

children.text: yā balābe mora mukhe tomāre baliba sukhe
children.translated_text: Whatever You make me speak, I shall happily speak of You,

children.text: doṣa guṇa nā kari gaṇana // HNC_1.11 //
children.translated_text: without counting faults or merits." // HNC 1.11 //

body.translated_text: The Nature of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> (<s>Kṛṣṇa-tattva</s>)

children.text: eka-mātra icchāmaya kṛṣṇa sarveśvara /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is the sole Lord of all, whose will alone prevails.

children.text: nitya śakti-yoge kṛṣṇa vibhu parātpara // HNC_1.12 //
children.translated_text: Through eternal union with His <s>śakti</s> (energy), <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is all-pervading and supreme beyond the supreme. // HNC 1.12 //

body.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s <s>Śakti</s>

children.text: kṛṣṇa-śakti kṛṣṇa haite nā haya svatantra /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s <s>śakti</s> is never independent from <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>.

children.text: yei śakti sei kṛṣṇa kahe veda-mantra // HNC_1.13 //
children.translated_text: That which is the <s>śakti</s> is itself <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> — so declare the Vedic <s>mantras</s>. // HNC 1.13 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa vibhu, śakti tāṅra vaibhava svarūpa /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is all-pervading; His <s>śakti</s> is His opulent nature (<s>vaibhava-svarūpa</s>).

children.text: ananta vaibhave kṛṣṇa haya eka rūpa // HNC_1.14 //
children.translated_text: In infinite opulence, <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> remains one form. // HNC 1.14 //

body.translated_text: The Threefold Opulence (<s>Trividha Vaibhava</s>)

children.text: śaktira prakāśa yei sei ta vaibhava /
children.translated_text: That which is the manifestation of <s>śakti</s> is the opulence (<s>vaibhava</s>).

children.text: vibhura vaibhava mātra haya anubhava // HNC_1.15 //
children.translated_text: The opulence of the all-pervading Lord is directly experienced. // HNC 1.15 //

children.text: cid acit jīva tina śāstrera gocara // HNC_1.16 //
children.translated_text: <s>cit</s> (spiritual), <s>acit</s> (material), and <s>jīva</s> (living beings) — these three are the domain of scripture. // HNC 1.16 //

body.translated_text: Your opulence is threefold, O beautiful <s>Gaurāṅga</s>:
Spiritual Opulence (<s>Cid-vaibhava</s>)

children.text: ananta vaikuṇṭha ādi yata kṛṣṇa dhāma /
children.translated_text: The infinite <s>Vaikuṇṭha</s> and all the abodes of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: govinda śrī-kṛṣṇa hari ādi yata nāma // HNC_1.17 //
children.translated_text: <s>Govinda</s>, <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>, <s>Hari</s> — all such names, // HNC 1.17 //

children.text: dvibhuja muralīdhara ādi yata rūpa /
children.translated_text: the two-armed flute-player and all such forms,

children.text: bhaktānanda-prada ādi guṇa aparūpa // HNC_1.18 //
children.translated_text: the wonderful qualities that bestow bliss on the devotees — // HNC 1.18 //

children.text: vraja rasa-līlā navadvīpe saṅkīrtana /
children.translated_text: the <s>rasa-līlā</s> in <s>Vraja</s>, the <s>saṅkīrtana</s> in <s>Navadvīpa</s> —

children.text: ei rūpa kṛṣṇa līlā vicitra gaṇana // HNC_1.19 //
children.translated_text: such are the wonderful varieties of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s <s>līlā</s>. // HNC 1.19 //

children.text: e samasta cid-vaibhava aprākṛta haya /
children.translated_text: All this spiritual opulence (<s>cid-vaibhava</s>) is transcendental (<s>aprākṛta</s>);

children.text: āsiyā-o e prapañce prāpañcika naya // HNC_1.20 //
children.translated_text: even coming into this material world, it does not become mundane. // HNC 1.20 //

children.text: cid-vyāpāra samudaya viṣṇu-tattva-sāra /
children.translated_text: All spiritual activities constitute the essence of <s>Viṣṇu-tattva</s>;

children.text: viṣṇu-pada bali vede gāya bāra bāra // HNC_1.21 //
children.translated_text: the Vedas repeatedly glorify them as <s>Viṣṇu-pada</s> (the abode of Viṣṇu). // HNC 1.21 //

body.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s spiritual potency is <s>Viṣṇu-tattva</s>, the pure reality (<s>śuddha-tattva</s>);

children.text: nāhi tāhe jaḍa-dharma māyāra vikāra /
children.translated_text: there is no material nature (<s>jaḍa-dharma</s>) or transformation of <s>māyā</s> in it.

children.text: jaḍātīta viṣṇu-tattva śuddha-sattva-sāra // HNC_1.22 //
children.translated_text: Beyond matter, <s>Viṣṇu-tattva</s> is the essence of pure goodness (<s>śuddha-sattva</s>). // HNC 1.22 //

children.text: śuddha-sattva rajas-tamo-gandha-virahita /
children.translated_text: <s>Śuddha-sattva</s> (pure goodness) is free from any trace of <s>rajas</s> and <s>tamas</s>;

children.text: rajas-tamo-miśra miśra-sattva suvidita // HNC_1.23 //
children.translated_text: <s>miśra-sattva</s> (mixed goodness) is well known as sattva mixed with <s>rajas</s> and <s>tamas</s>. // HNC 1.23 //

children.text: govinda vaikuṇṭha-nātha kāraṇodaśāyī /
children.translated_text: <s>Govinda</s>, the Lord of <s>Vaikuṇṭha</s>, the one who reclines on the Causal Ocean (<s>Kāraṇodaśāyī</s>),

children.text: garbhodaśāyī āra kṣīra-sindhu-śāyī // HNC_1.24 //
children.translated_text: <s>Garbhodaśāyī</s> and <s>Kṣīra-sindhu-śāyī</s> (the one who reclines on the Ocean of Milk) — // HNC 1.24 //

children.text: āra yata svāṃśa paricita avatāra /
children.translated_text: and all other personal expansions (<s>svāṃśa</s>) known as <s>avatāras</s> —

children.text: sei saba śuddha-sattva viṣṇu-tattva-sāra // HNC_1.25 //
children.translated_text: all of them are <s>śuddha-sattva</s>, the essence of <s>Viṣṇu-tattva</s>. // HNC 1.25 //

children.text: goloke vaikuṇṭhe āra kāraṇa-sāgare /
children.translated_text: Whether in <s>Goloka</s>, in <s>Vaikuṇṭha</s>, or in the Causal Ocean,

children.text: athavā e jaḍe thāke, viṣṇu-nāma dhare // HNC_1.26 //
children.translated_text: or even residing in this material world, He bears the name <s>Viṣṇu</s>. // HNC 1.26 //

children.text: praveśi e jaḍa viśva māyāra adhīśa /
children.translated_text: Entering this material universe as the Lord of <s>māyā</s>,

children.text: viṣṇu-nāma prāpta vibhu sarva-deva īśa // HNC_1.27 //
children.translated_text: He, being all-pervading, receives the name <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the Lord of all <s>devas</s>. // HNC 1.27 //

body.translated_text: The controller of <s>māyā</s>, the divine wielder (<s>māyī</s>), is composed of <s>śuddha-sattva</s> (pure goodness).
Mixed Goodness (<s>Miśra-sattva</s>)

body.text: miśra-sattva brahmā śiva ādi saba haya // HNC_1.28 //
body.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Śiva</s>, and all others are of <s>miśra-sattva</s> (mixed goodness). // HNC 1.28 //
The Extent of Spiritual Opulence (<s>Cid-vaibhavera Vistṛti</s>)

children.text: e samasta viṣṇu-tattva āra viṣṇu-dhāma /
children.translated_text: All this <s>Viṣṇu-tattva</s> and the abode of <s>Viṣṇu</s> —

children.text: tava cid-vaibhava nātha tava līlā-grāma // HNC_1.29 //
children.translated_text: these are Your spiritual opulence (<s>cid-vaibhava</s>), O Lord, the village of Your <s>līlā</s>. // HNC 1.29 //

body.translated_text: Material Opulence: the Principle of <s>Māyā</s> (<s>Acit-vaibhava Māyā-tattva</s>)

children.text: virajāra ei pāre yata vastu haya /
children.translated_text: Whatever exists on this side of the <s>Virajā</s> river

children.text: acit vaibhava tava caudda-loka-maya // HNC_1.30 //
children.translated_text: is Your material opulence (<s>acit-vaibhava</s>), consisting of the fourteen worlds. // HNC 1.30 //

children.text: māyāra vaibhava bali bale devī-dhāma /
children.translated_text: It is called the opulence of <s>māyā</s> or the abode of <s>Devī</s> (<s>Devī-dhāma</s>);

children.text: pañca-bhūta mano buddhi ahaṅkāra nāma // HNC_1.31 //
children.translated_text: it comprises the five elements, mind, intellect, and false ego (<s>ahaṅkāra</s>). // HNC 1.31 //

children.text: e bhūrloka, bhuvarloka āra svarga-loka /
children.translated_text: This <s>Bhūrloka</s> (earth), <s>Bhuvarloka</s> (atmosphere), and <s>Svargaloka</s> (heaven),

children.text: maharloka, jana-tapa-satya-brahmaloka // HNC_1.32 //
children.translated_text: <s>Maharloka</s>, <s>Janaloka</s>, <s>Tapoloka</s>, and <s>Satyaloka</s> (<s>Brahmaloka</s>), // HNC 1.32 //

children.text: atala-sutala-ādi nimna loka sāta /
children.translated_text: <s>Atala</s>, <s>Sutala</s>, and other lower worlds — seven in number —

children.text: māyika vaibhava tava śuna jagannātha // HNC_1.33 //
children.translated_text: hear, O <s>Jagannātha</s>, of Your opulence wrought by <s>māyā</s>. // HNC 1.33 //

body.translated_text: Spiritual opulence (<s>cid-vaibhava</s>) is the complete reality; <s>māyā</s> is its shadow.
The Opulence of the Living Entity (<s>Jīva-vaibhava</s>)
The <s>jīva</s>, an atomic particle of spiritual consciousness (<s>cid-aṇu</s>), is another kind of opulence. // HNC 1.34 //

children.text: cid-dharma-vaśataḥ jīva svatantra gaṭhana /
children.translated_text: By virtue of spiritual nature (<s>cid-dharma</s>), the <s>jīva</s> has independent constitution;

children.text: saṅkhyāya ananta sukha tāra prayojana // HNC_1.35 //
children.translated_text: its purpose is happiness, which is infinite in measure. // HNC 1.35 //

body.translated_text: The Liberated <s>Jīva</s> (<s>Mukta Jīva</s>)

children.text: sei sukha hetu yārā kṛṣṇere barila /
children.translated_text: Those who, for the sake of that happiness, chose <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: kṛṣṇa-pāriṣada mukta-rūpete rahila // HNC_1.36 //
children.translated_text: remained as associates of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> (<s>Kṛṣṇa-pāriṣada</s>) in the liberated state. // HNC 1.36 //

body.translated_text: The Bound or Outward-Turned <s>Jīva</s> (<s>Baddha</s> or <s>Bahirmukha Jīva</s>)

children.text: yārā punaḥ nija-sukha kariyā bhāvanā /
children.translated_text: Those who, again contemplating their own separate happiness,

children.text: pārśva-sthitā māyā prati karila kāmanā // HNC_1.37 //
children.translated_text: directed desire toward <s>māyā</s>, who stands nearby — // HNC 1.37 //

children.text: sei saba nitya-kṛṣṇa-bahirmukha haila /
children.translated_text: all of them became eternally turned away from <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> (<s>nitya-kṛṣṇa-bahirmukha</s>);

children.text: devī-dhāme māyā-kṛta śarīra pāila // HNC_1.38 //
children.translated_text: in the realm of <s>Devī</s> (<s>Devī-dhāma</s>) they received bodies fashioned by <s>māyā</s>. // HNC 1.38 //

children.text: puṇya pāpa karma cakre paḍiyā ekhana /
children.translated_text: Falling now into the wheel of <s>karma</s> — merit (<s>puṇya</s>) and sin (<s>pāpa</s>) —

children.text: sthūla liṅga dehe sadā karena bhramaṇa // HNC_1.39 //
children.translated_text: they perpetually wander in gross and subtle bodies. // HNC 1.39 //

children.text: kabhu svarge uṭhe, kabhu niraye paḍiyā /
children.translated_text: Sometimes rising to heaven, sometimes falling into hell,

children.text: caurāśi lakṣa yoni bhoge bhramiyā bhramiyā // HNC_1.40 //
children.translated_text: wandering and wandering through 8,400,000 species of life. // HNC 1.40 //

body.translated_text: Yet <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Mercy Persists

children.text: tumi vibhu, tomāra vaibhava jīva haya /
children.translated_text: You are all-pervading; the <s>jīvas</s> are Your opulence.

children.text: dāsera maṅgala cintā tomāra niścaya // HNC_1.41 //
children.translated_text: Concern for the welfare of Your servants is Your certainty. // HNC 1.41 //

children.text: dāsa yāhā sukha māni kare anveṣaṇa /
children.translated_text: Whatever the servant considers happiness and seeks,

children.text: tumi tāhā kṛpā kari kara vitaraṇa // HNC_1.42 //
children.translated_text: You, by Your mercy, generously distribute. // HNC 1.42 //

body.translated_text: Mundane Pious Works: <s>Karma-kāṇḍa</s>

body.text: māyāra vaibhave ye anitya sukha cāya

children.text: tomāra kṛpāya se anāyāse pāya // HNC_1.43 //
children.translated_text: by Your grace easily obtain it. // HNC 1.43 //

body.translated_text: Those who desire impermanent happiness through the opulence of <s>māyā</s>,

children.text: sei sukha prāpty-upāya śubha-karma yata /
children.translated_text: All the pious deeds that are the means to attain that happiness —

children.text: niramile dharma-yajña-yoga-homa-vrata // HNC_1.44 //
children.translated_text: such as <s>dharma</s>, <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice), <s>yoga</s>, <s>homa</s> (fire ritual), and <s>vrata</s> (vows) — // HNC 1.44 //

children.text: sei saba śubha-karma sadā jaḍa-maya /
children.translated_text: all those pious deeds are always material in nature;

children.text: cinmayī pravṛtti tāhe kabhu nā milaya // HNC_1.45 //
children.translated_text: spiritual inclination is never found in them. // HNC 1.45 //

children.text: tāhāra sādhane sādhya jaḍamaya phala /
children.translated_text: Through their practice, the attainable result is material;

children.text: ucca-loka bhoga sukha tāhāte prabala // HNC_1.46 //
children.translated_text: the enjoyment of pleasures in the higher worlds prevails therein. // HNC 1.46 //

children.text: sei saba karma-bhoga nāhi ātma-śānti /
children.translated_text: All such <s>karma</s>-based enjoyment brings no peace to the self;

children.text: tāhāte prayāsa karā atiśaya bhrānti // HNC_1.47 //
children.translated_text: to endeavor for it is utter delusion. // HNC 1.47 //

children.text: sei saba śubha karma upāya haiyā /
children.translated_text: All those pious deeds, serving merely as means,

children.text: anitya upeya sādhe loka sukha diyā // HNC_1.48 //
children.translated_text: accomplish an impermanent end while giving worldly happiness. // HNC 1.48 //

body.translated_text: The Means of Deliverance from that Condition

children.text: kabhu yadi sādhu saṅge jānite se pāre /
children.translated_text: If ever, through the company of saints (<s>sādhu-saṅga</s>), one can come to know:

children.text: āmi jīva kṛṣṇa-dāsa, yāya māyā pāre // HNC_1.49 //
children.translated_text: "I am a <s>jīva</s>, a servant of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>" — then one crosses beyond <s>māyā</s>. // HNC 1.49 //

children.text: se virala phala mātra sukṛti-janita /
children.translated_text: That rare fruit is born solely of spiritual merit (<s>sukṛti</s>);

children.text: tuccha karma-kāṇḍa nāhi karile vihita // HNC_1.50 //
children.translated_text: it is not ordained by petty <s>karma-kāṇḍa</s> rites. // HNC 1.50 //

body.translated_text: The Path of Knowledge (<s>Jñāna-kāṇḍa</s>): the Happiness of Merging into <s>Brahman</s>

children.text: āra yini māyāra yantraṇā mātra jāni /
children.translated_text: Another — one who knows only the torment of <s>māyā</s>,

children.text: mukti lābhe yatnavān tini hana jñānī // HNC_1.51 //
children.translated_text: and strives for liberation (<s>mukti</s>) — that person is a <s>jñānī</s>. // HNC 1.51 //

children.text: se saba lokera janya tumi dayāmaya /
children.translated_text: For all such people, You are compassionate;

children.text: jñāna-kāṇḍa brahma-vidyā diyācha niścaya // HNC_1.52 //
children.translated_text: You have certainly given them <s>jñāna-kāṇḍa</s> and <s>Brahma-vidyā</s> (knowledge of Brahman). // HNC 1.52 //

children.text: sei vidyā māyāvāda kariyā āśraya /
children.translated_text: That knowledge, taking shelter of <s>Māyāvāda</s> (illusionism),

children.text: jaḍa mukta haye brahme jīva haya laya // HNC_1.53 //
children.translated_text: liberates from matter and dissolves the <s>jīva</s> into <s>Brahman</s>. // HNC 1.53 //

body.translated_text: What Is <s>Brahman</s>?

children.text: sei brahma tava aṅga-kānti jyotirmaya /
children.translated_text: That <s>Brahman</s> is the luminous effulgence of Your limbs;

children.text: virajāra pāre sthita tāte haya laya // HNC_1.54 //
children.translated_text: it is situated beyond the <s>Virajā</s>, and into it the dissolution occurs. // HNC 1.54 //

children.text: ye saba asure viṣṇu karena saṃhāra /
children.translated_text: Those demons whom <s>Viṣṇu</s> slays

children.text: tāhārā-o sei brahme yāya māyā-pāra // HNC_1.55 //
children.translated_text: also go to that <s>Brahman</s>, crossing beyond <s>māyā</s>. // HNC 1.55 //

body.translated_text: Turned Away from <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> (<s>Kṛṣṇa-bahirmukha</s>)

children.text: karmī jñānī ubhaye-i kṛṣṇa-bahirmukha /
children.translated_text: The <s>karmī</s> and the <s>jñānī</s> — both are turned away from <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: kabhu nāhi āsvādaya kṛṣṇa-dāsya-sukha // HNC_1.56 //
children.translated_text: they never taste the bliss of servitude to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> (<s>Kṛṣṇa-dāsya-sukha</s>). // HNC 1.56 //

body.translated_text: The Merit That Inclines One Toward Devotion (<s>Bhakty-unmukhī Sukṛti</s>)

children.text: bhaktira unmukhī sei sukṛti pradhāna /
children.translated_text: That <s>sukṛti</s> which inclines one toward <s>bhakti</s> is the foremost;

children.text: tāra phale jīva bhakta-sādhu-saṅga pāna // HNC_1.57 //
children.translated_text: as its fruit, the <s>jīva</s> obtains the association of saintly devotees (<s>sādhu-saṅga</s>). // HNC 1.57 //

children.text: śraddhāvān haye kṛṣṇa-bhakta-saṅga kare /
children.translated_text: Becoming faithful, one keeps the company of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s devotees;

children.text: nāme ruci, jīve dayā, bhakti-patha dhare // HNC_1.58 //
children.translated_text: taste for the Name arises, compassion for all beings, and the path of <s>bhakti</s> is embraced. // HNC 1.58 //

body.text: karmī o jñānīra prati kṛpāya gauṇa-patha vidhāna
body.translated_text: The Lord's Merciful Provision of the Secondary Path for <s>Karmīs</s> and <s>Jñānīs</s>

children.text: dayāra sāgara tumi jīvera īśvara /
children.translated_text: You are an ocean of mercy, the Lord of the <s>jīvas</s>;

children.text: karmī jñānī bahirmukha uddhāre tatpara // HNC_1.59 //
children.translated_text: You are eager to deliver the outward-turned <s>karmīs</s> and <s>jñānīs</s>. // HNC 1.59 //

children.text: karma-pathe jñāna-pathe pathika ye jana /
children.translated_text: For those who walk the path of <s>karma</s> or the path of <s>jñāna</s>,

children.text: tāhāra uddhāra lāgi tomāra yatana // HNC_1.60 //
children.translated_text: You make effort for their deliverance. // HNC 1.60 //

children.text: sei sei pathikera maṅgala cintiyā /
children.translated_text: Thinking of the welfare of each such traveler,

children.text: gauṇa-bhakti patha eka rākhila kariyā // HNC_1.61 //
children.translated_text: You have kept open one secondary path of devotion (<s>gauṇa-bhakti</s>). // HNC 1.61 //

body.translated_text: The Secondary Devotional Path Through <s>Karma</s>, for the <s>Karmī</s>

children.text: karmī varṇāśrame thāki sādhu-saṅga kari /
children.translated_text: The <s>karmī</s>, remaining in <s>varṇāśrama</s> and keeping the company of saints,

children.text: karma mājhe bhakti kare gauṇa-patha dhari // HNC_1.62 //
children.translated_text: practices <s>bhakti</s> within <s>karma</s>, following the secondary path. // HNC 1.62 //

children.text: tāra kṛta karma saba hṛdaya śodhiyā /
children.translated_text: All the deeds so performed purify the heart,

children.text: tirohita haya śraddhā bīje sthāna diyā // HNC_1.63 //
children.translated_text: and disappear, giving place to the seed of faith (<s>śraddhā</s>). // HNC 1.63 //

body.translated_text: The Secondary Path for the <s>Jñānī</s>

children.text: jñānī sukṛtira bale bhaktera kṛpāya /
children.translated_text: The <s>jñānī</s>, by the strength of merit and the grace of devotees,

children.text: ananya bhaktite śraddhā bīje sthāna diyā // HNC_1.64 //
children.translated_text: gives place to the seed of faith in exclusive devotion (<s>ananya-bhakti</s>). // HNC 1.64 //

children.text: tumi bala mora dāsa māyāra vipāke /
children.translated_text: You say: 'My servant, due to the ripening of <s>māyā</s>,

children.text: cāhe anya tuccha phala chāḍiyā āmāke // HNC_1.65 //
children.translated_text: desires other petty fruits, abandoning Me. // HNC 1.65 //

children.text: āmi jāni tāra yāte haya sumaṅgala /
children.translated_text: I know what will bring about his supreme good;

children.text: bhukti mukti chāḍāiyā di-i bhakti phala // HNC_1.66 //
children.translated_text: making him give up enjoyment (<s>bhukti</s>) and liberation (<s>mukti</s>), I give the fruit of <s>bhakti</s>.' // HNC 1.66 //

children.text: gauṇa-pathera prakriyā
children.translated_text: The Process of the Secondary Path (<s>Gauṇa-pathera Prakriyā</s>)

children.text: tāra kāma anusāre cālāñā tāhāre
children.translated_text: According to his desires, guiding him along,

children.text: gauṇa-patha bhakti-mārge śraddhā di-i tāre // HNC_1.67 //
children.translated_text: through the secondary path I give him faith in the path of <s>bhakti</s>. // HNC 1.67 //

children.text: e tomāra kṛpā prabhu tumi kṛpāmaya /
children.translated_text: This is Your mercy, O Lord — You are full of compassion.

children.text: kṛpā nā karile kise jīva śuddha haya // HNC_1.68 //
children.translated_text: Without Your mercy, how can a <s>jīva</s> become purified? // HNC 1.68 //

body.translated_text: The Dire Condition of the Secondary Path in <s>Kali-yuga</s>

children.text: satya-yuge dhyāna-yoge kata ṛṣi-gaṇe /
children.translated_text: In <s>Satya-yuga</s>, through <s>dhyāna-yoga</s> (meditation), You purified many sages

children.text: śuddha kari' dile prabhu nija-bhakti-dhane // HNC_1.69 //
children.translated_text: and bestowed upon them the wealth of Your own <s>bhakti</s>. // HNC 1.69 //

children.text: tretā-yuge yajña-karme aneka śodhile /
children.translated_text: In <s>Tretā-yuga</s>, through sacrificial rites, You purified many;

children.text: dvāpare arcana-mārge bhakti bilāile // HNC_1.70 //
children.translated_text: in <s>Dvāpara</s>, through the path of deity worship (<s>arcana</s>), You distributed <s>bhakti</s>. // HNC 1.70 //

children.text: kali āgamane nātha jīvera durdaśā /
children.translated_text: With the arrival of <s>Kali</s>, O Lord, the <s>jīvas</s> fell into dire straits;

children.text: dekhi jñāna karma yoga chāḍila bharasā // HNC_1.71 //
children.translated_text: seeing this, You abandoned reliance on <s>jñāna</s>, <s>karma</s>, and <s>yoga</s>. // HNC 1.71 //

children.text: alpa āyu, bahu pīḍā, bala-buddhi-hrāsa /
children.translated_text: Short lifespan, much affliction, decline of strength and intellect —

children.text: ei saba upadrava jīve kaila grāsa // HNC_1.72 //
children.translated_text: all these calamities have devoured the <s>jīvas</s>. // HNC 1.72 //

children.text: varṇāśrama dharma āra sāṅkhya yoga jñāna /
children.translated_text: <s>Varṇāśrama-dharma</s>, <s>Sāṅkhya</s>, <s>Yoga</s>, and <s>Jñāna</s> —

children.text: kali-jīve uddhārite nahe balavān // HNC_1.73 //
children.translated_text: none are powerful enough to deliver the <s>jīvas</s> of <s>Kali</s>. // HNC 1.73 //

children.text: jñāna-karma-gata ye bhaktira gauṇa-patha /
children.translated_text: The secondary devotional path embedded in <s>jñāna</s> and <s>karma</s>

children.text: kaṇṭake saṅkīrṇa hañā haila vipatha // HNC_1.74 //
children.translated_text: became overgrown with thorns and turned into a wrong path. // HNC 1.74 //

children.text: pṛthak upāya dhari upeya sādhane /
children.translated_text: Adopting separate means to accomplish the end,

children.text: vighna bahutara haila jīvera jīvane // HNC_1.75 //
children.translated_text: many obstacles arose in the life of the <s>jīva</s>. // HNC 1.75 //

body.translated_text: The Primary Path of Contemplation on the Holy Name (<s>Nāmālocanāra Mukhya-patha</s>)

children.text: prabhu tumi jīvera maṅgala cintā kari /
children.translated_text: O Lord, thinking of the welfare of the <s>jīvas</s>,

children.text: kali yuge nāma saṅge svayaṃ avatari // HNC_1.76 //
children.translated_text: In the Age of <s>Kali</s>, He descends Himself along with the Name. // HNC_1.76 //

children.text: yuga dharma pracārile nāma saṅkīrtana /
children.translated_text: He propagated <s>Nāma-saṅkīrtana</s> (congregational chanting of the Name) as the religion of the age;

children.text: mukhya pathe jīva pāya kṛṣṇa prema dhana // HNC_1.77 //
children.translated_text: on the chief path, the <s>jīva</s> (soul) obtains the wealth of <s>Kṛṣṇa-prema</s> (love for Kṛṣṇa). // HNC_1.77 //

children.text: nāmera smaraṇe āra nāma-saṅkīrtana /
children.translated_text: Remembrance of the Name and <s>Nāma-saṅkīrtana</s> (congregational chanting) —

children.text: ei mātra dharma jīva karibe pālana // HNC_1.78 //
children.translated_text: this alone is the <s>dharma</s> (religious duty) that the <s>jīva</s> (soul) should maintain. // HNC_1.78 //

body.text: sādhya-sādhana o upāya upeyera abhedatā-krame nāmera mukhyatā
body.translated_text: The non-difference of <s>sādhya</s> (goal) and <s>sādhana</s> (means), and of <s>upāya</s> (method) and <s>upeya</s> (object to be attained) — the primacy of the Name in this sequence

children.text: yei ta sādhana sei sādhya yabe haila /
children.translated_text: When the <s>sādhana</s> (means) itself becomes the <s>sādhya</s> (goal),

children.text: upāya upeya madhye bheda nā rahila // HNC_1.79 //
children.translated_text: no difference remains between the <s>upāya</s> (method) and the <s>upeya</s> (object to be attained). // HNC_1.79 //

children.text: sādhyera sādhane āra nāhi antarāya /
children.translated_text: There is no obstacle in the <s>sādhana</s> (practice) of the <s>sādhya</s> (goal);

children.text: anāyāse tare jīva tomāra kṛpāya // HNC_1.80 //
children.translated_text: the <s>jīva</s> (soul) is easily delivered by Your grace. // HNC_1.80 //

children.text: āmi ta adhama ati majiyā viṣaye /
children.translated_text: I am most fallen, immersed in sense objects;

children.text: nā bhajinu nāma tava ati mūḍha haye // HNC_1.81 //
children.translated_text: I did not worship Your Name, being extremely foolish. // HNC_1.81 //

children.text: dara dara dhārā cakṣe brahma-haridāsa /
children.translated_text: With streams of tears flowing from his eyes, <s>Brahma Haridāsa</s>

children.text: paḍila prabhura pade chāḍiyā niḥśvāsa // HNC_1.82 //
children.translated_text: fell at the feet of the Lord, heaving sighs. // HNC_1.82 //

children.text: hari bhakta bhakti mātre vinoda yāhāra /
children.translated_text: <s>Bhaktivinoda</s>, whose sole delight is <s>Hari</s>'s devotees and devotion —

children.text: harināma cintāmaṇi jīvana tāhāra // HNC_1.83 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Harināma Cintāmaṇi</s> (wish-fulfilling gem of the Holy Name) is his very life. // HNC_1.83 //

body.text: iti śrī-hari-nāma-cintāmaṇau nāma-māhātma-sūcanaṃ nāma prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ /
body.translated_text: Thus ends the first chapter of <s>Śrī Hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi</s>, entitled 'Indication of the Glories of the Name.'

(2)
Second Chapter
Considerations on Chanting the Name

children.text: gadāi gaurāṅga jaya jāhnavā jīvana /
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Gadāi Gaurāṅga</s>! Glory to <s>Jāhnavā</s>, the life [of <s>Nityānanda</s>]!

children.text: sītādvaita jaya śrīvāsādi bhakta gaṇa // HNC_2.1 //
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Sītā</s>, <s>Advaita</s>! Glory to <s>Śrīvāsa</s> and the host of devotees! // HNC_2.1 //

children.text: mahā-preme hari-dāsa karena rodana /
children.translated_text: With great <s>prema</s> (divine love), <s>Haridāsa</s> weeps;

children.text: preme tāre gauracandra dilā āliṅgana // HNC_2.2 //
children.translated_text: with <s>prema</s>, <s>Gauracandra</s> (the moon-like <s>Gaura</s>) gave him an embrace. // HNC_2.2 //

children.text: balena tomāra sama bhakta kothā āra /
children.translated_text: He says, 'Where is another devotee equal to you?

children.text: sarva-tattva-jñātā tumi sadā māyā-pāra // HNC_2.3 //
children.translated_text: You are the knower of all truths, always beyond <s>Māyā</s> (illusion).' // HNC_2.3 //

body.translated_text: The excellence of exclusive worship

children.text: nica-kule avatari dekhāle sakale /
children.translated_text: Descending in a low-born family, He showed to all

children.text: dhane māne kule śīle kṛṣṇa nāhi mile // HNC_2.4 //
children.translated_text: that <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is not obtained through wealth, honor, family lineage, or character. // HNC_2.4 //

children.text: ananya bhajane yāṅra śraddhā atiśaya /
children.translated_text: One whose faith in exclusive worship is supreme,

children.text: devatā apekṣā śreṣṭha sei mahāśaya // HNC_2.5 //
children.translated_text: that great soul is superior to [one who worships] the <s>devatās</s> (demigods). // HNC_2.5 //

body.translated_text: The appointment of <s>Śrī Haridāsa</s> as <s>Nāmācārya</s> (preceptor of the Name)

children.text: nāma-tattva sarva-sāra tomāra vidita /
children.translated_text: The essence of all truths about the Name is known to you;

children.text: ācāre ācāryya tumi pracāre paṇḍita // HNC_2.6 //
children.translated_text: you are the <s>Ācārya</s> (teacher) in practice and a <s>paṇḍita</s> (scholar) in propagation. // HNC_2.6 //

children.text: bala haridāsa nāma-mahimā apāra /
children.translated_text: Speak, O <s>Haridāsa</s>, of the boundless glories of the Name;

children.text: śuniyā tomāra mukhe ānanda āmāra // HNC_2.7 //
children.translated_text: hearing from your mouth brings me joy. // HNC_2.7 //

body.translated_text: Characteristics of a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>

children.text: eka nāma yāra mukhe vaiṣṇava se haya /
children.translated_text: One in whose mouth there is even one Name — he is a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>;

children.text: tāre gṛhī yatna kari mānibe niścaya // HNC_2.8 //
children.translated_text: a householder should carefully honor him with certainty. // HNC_2.8 //

body.translated_text: Characteristics of a greater <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>

children.text: nirantara yāra mukhe śuni kṛṣṇa-nāma /
children.translated_text: One from whose mouth <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name is constantly heard,

children.text: sei se vaiṣṇavatara sarva-guṇa-dhāma // HNC_2.9 //
children.translated_text: he is a greater <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>, the abode of all virtues. // HNC_2.9 //

body.translated_text: Characteristics of the greatest <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>

children.text: vaiṣṇava uttama sei yāhāre dekhile /
children.translated_text: The supreme <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> is one at whose very sight

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāma āse mukhe kṛṣṇa-bhakti mile // HNC_2.10 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name comes to one's lips and devotion to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is obtained. // HNC_2.10 //

children.text: hena kṛṣṇa-nāma jīva ki rūpe karibe /
children.translated_text: How should the <s>jīva</s> (soul) chant such a Name of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>?

children.text: tāhāra vidhāna tumi āmāre balibe // HNC_2.11 //
children.translated_text: Please tell me its proper procedure. // HNC_2.11 //

children.text: kara yuḍi haridāsa balena vacana /
children.translated_text: With folded hands, <s>Haridāsa</s> speaks these words,

children.text: prema gada-gada svara sajala nayana // HNC_2.12 //
children.translated_text: his voice choked with <s>prema</s> (divine love), his eyes filled with tears. // HNC_2.12 //

body.translated_text: The essential nature of the Name

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāma cintāmaṇi anādi cinmaya /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name is a <s>cintāmaṇi</s> (wish-fulfilling gem), beginningless and made of pure consciousness;

children.text: yei kṛṣṇa sei nāma eka-tattva haya // HNC_2.13 //
children.translated_text: that which is <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> — that is the Name; they are one and the same truth. // HNC_2.13 //

children.text: caitanya vigraha nāma nitya mukta tattva /
children.translated_text: The Name is a conscious form, an eternally liberated truth;

children.text: nāma nāmī bhinna naya nitya śuddha sattva // HNC_2.14 //
children.translated_text: the Name and the Named are not different — [the Name is] eternally pure existence. // HNC_2.14 //

children.text: e jaḍa jagate tāṅra akṣara ākāra /
children.translated_text: In this material world, It has the form of syllables [and] letters;

children.text: rasa-rūpe rasikete sattva avatāra // HNC_2.15 //
children.translated_text: in the form of <s>rasa</s> (divine flavor), It descends among the <s>rasikas</s> (relishers) in the mode of pure goodness. // HNC_2.15 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa vastu haya cāri dharme paricita /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> as a reality is known through four attributes:

children.text: nāma rūpa guṇa karma anādi vihita // HNC_2.16 //
children.translated_text: Name, Form, Qualities, and Pastimes — ordained since beginningless time. // HNC_2.16 //

body.translated_text: The Name is eternally self-manifest

children.text: nitya vastu rasa-rūpa kṛṣṇa se advaya /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the non-dual reality, is eternally of the nature of <s>rasa</s> (divine flavor);

children.text: sei cāri paricaye vastu siddha haya // HNC_2.17 //
children.translated_text: through these four identifiers, the reality is established. // HNC_2.17 //

children.text: sandhinī śaktite tāṅra cāri paricaya /
children.translated_text: By His <s>Sandhinī</s> (existence) potency, His four identifiers

children.text: nitya-siddha rūpe khyāta sarvadā cinmaya // HNC_2.18 //
children.translated_text: are known in their eternally self-manifest forms, always made of pure consciousness. // HNC_2.18 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa ākarṣaye sarva viśva-gata jana /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> attracts all beings throughout the universe;

children.text: sei nitya dharma gata kṛṣṇa nāma dhana // HNC_2.19 //
children.translated_text: that eternal attribute is the wealth of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name. // HNC_2.19 //

body.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s form is eternal

children.text: kṛṣṇa-rūpa kṛṣṇa haite sarvadā abheda /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s form is always non-different from <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: nāma rūpa eka vastu nāhika prabheda // HNC_2.20 //
children.translated_text: Name and Form are one substance — there is no distinction. // HNC_2.20 //

children.text: śrī-nāma smarile rūpa āise saṅge saṅge /
children.translated_text: When one remembers the Holy Name, the Form comes along with it;

children.text: rūpa nāma bhinna naya nāce nānā raṅge // HNC_2.21 //
children.translated_text: Form and Name are not different — they dance in various ways. // HNC_2.21 //

body.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s qualities are eternal

children.text: kṛṣṇa-guṇa catuḥ-ṣaṣṭhi ananta apāra /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s sixty-four qualities are unlimited and boundless;

children.text: yāṅra nija aṃśa-rūpe saba avatāra // HNC_2.22 //
children.translated_text: all <s>avatāras</s> (incarnations) are partial forms of His own portions. // HNC_2.22 //

children.text: yāṅra guṇa aṃśe brahmā śivādi īśvara /
children.translated_text: By a portion of His qualities, <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Śiva</s>, and other lords [are empowered];

children.text: yāṅra guṇe nārāyaṇa ṣaṣṭhi guṇeśvara // HNC_2.23 //
children.translated_text: by His qualities, <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> is the lord of sixty qualities. // HNC_2.23 //

children.text: sei saba nitya-guṇe nitya nāma tāṅra /
children.translated_text: His eternal Names correspond to all these eternal qualities;

children.text: ananta saṅkhyāya vyāpta vaikuṇṭha vyāpāra // HNC_2.24 //
children.translated_text: they pervade in unlimited numbers the activities of <s>Vaikuṇṭha</s>. // HNC_2.24 //

body.translated_text: The eternality of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s pastimes

children.text: sei guṇa taraṅgete līlāra vistāra /
children.translated_text: By the waves of those qualities, the pastimes expand;

children.text: goloke vaikuṇṭha vraja saba cid-ākāre // HNC_2.25 //
children.translated_text: in <s>Goloka</s>, <s>Vaikuṇṭha</s>, and <s>Vraja</s> — all in spiritual form. // HNC_2.25 //

body.text: cid-vastute nāma, rūpa, guṇa, līlā vastu haite pṛthak naya
body.translated_text: In spiritual reality, Name, Form, Qualities, and Pastimes are not separate from the substance

children.text: nāma rūpa guṇa līlā abhinna udaya /
children.translated_text: Name, Form, Qualities, and Pastimes arise as non-different [from <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>];

children.text: acit samparke baddha jīve bhinna haya // HNC_2.26 //
children.translated_text: in contact with inert matter, the bound <s>jīva</s> (soul) perceives them as different. // HNC_2.26 //

children.text: śuddha jīve nāma rūpa guṇa kriyā eka /
children.translated_text: For the pure <s>jīva</s>, Name, Form, Qualities, and Activities are one;

children.text: jaḍāśrita dehe bheda ei se viveka // HNC_2.27 //
children.translated_text: the distinction [arises] in a body sheltered by matter — this is the discernment. // HNC_2.27 //

children.text: kṛṣṇe nāhi jaḍa-gandha ataeva tāṅya /
children.translated_text: In <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> there is no trace of matter; therefore in Him

children.text: nāma rūpa guṇa līlā eka-tattva bhāya // HNC_2.28 //
children.translated_text: Name, Form, Qualities, and Pastimes are one and the same truth. // HNC_2.28 //

children.text: nāmera sarva-mūlatva
children.translated_text: The Name is the root of everything

children.text: ei cāri paricaya madhye nāma tāṅra /
children.translated_text: Among these four identifiers, His Name

children.text: sakalera ādi se pratīti sabākāra // HNC_2.29 //
children.translated_text: is the origin of all — this is everyone's conviction. // HNC_2.29 //

children.text: ataeva nāma mātra vaiṣṇavera dharma /
children.translated_text: Therefore the Name alone is the <s>dharma</s> (religious duty) of a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>;

children.text: nāme prasphuṭita haya rūpa guṇa karma // HNC_2.30 //
children.translated_text: through the Name, Form, Qualities, and Pastimes become manifest. // HNC_2.30 //

children.text: kṛṣṇera samagra līlā nāme vidyamāna /
children.translated_text: All of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s pastimes are present within the Name;

children.text: nāme se parama tattva tomāra vidhāna // HNC_2.31 //
children.translated_text: in the Name is the supreme truth — this is Your arrangement. // HNC_2.31 //

body.translated_text: There is a difference between a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> and one who is almost a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>

children.text: sei nāma baddha jīva śraddhā sahakāre /
children.translated_text: That Name, when the bound <s>jīva</s> takes it with faith,

children.text: śuddha rūpe laile vaiṣṇava bali tāre // HNC_2.32 //
children.translated_text: in pure form — then he is called a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>. // HNC_2.32 //

children.text: nāmābhāsa yāra haya se vaiṣṇava-prāya /
children.translated_text: One who has <s>nāmābhāsa</s> (a semblance of the Name) is almost a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>;

children.text: kṛṣṇa-kṛpā bale krame śuddha bhāva pāya // HNC_2.33 //
children.translated_text: by the power of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s grace, he gradually attains pure disposition. // HNC_2.33 //

body.text: ei māyika jagate kṛṣṇa-nāma o jīva ei duiṭi mātra cid-vyāpāra
body.translated_text: In this illusory world, <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name and the <s>jīva</s> (soul) — only these two are spiritual activities

children.text: nāma sama vastu nāi e bhava saṃsāre /
children.translated_text: There is nothing equal to the Name in this world of <s>Saṃsāra</s> (material existence);

children.text: nāme se parama dhana kṛṣṇera bhāṇḍāre // HNC_2.34 //
children.translated_text: the Name is the supreme wealth in <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s treasury. // HNC_2.34 //

children.text: jīva nije cid-vyāpāre kṛṣṇa-nāma āra /
children.translated_text: The <s>jīva</s> (soul) by its own spiritual function, and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name —

children.text: āra saba prāpañcika jagat saṃsāra // HNC_2.35 //
children.translated_text: everything else is mundane, [belonging to] the world of <s>Saṃsāra</s>. // HNC_2.35 //

body.text: mukhya gauṇa bhede nāma dui prakāra
body.translated_text: The Name is of two kinds, distinguished as primary and secondary

children.text: mukhya o gauṇa bhede kṛṣṇa-nāma dvi-prakāra /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name is of two kinds, distinguished as primary (<s>mukhya</s>) and secondary (<s>gauṇa</s>);

children.text: mukhya-nāmāśraye jīva pāya sarva sāra // HNC_2.36 //
children.translated_text: by taking shelter of the primary Name, the <s>jīva</s> obtains the essence of everything. // HNC_2.36 //

children.text: cil-līlā āśraya kari yata kṛṣṇa nāma /
children.translated_text: All Names of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> that are based on His spiritual pastimes,

children.text: sei sei mukhya nāma sarva guṇa dhāma // HNC_2.37 //
children.translated_text: each of those is a primary Name, the abode of all virtues. // HNC_2.37 //

body.translated_text: Primary Names

children.text: govinda gopāla rāma śrī-nanda-nandana /
children.translated_text: <s>Govinda</s>, <s>Gopāla</s>, <s>Rāma</s>, <s>Śrī Nanda-nandana</s>,

children.text: rādhānātha hari yaśomatī prāṇa-dhana // HNC_2.38 //
children.translated_text: <s>Rādhānātha</s>, <s>Hari</s>, the life-treasure of <s>Yaśomatī</s>; // HNC_2.38 //

children.text: madana-mohana śyāmasundara mādhava /
children.translated_text: <s>Madana-mohana</s>, <s>Śyāmasundara</s>, <s>Mādhava</s>,

children.text: gopīnātha vraja-gopa rākhāla yādava // HNC_2.39 //
children.translated_text: <s>Gopīnātha</s>, <s>Vraja-gopa</s>, <s>Rākhāla</s>, <s>Yādava</s> — // HNC_2.39 //

children.text: ei rūpa nitya līlā prakāśaka nāma /
children.translated_text: these are Names that reveal His eternal pastimes;

children.text: e saba kīrtane jīva pāya kṛṣṇa dhāma // HNC_2.40 //
children.translated_text: by chanting all of these, the <s>jīva</s> attains <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s abode. // HNC_2.40 //

body.translated_text: Secondary Names and their characteristics

children.text: jaḍā prakṛtira paricaye nāma yata /
children.translated_text: Those Names connected with the identification of material nature,

children.text: prakṛtira guṇe gauṇa vedera sammata // HNC_2.41 //
children.translated_text: being related to the qualities of <s>Prakṛti</s> (material nature), are secondary — this is the verdict of the <s>Vedas</s>. // HNC_2.41 //

children.text: sṛṣṭi-kartā paramātmā brahma sthiti-kara /
children.translated_text: The Creator, <s>Paramātmā</s> (Supreme Soul), <s>Brahman</s>, the Sustainer,

children.text: jagat-saṃhartā pātā - yajñeśvara hara // HNC_2.42 //
children.translated_text: the Destroyer of the universe, the Protector — <s>Yajñeśvara</s> (Lord of sacrifice), <s>Hara</s> — // HNC_2.42 //

body.translated_text: The difference in results between primary and secondary Names

children.text: ei-rūpa nāma karma-jñāna-kāṇḍa-gata /
children.translated_text: Such Names belong to the domain of <s>karma-kāṇḍa</s> (ritualistic action) and <s>jñāna-kāṇḍa</s> (speculative knowledge);

children.text: puṇya mokṣa dāna kare śāstrera sammata // HNC_2.43 //
children.translated_text: they grant piety and liberation — this is the verdict of the scriptures. // HNC_2.43 //

children.text: nāmera ye mukhya phala kṛṣṇa prema dhana /
children.translated_text: The principal fruit of the Name is the wealth of <s>Kṛṣṇa-prema</s> (love for Kṛṣṇa);

children.text: tāra mukhya nāme mātra labhe sādhu gaṇa // HNC_2.44 //
children.translated_text: that is obtained by the saintly only through the primary Name. // HNC_2.44 //

body.translated_text: The difference in results between the Name proper and <s>nāmābhāsa</s> (semblance of the Name)

children.text: eka kṛṣṇa-nāma yadi mukhe bāhirāya /
children.translated_text: If even one Name of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> issues from the mouth,

children.text: athavā śravaṇa-pathe antarete yāya // HNC_2.45 //
children.translated_text: or enters within through the path of hearing — // HNC_2.45 //

children.text: śuddha varṇa haya vā aśuddha varṇa haya /
children.translated_text: whether the pronunciation is pure or impure,

children.text: tāte jīva tare ei śāstrera nirṇaya // HNC_2.46 //
children.translated_text: the <s>jīva</s> (soul) is delivered thereby — this is the conclusion of the scriptures. // HNC_2.46 //

children.text: kintu eka kathā ithe āche suniścita /
children.translated_text: But there is one matter here that is certain:

children.text: nāmābhāsa haile vilambe haya hita // HNC_2.47 //
children.translated_text: with <s>nāmābhāsa</s> (semblance of the Name), the benefit comes only after delay. // HNC_2.47 //

children.text: nāmābhāsa haile-o anya śubha haya /
children.translated_text: Even with <s>nāmābhāsa</s>, other auspicious results arise,

children.text: prema-dhana kevala vilambe upajaya // HNC_2.48 //
children.translated_text: but the wealth of <s>prema</s> (divine love) arises only after a delay. // HNC_2.48 //

children.text: nāmābhāse pāpa-kṣaye śuddha nāma haya /
children.translated_text: When through <s>nāmābhāsa</s>, sins are destroyed, then the pure Name arises;

children.text: takhana-i śrī-kṛṣṇa-prema labhaye niścaya // HNC_2.49 //
children.translated_text: at that very moment, one certainly obtains <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa-prema</s> (love for Kṛṣṇa). // HNC_2.49 //

body.translated_text: Obstruction or interference (<s>vyavadhāna</s>) gives rise to offenses

children.text: kintu vyavahita hale haya aparādha /
children.translated_text: But if there is obstruction (<s>vyavadhāna</s>), then offense arises;

children.text: sei aparādhe haya prema-lābha bādha // HNC_2.50 //
children.translated_text: by that offense, the attainment of <s>prema</s> (divine love) is impeded. // HNC_2.50 //

children.text: nāma-nāmī bheda-buddhi vyavadhāna haya /
children.translated_text: The notion of difference between the Name and the Named constitutes obstruction;

children.text: vyavahita thākile kadāpi prema naya // HNC_2.51 //
children.translated_text: as long as obstruction remains, <s>prema</s> never [comes]. // HNC_2.51 //

body.translated_text: Obstruction is of two kinds

children.text: varṇa-vyavadhāna āra tattva-vyavadhāna /
children.translated_text: Obstruction of syllables (<s>varṇa-vyavadhāna</s>) and obstruction of truth (<s>tattva-vyavadhāna</s>) —

children.text: vyavadhāna dvi-prakāra vedera vidhāna // HNC_2.52 //
children.translated_text: obstruction is of two kinds — this is the ordinance of the <s>Vedas</s>. // HNC_2.52 //

body.translated_text: <s>Māyāvāda</s> (illusionism) creates obstruction of truth in the Name

children.text: tattva-vyavadhāna māyāvāda duṣṭa mata /
children.translated_text: Obstruction of truth is the corrupt doctrine of <s>Māyāvāda</s> (illusionism);

children.text: kalira jañjāla ei śāstra asammata // HNC_2.53 //
children.translated_text: it is the entanglement of <s>Kali</s> [Yuga] — disapproved by the scriptures. // HNC_2.53 //

body.translated_text: The Name free from obstruction is the pure Name

children.text: ataeva śuddha kṛṣṇa nāma yāṅra mukhe /
children.translated_text: Therefore, one in whose mouth there is the pure Name of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: tāṅhāke vaiṣṇava jāni sadā sevi sukhe // HNC_2.54 //
children.translated_text: know him as a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> and always serve him with happiness. // HNC_2.54 //

body.text: anartha yata naṣṭa haya tata-i nāmābhāsatva dūra haya o cinmaya nāma prakāśa pāya
body.translated_text: As obstacles are destroyed, the quality of <s>nāmābhāsa</s> recedes and the spiritual Name becomes manifest

children.text: nāmābhāsa bhedi śuddha-nāma labhibāre /
children.translated_text: To break through <s>nāmābhāsa</s> and attain the pure Name,

children.text: sad-guru sevibe jīva yatna sahakāre // HNC_2.55 //
children.translated_text: the <s>jīva</s> (soul) should serve the <s>sad-guru</s> (true spiritual master) with effort and care. // HNC_2.55 //

children.text: bhajane anartha nāśa yei kṣaṇe pāya /
children.translated_text: At the very moment when obstacles in worship are destroyed,

children.text: cit-svarūpa nāme nāce bhaktera jīhvāya // HNC_2.56 //
children.translated_text: the Name in its spiritual form dances on the tongue of the devotee. // HNC_2.56 //

children.text: nāma se amṛta dhārā nāhi chāḍe āra /
children.translated_text: The Name is a stream of nectar that never ceases;

children.text: nāma rase matta jīva nāce anivāra // HNC_2.57 //
children.translated_text: the <s>jīva</s>, intoxicated by the <s>rasa</s> (divine flavor) of the Name, dances without stopping. // HNC_2.57 //

children.text: nāma nāce jīva nāce nāce prema dhana /
children.translated_text: The Name dances, the <s>jīva</s> dances, the wealth of <s>prema</s> (divine love) dances;

children.text: jagat nācāya māyā kare palāyana // HNC_2.58 //
children.translated_text: it makes the world dance [while] <s>Māyā</s> (illusion) flees. // HNC_2.58 //

body.text: yāhāra nāme śraddhā haya tāhāra-i nāme adhikāra haiyā thāke nāme sarva-śakti āche
body.translated_text: One who has faith in the Name has the right to chant the Name — all potencies are in the Name

children.text: nāme adhikāra nara-mātre kaile dāna /
children.translated_text: The Lord has given to all human beings the right to chant the Name;

children.text: sarva-śakti nāme prabhu karile vidhāna // HNC_2.59 //
children.translated_text: the Lord has ordained all potencies within the Name. // HNC_2.59 //

children.text: yāra śraddhā haya nāme sei adhikārī /
children.translated_text: Whoever has faith in the Name — he is qualified;

children.text: yāra mukhe kṛṣṇa-nāma sei se ācārī // HNC_2.60 //
children.translated_text: whoever has <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name on his lips — he is the true practitioner. // HNC_2.60 //

children.text: deśa-kāla aśaucādira bādhā nāme nāi
children.translated_text: Restrictions of place, time, impurity, etc. do not apply to the Name

children.text: deśa kāla aśaucādi niyama sakāla /
children.translated_text: All rules regarding place, time, impurity, and so forth

children.text: śrī-nāma-grahaṇe nāi nāma se prabala // HNC_2.61 //
children.translated_text: do not [apply] to the chanting of the Holy Name — the Name is supremely powerful. // HNC_2.61 //

body.text: kali-jīvera nāme niṣkapaṭa viśvāsa haile-i nāme adhikāra haila
body.translated_text: When the <s>jīva</s> of <s>Kali</s> [Yuga] has sincere faith in the Name, it acquires the right to chant the Name

children.text: dāne yajñe snāne jape āche ta vicāra /
children.translated_text: For charity, sacrifice, bathing, and <s>japa</s> (silent repetition), there are considerations [of eligibility];

children.text: kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtane mātra śraddhā adhikāra // HNC_2.62 //
children.translated_text: for <s>Kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtana</s> (congregational chanting), faith alone is the qualification. // HNC_2.62 //

children.text: yuga-dharma hari-nāma ananya śraddhāya /
children.translated_text: The <s>yuga-dharma</s> (religion of the age) is <s>Hari-nāma</s> (the Holy Name) — with exclusive faith,

children.text: ye kare āśraya tāra sarva-lābha haya // HNC_2.63 //
children.translated_text: one who takes shelter [of the Name] obtains all benefits. // HNC_2.63 //

children.text: kali jīva niṣkapaṭe kṛṣṇera saṃsāre /
children.translated_text: The <s>jīva</s> of <s>Kali</s> [Yuga], sincerely situated in <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s service,

children.text: avasthita haye kṛṣṇa-nāma sadā kare // HNC_2.64 //
children.translated_text: constantly chants the Name of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // HNC_2.64 //

body.text: nāmera anukūla viṣaya grahaṇa o pratikūla visaya varjana
body.translated_text: Accepting what is favorable to the Name and rejecting what is unfavorable

children.text: bhajanera anukūla sarva kāryya kari' /
children.translated_text: Performing all activities favorable to worship,

children.text: bhajanera pratikūla saba parihari' // HNC_2.65 //
children.translated_text: and abandoning everything unfavorable to worship — // HNC_2.65 //

children.text: kṛṣṇera saṃsāre thāki' kāṭāye jīvana /
children.translated_text: living within <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s household, one passes one's life

children.text: nirantara hari-nāma karena smaraṇa // HNC_2.66 //
children.translated_text: in the constant remembrance of <s>Hari</s>'s Name. // HNC_2.66 //

body.translated_text: One should chant the Name with exclusive devotion

children.text: āra kona dharma karma kabhu nā karibe /
children.translated_text: One should never perform any other <s>dharma</s> or <s>karma</s> (religious or worldly duty);

children.text: svatantra īśvara-jñāne anye nā pūjibe // HNC_2.67 //
children.translated_text: one should not worship any other [deity] with the conception of an independent lord. // HNC_2.67 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāma bhakta-sevā satata karibe /
children.translated_text: One should constantly chant <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name and serve His devotees;

children.text: kṛṣṇa-prema lābha tāra avaśya ha-ibe // HNC_2.68 //
children.translated_text: the attainment of <s>Kṛṣṇa-prema</s> (love for Kṛṣṇa) will surely follow. // HNC_2.68 //

children.text: haridāsa kāṅdi prabhu caraṇe paḍiyā /
children.translated_text: Weeping, <s>Haridāsa</s> fell at the Lord's feet,

children.text: nāme anurāga māge caraṇa dhariyā // HNC_2.69 //
children.translated_text: begging for attachment to the Name, clasping His feet. // HNC_2.69 //

children.text: haridāsa pade bhaktivinoda yāhāra /
children.translated_text: <s>Bhaktivinoda</s>, who is at <s>Haridāsa</s>'s feet —

children.text: harināma cintāmaṇi jīvana tāhāra // HNC_2.70 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Harināma Cintāmaṇi</s> (wish-fulfilling gem of the Holy Name) is his very life. // HNC_2.70 //

body.text:
iti śrī-hari-nāma-cintāmaṇau
nāma-grahaṇa-vicāro nāma prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ /
body.translated_text: Thus ends the first chapter of Śrī <s>Hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi</s> (the wish-fulfilling jewel of the Holy Name), entitled "Consideration of accepting the Name" (<s>nāma-grahaṇa-vicāra</s>).
(3) Third Chapter: Consideration of <s>Nāmābhāsa</s> (the semblance of the Holy Name)

children.text: gadāi gaurāṅga jaya jāhnavā jīvana /
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Gadāi</s> <s>Gaurāṅga</s>, the life of <s>Jāhnavā</s>!

children.text: sītādvaita jaya śrīvāsādi bhakta-jana // HNC_3.1 //
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Sītā</s>, <s>Advaita</s>, <s>Śrīvāsa</s>, and all the devotees!

children.text: haridāse mahāprabhu sadaya haiyā /
children.translated_text: <s>Mahāprabhu</s>, being merciful to <s>Haridāsa</s>,

children.text: uṭhāya takhana padma-hasta prasāriyā // HNC_3.2 //
children.translated_text: then raised him up, extending His lotus hand.

children.text: bale śuna haridāsa āmāra vacana /
children.translated_text: He said, "Listen, <s>Haridāsa</s>, to My words.

children.text: nāmābhāsa spaṣṭa-rūpe bujhāo ekhana // HNC_3.3 //
children.translated_text: Now explain clearly the nature of <s>nāmābhāsa</s> (the semblance of the Name)."

children.text: nāmābhāsa bujhāile nāma śuddha habe /
children.translated_text: "If <s>nāmābhāsa</s> is properly understood, the Name will become pure,

children.text: anāyāse jīva nāma-guṇe tare yābe // HNC_3.4 //
children.translated_text: and the living being will easily be delivered by the qualities of the Name."

body.translated_text: The cloud of <s>nāmābhāsa</s>: ignorance and <s>anarthas</s> (unwanted habits) in the form of fog

children.text: nāma sūrya-sama nāśe māyā andhakāra /
children.translated_text: The Name is like the sun — it destroys the darkness of <s>māyā</s> (illusion),

children.text: megha kujjhaṭikā nāme ḍhāke bāra bāra // HNC_3.5 //
children.translated_text: but clouds and fog cover the Name again and again.

children.text: jīvera ajñāna āra anartha sakala /
children.translated_text: The ignorance of the living being and all <s>anarthas</s> (unwanted habits)

children.text: kujjhaṭikā-megha-rūpe haya ta prabala // HNC_3.6 //
children.translated_text: become powerful in the form of fog and clouds.

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāma sūrya citta-gagaṇe uṭhila /
children.translated_text: The sun of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name arose in the sky of the heart,

children.text: kujjhaṭikā-megha punaḥ tāhāre ḍhākila // HNC_3.7 //
children.translated_text: but fog and clouds covered it again.

body.translated_text: The fog of ignorance: confusion about one's true nature (<s>svarūpa-bhrama</s>)

children.text: nāmera ye cit svarūpa tāhā nāhi jāne /
children.translated_text: One who does not know the spiritual nature (<s>cit-svarūpa</s>) of the Name —

children.text: se ajñāna kujjhaṭikā andhakāra āne // HNC_3.8 //
children.translated_text: that ignorance, like fog, brings darkness.

children.text: kṛṣṇa sarveśvara bali nāhi jāne yei /
children.translated_text: One who does not know that <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is the Lord of all,

children.text: nānā deve pūji karma-mārge bhrame sei // HNC_3.9 //
children.translated_text: worships various <s>devas</s> (demigods) and wanders on the path of <s>karma</s> (fruitive action).

children.text: jīve cit svarūpa bali nāhi yāra jñāna /
children.translated_text: One who has no knowledge that the living being has a spiritual nature (<s>cit-svarūpa</s>),

children.text: māyā jaḍāśraye tāra satata ajñāna // HNC_3.10 //
children.translated_text: who takes shelter of inert matter under <s>māyā</s> — such a person is always in ignorance.

children.text: tabe haridāsa bale āja āmi dhanya /
children.translated_text: Then <s>Haridāsa</s> said, "Today I am truly blessed,

children.text: mama mukhe nāma kathā śunibe caitanya // HNC_3.11 //
children.translated_text: for <s>Caitanya</s> will hear words about the Name from my mouth."

children.text: kṛṣṇa jīva prabhu dāsa jaḍātmikā māyā /
children.translated_text: "<s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is the Lord, the living being is His servant, and <s>māyā</s> is the material energy —

children.text: ye nā jāne tāra śire ajñānera chāyā // HNC_3.12 //
children.translated_text: one who does not know this has the shadow of ignorance upon his head."

body.translated_text: The cloud of <s>anarthas</s>: false desires (<s>asat-tṛṣṇā</s>), weakness of heart (<s>hṛdaya-daurbalya</s>), and offenses (<s>aparādha</s>)

children.text: asat-tṛṣṇā, hṛdaya-daurbalya, aparādha /
children.translated_text: False desires (<s>asat-tṛṣṇā</s>), weakness of heart (<s>hṛdaya-daurbalya</s>), and offenses (<s>aparādha</s>) —

children.text: anartha e saba megha-rūpe kare bādha // HNC_3.13 //
children.translated_text: all these <s>anarthas</s> obstruct in the form of clouds.

children.text: nāma-sūrya raśmi ḍhāke nāmābhāsa haya /
children.translated_text: They cover the rays of the sun of the Name, and <s>nāmābhāsa</s> (semblance of the Name) results,

children.text: svataḥ siddha kṛṣṇa-nāme sadā ācchādaya // HNC_3.14 //
children.translated_text: always veiling the self-manifest Name of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>.

body.translated_text: The limit of <s>nāmābhāsa</s>

children.text: sambandha-tattvera jñāna yāvat nā haya /
children.translated_text: As long as knowledge of the principle of one's relationship (<s>sambandha-tattva</s>) does not arise,

children.text: tāvat se nāmābhāsa jīvera āśraya // HNC_3.15 //
children.translated_text: so long <s>nāmābhāsa</s> remains the shelter of the living being.

children.text: sādhaka yadyapi pāya sad-guru āśraya /
children.translated_text: When the practitioner (<s>sādhaka</s>) takes shelter of a genuine spiritual master (<s>sad-guru</s>),

children.text: bhajana-naipuṇye megha ādi dūra haya // HNC_3.16 //
children.translated_text: through expertise in devotional practice (<s>bhajana</s>), the clouds and other obstructions are dispelled.

body.translated_text: Relationship (<s>sambandha</s>), practice (<s>abhidheya</s>), and ultimate goal (<s>prayojana</s>)

children.text: megha kujjhaṭikā gele nāma-divākara /
children.translated_text: When the fog and clouds are gone, the sun of the Name,

children.text: prakāśa haiyā bhakte dena prema-vara // HNC_3.17 //
children.translated_text: manifesting itself, bestows the supreme gift of <s>prema</s> (divine love) upon the devotee.

children.text: sad-guru sambandha jñāna kariyā arpaṇa /
children.translated_text: The genuine spiritual master (<s>sad-guru</s>), bestowing knowledge of one's relationship (<s>sambandha-jñāna</s>),

children.text: abhidheya rūpe karāna nāmānuśīlana // HNC_3.18 //
children.translated_text: causes one to cultivate the Name (<s>nāmānuśīlana</s>) as the means (<s>abhidheya</s>).

children.text: nāma-sūrya svalpa-kāle prabala haiyā /
children.translated_text: The sun of the Name, becoming powerful in a short time,

children.text: anartha-kujjhaṭikā dena tāḍāiyā // HNC_3.19 //
children.translated_text: drives away the fog of <s>anarthas</s>.

children.text: prayojana-tattva tabe dena prema-dhana /
children.translated_text: Then the principle of the ultimate goal (<s>prayojana-tattva</s>) bestows the treasure of <s>prema</s> (divine love),

children.text: prāpta-prema jīva kare nāma-saṅkīrtana // HNC_3.20 //
children.translated_text: and the living being who has attained <s>prema</s> performs <s>nāma-saṅkīrtana</s> (congregational chanting of the Name).

body.translated_text: Knowledge of one's relationship (<s>sambandha-jñāna</s>)

children.text: sad-guru-caraṇe jīva śraddhā sahakāre /
children.translated_text: At the feet of the genuine spiritual master (<s>sad-guru</s>), the living being, with faith (<s>śraddhā</s>),

children.text: prathame sambandha-jñāna pāya suvicāre // HNC_3.21 //
children.translated_text: first attains knowledge of one's relationship (<s>sambandha-jñāna</s>) through proper deliberation.

children.text: kṛṣṇa nitya prabhu āra jīva nitya dāsa /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is the eternal Lord, and the living being is His eternal servant;

children.text: kṛṣṇa prema nitya jīva-svabhāva prakāśa // HNC_3.22 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>-<s>prema</s> (love for Kṛṣṇa) is the eternal manifestation of the living being's true nature.

children.text: kṛṣṇa nitya dāsa jīva tāhā vismariyā /
children.translated_text: Forgetting that the living being is eternally the servant of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: māyika jagate phire sukha anveṣiyā // HNC_3.23 //
children.translated_text: one wanders in the material world seeking happiness.

children.text: māyika jagat haya jīva kārāgāra /
children.translated_text: The material world is a prison for the living being;

children.text: jīvera vaimukhya doṣe daṇḍa pratikāra // HNC_3.24 //
children.translated_text: it is the punishment and remedy for the fault of the living being's aversion to the Lord.

children.text: tabe yadi jīva sādhu vaiṣṇava kṛpāya /
children.translated_text: Then, if by the mercy of a saintly <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>,

children.text: sambandha jñānete punaḥ kṛṣṇa-nāma pāya // HNC_3.25 //
children.translated_text: the living being again attains <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name through knowledge of relationship (<s>sambandha-jñāna</s>),

children.text: tabe pāya prema-dhana sarva-dharma-sāra /
children.translated_text: then one obtains the treasure of <s>prema</s>, the essence of all <s>dharma</s> (duties),

children.text: yāhāra nikaṭe sāyujyādira dhikkāra // HNC_3.26 //
children.translated_text: before which <s>sāyujya</s> (merging liberation) and other forms of liberation are contemptible.

children.text: yāvat sambandha jñāna sthira nāhi haya /
children.translated_text: As long as knowledge of one's relationship (<s>sambandha-jñāna</s>) is not firmly established,

children.text: tāvat anarthe nāmābhāsera āśraya // HNC_3.27 //
children.translated_text: so long <s>nāmābhāsa</s> remains the refuge of one beset by <s>anarthas</s>.

body.translated_text: The fruits of <s>nāmābhāsa</s>

children.text: nāmābhāsa daśāte-o aneka maṅgala /
children.translated_text: Even in the stage of <s>nāmābhāsa</s>, many auspicious results occur;

children.text: jīvera avaśya haya sukṛti prabala // HNC_3.28 //
children.translated_text: the living being certainly acquires powerful spiritual merit (<s>sukṛti</s>).

children.text: nāmābhāse naṣṭa haya āche pāpa yata /
children.translated_text: Through <s>nāmābhāsa</s>, all existing sins are destroyed;

children.text: nāmābhāse mukti haya kali haya hata // HNC_3.29 //
children.translated_text: through <s>nāmābhāsa</s>, liberation is attained and the age of <s>Kali</s> is defeated.

children.text: nāmābhāse nara haya supaṅkti pāvana /
children.translated_text: Through <s>nāmābhāsa</s>, a person purifies even his entire lineage;

children.text: nāmābhāse sarva-roga haya nivāraṇa // HNC_3.30 //
children.translated_text: through <s>nāmābhāsa</s>, all diseases are cured.

children.text: sakala āśaṅkā nāmābhāse dūra haya /
children.translated_text: All doubts and apprehensions are removed by <s>nāmābhāsa</s>;

children.text: nāmābhāsī sarvāriṣṭa haite śānti pāya // HNC_3.31 //
children.translated_text: one who chants <s>nāmābhāsa</s> attains peace from all calamities.

children.text: yakṣa rakṣa bhūta preta graha samudaya /
children.translated_text: <s>Yakṣas</s> (nature spirits), <s>rākṣasas</s> (demons), <s>bhūtas</s> (ghosts), <s>pretas</s> (departed spirits), and all <s>grahas</s> (malefic planetary influences) —

children.text: nāmābhāse sakala anartha dūre yāya // HNC_3.32 //
children.translated_text: through <s>nāmābhāsa</s>, all such <s>anarthas</s> (obstacles) go far away.

children.text: narake patita loka sukhe mukti pāya /
children.translated_text: People fallen into hell easily attain liberation;

children.text: samasta prārabdha karma nāmābhāse yāya // HNC_3.33 //
children.translated_text: all <s>prārabdha karma</s> (fructified past actions) are destroyed by <s>nāmābhāsa</s>.

children.text: sarva-vedādhika sarva tīrtha haite baḍa /
children.translated_text: Superior to all the <s>Vedas</s>, greater than all holy places (<s>tīrthas</s>),

children.text: nāmābhāsa sarva-śubha-karma śreṣṭhatara // HNC_3.34 //
children.translated_text: <s>nāmābhāsa</s> is the most excellent of all auspicious activities.

body.translated_text: <s>Nāmābhāsa</s> grants attainment of <s>Vaikuṇṭha</s> and other spiritual abodes

children.text: dharma artha kāma mokṣa catur-varga-dātā /
children.translated_text: <s>Dharma</s> (religiosity), <s>artha</s> (wealth), <s>kāma</s> (desire), and <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation) — it bestows all four goals of life;

children.text: sarva-śakti dhare nāmābhāse jīva-trātā // HNC_3.35 //
children.translated_text: possessing all potencies, <s>nāmābhāsa</s> is the deliverer of the living beings.

children.text: jagat ānanda-kara śreṣṭha-pada-prada /
children.translated_text: It brings joy to the world and grants the supreme destination;

children.text: agatira eka gati sarva-śreṣṭha-pada // HNC_3.36 //
children.translated_text: it is the sole refuge of the shelterless, the supreme abode.

children.text: vaikuṇṭhādi loka prāpti nāmābhāse haya /
children.translated_text: Attainment of <s>Vaikuṇṭha</s> and other realms occurs through <s>nāmābhāsa</s>;

children.text: viśeṣataḥ kali-yuge sarva-śāstra kaya // HNC_3.37 //
children.translated_text: especially in the age of <s>Kali</s>, all scriptures declare this.

body.text: saṅketa, parihāsa, stobha o helā ei cāri-prakāra nāmābhāsa
body.translated_text: The four types of <s>nāmābhāsa</s>: <s>saṅketa</s> (indication), <s>parihāsa</s> (jest), <s>stobha</s> (musical exclamation), and <s>helā</s> (neglect)

children.text: caturvidha nāmābhāsa ei mātra jāni /
children.translated_text: Know that <s>nāmābhāsa</s> is of four kinds:

children.text: saṅketa o parihāsa, stobha, helā māni // HNC_3.38 //
children.translated_text: <s>saṅketa</s> (indication), <s>parihāsa</s> (jest), <s>stobha</s> (exclamation), and <s>helā</s> (neglect).

body.translated_text: The two types of <s>nāmābhāsa</s> in the form of <s>saṅketa</s> (indication)

children.text: viṣṇu lakṣya kari jaḍa buddhye nāma laya /
children.translated_text: One takes the Name with material understanding, intending <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: anya lakṣya kari viṣṇu nāma uccāraya // HNC_3.39 //
children.translated_text: or one utters the name of <s>Viṣṇu</s> while intending something else.

children.text: saṅgete dvividha ei haya nāmābhāsa /
children.translated_text: These are the two kinds of <s>nāmābhāsa</s> by <s>saṅketa</s> (indication);

children.text: ajāmila sākṣī tāra śāstrete prakāśa // HNC_3.40 //
children.translated_text: <s>Ajāmila</s> is the witness of this, as revealed in the scriptures.

children.text: yavana sakala mukta habe anāyāse /
children.translated_text: All the <s>yavanas</s> (foreigners) will easily be liberated,

children.text: hārāma hārāma bali kahe nāmābhāse // HNC_3.41 //
children.translated_text: for they chant "<s>hārāma</s>, <s>hārāma</s>" as <s>nāmābhāsa</s>.

children.text: anyatra saṅkete yadi haya nāmābhāsa /
children.translated_text: Even when <s>nāmābhāsa</s> occurs through indication referring to something else,

children.text: tathāpi nāmera teja nā haya vināśa // HNC_3.42 //
children.translated_text: still the potency of the Name is not destroyed.

body.translated_text: <s>Nāmābhāsa</s> through jest (<s>parihāsa</s>)

children.text: parihāse kṛṣṇa-nāma yei jana kare /
children.translated_text: One who utters <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name in jest —

children.text: jarāsandha sama sei e saṃsāre tare // HNC_3.43 //
children.translated_text: like <s>Jarāsandha</s>, such a person crosses over this material existence.

body.translated_text: <s>Nāmābhāsa</s> through exclamation (<s>stobha</s>)

children.text: aṅga-bhaṅgī caidya sama kare nāmābhāsa /
children.translated_text: One who chants <s>nāmābhāsa</s> with gestures, like <s>Caidya</s> (<s>Śiśupāla</s>) —

children.text: stobha mātra haya tabu nāśe bhava-pāśa // HNC_3.44 //
children.translated_text: even though it is merely an exclamation (<s>stobha</s>), it still destroys the bondage of material existence.

body.translated_text: <s>Nāmābhāsa</s> through neglect (<s>helā</s>)

children.text: mana nāhi deya āra avajñā bhāvete /
children.translated_text: Without paying attention, or with a mood of disregard,

children.text: kṛṣṇa rāma bale helā nāmābhāsa tāte // HNC_3.45 //
children.translated_text: one says "<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, <s>Rāma</s>" — that constitutes <s>nāmābhāsa</s> through <s>helā</s> (neglect).

children.text: ei saba nāmābhāse mleccha-gaṇa tare /
children.translated_text: Through all these forms of <s>nāmābhāsa</s>, even <s>mlecchas</s> (outcasts) are delivered;

children.text: viṣayī alasa jana ei patha dhare // HNC_3.46 //
children.translated_text: materialistic and lazy persons follow this path.

body.translated_text: The distinction between <s>nāmābhāsa</s> with faith (<s>śraddhā</s>) and with neglect (<s>helā</s>)

children.text: śraddhā kari kare nāma anartha sahita /
children.translated_text: One who chants the Name with faith, though accompanied by <s>anarthas</s>,

children.text: śraddhā nāma haya sei tomāra vihita // HNC_3.47 //
children.translated_text: that is called faithful chanting (<s>śraddhā-nāma</s>), which is ordained for you.

children.text: saṅketādi avajñā paryanta bhāva dhari /
children.translated_text: From the mood of indication (<s>saṅketa</s>) up to disregard,

children.text: nāma kare helāya ye śraddhā parihari // HNC_3.48 //
children.translated_text: one who chants the Name with neglect, abandoning faith —

children.text: nāmābhāsa avadhi se helā nāma haya /
children.translated_text: that constitutes <s>nāmābhāsa</s> through <s>helā</s> (neglect) up to the limit of <s>nāmābhāsa</s>,

children.text: tāhāte-o mukti labhe pāpa haya kṣaya // HNC_3.49 //
children.translated_text: yet even in that, liberation is obtained and sins are destroyed.

body.text: anartha-nāśe nāmābhāsa nāma haiyā prema deya
body.translated_text: When <s>anarthas</s> are destroyed, <s>nāmābhāsa</s> becomes the pure Name and bestows <s>prema</s> (divine love)

children.text: kṛṣṇa prema chāḍi saba nāmābhāse pāya /
children.translated_text: Except for <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>-<s>prema</s>, everything is obtained through <s>nāmābhāsa</s>;

children.text: nāmābhāse punaḥ śuddha nāma haye yāya // HNC_3.50 //
children.translated_text: and <s>nāmābhāsa</s> again transforms into the pure Name.

children.text: anartha vigate yabe śuddha nāma haya /
children.translated_text: When <s>anarthas</s> are gone and the pure Name arises,

children.text: kṛṣṇa-prema tabe tāra ha-ibe niścaya // HNC_3.51 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>-<s>prema</s> will certainly manifest for that person.

children.text: nāmābhāse sākṣāt se prema dite nāre /
children.translated_text: <s>Nāmābhāsa</s> cannot directly give <s>prema</s>;

children.text: nāma haye prema deya vidhi anusāre // HNC_3.52 //
children.translated_text: becoming the pure Name, it bestows <s>prema</s> according to the proper sequence.

body.translated_text: The distinction between <s>nāmābhāsa</s> and <s>nāmāparādha</s> (offense to the Name)

children.text: ataeva nāma aparādha parihari /
children.translated_text: Therefore, one who abandons offenses to the Name (<s>nāmāparādha</s>)

children.text: nāmābhāsa kare yei tāre nati kari // HNC_3.53 //
children.translated_text: and chants <s>nāmābhāsa</s> — I offer my obeisance to such a person.

children.text: karma jñāna haite ananta śreṣṭhatara /
children.translated_text: Infinitely superior to <s>karma</s> (fruitive action) and <s>jñāna</s> (speculative knowledge) —

children.text: bali nāmābhāse jāni ohe sarveśvara // HNC_3.54 //
children.translated_text: thus I know <s>nāmābhāsa</s> to be, O Lord of all.

children.text: rati mūlā śraddhā yadi śuddha-bhāve haya /
children.translated_text: If faith (<s>śraddhā</s>) rooted in <s>rati</s> (attachment to the Lord) is in a pure state,

children.text: tabe ta viśuddha nāma ha-ibe udaya // HNC_3.55 //
children.translated_text: then the completely pure Name will arise.

body.text:
chāyā o pratibimba bhede ābhāsa dui prakāra
chāyā nāmābhāsa
body.translated_text: Two types of <s>ābhāsa</s> (semblance): <s>chāyā</s> (shadow) and <s>pratibimba</s> (reflection). <s>Chāyā-nāmābhāsa</s> (shadow semblance of the Name)

children.text: ābhāsa dvividha haya pratibimba chāyā /
children.translated_text: <s>Ābhāsa</s> (semblance) is of two kinds: <s>pratibimba</s> (reflection) and <s>chāyā</s> (shadow);

children.text: śraddhābhāsa dvi-prakāra saba tava māyā // HNC_3.56 //
children.translated_text: similarly, <s>śraddhābhāsa</s> (semblance of faith) is of two kinds — all by Your <s>māyā</s>.

children.text: chāyā śraddhābhāse chāyā-nāmābhāsa haya /
children.translated_text: From the shadow-semblance of faith (<s>chāyā-śraddhābhāsa</s>), shadow-<s>nāmābhāsa</s> (<s>chāyā-nāmābhāsa</s>) arises;

children.text: sei nāmābhāse jīvera śubha prasavaya // HNC_3.57 //
children.translated_text: that <s>nāmābhāsa</s> produces auspiciousness for the living being.

body.translated_text: <s>Pratibimba-nāmābhāsa</s> (reflection-semblance of the Name)

children.text: anya jīve śuddhā śraddhā kariyā darśana /
