children.translated_text: Seeing pure faith in other living beings,

children.text: nija mane śraddhābhāsa āne yei jana // HNC_3.58 //
children.translated_text: one who brings into his own mind a semblance of faith (<s>śraddhābhāsa</s>) —

children.text: bhoga mokṣa vāñchā tāhe thāke nitya miśi /
children.translated_text: desires for enjoyment (<s>bhoga</s>) and liberation (<s>mokṣa</s>) always remain mixed within that,

children.text: aśrame abhīṣṭa lābhe yate divāniśi // HNC_3.59 //
children.translated_text: as one strives day and night for the desired attainment in one's <s>āśrama</s> (stage of life).

children.text: śraddhāra lakṣaṇa mātra śraddhā tāhe naya /
children.translated_text: That has merely the appearance of faith but is not true faith;

children.text: tāke pratibimba śraddhābhāsa śāstre kaya // HNC_3.60 //
children.translated_text: the scriptures call it <s>pratibimba-śraddhābhāsa</s> (reflection-semblance of faith).

children.text: pratibimba śraddhābhāse nāmābhāsa yata /
children.translated_text: All <s>nāmābhāsa</s> arising from <s>pratibimba-śraddhābhāsa</s>

children.text: pratibimba-nāmābhāsa haya avirata // HNC_3.61 //
children.translated_text: becomes <s>pratibimba-nāmābhāsa</s> (reflection-semblance of the Name) continuously.

body.text: pratibimba- nāmābhāse māyāvāda kapaṭatā utpanna kare
body.translated_text: <s>Pratibimba-nāmābhāsa</s> gives rise to <s>Māyāvāda</s> (impersonalism) and deceitfulness

children.text: ei nāmābhāse māyāvāda duṣṭa-mata /
children.translated_text: Through this <s>nāmābhāsa</s>, the wicked doctrine of <s>Māyāvāda</s> (impersonalism)

children.text: praveśiyā śaṭhatāya haya pariṇata // HNC_3.62 //
children.translated_text: enters and matures into deceitfulness.

body.translated_text: Deceitful <s>pratibimba-nāmābhāsa</s> constitutes <s>nāmāparādha</s> (offense to the Name)

children.text: nitya sādhya nāme sādhana buddhi kari /
children.translated_text: Applying the mentality that the eternally perfect Name is a means to some end (<s>sādhana-buddhi</s>),

children.text: nāmera mahimā nāśi aparādhe mari // HNC_3.63 //
children.translated_text: one destroys the glory of the Name and dies by offense.

body.translated_text: The distinction between <s>chāyā-nāmābhāsa</s> (shadow-semblance) and <s>pratibimba-nāmābhāsa</s> (reflection-semblance)

children.text: chāyā nāmābhāse mātra hayata ajñāna /
children.translated_text: In <s>chāyā-nāmābhāsa</s>, there is merely ignorance;

children.text: hṛdaya-daurbalya haite anartha vidhāna // HNC_3.64 //
children.translated_text: from weakness of heart, <s>anarthas</s> arise.

children.text: sei saba doṣe nāma karena mārjana /
children.translated_text: The Name cleanses all these faults;

children.text: pratibimba nāmābhāse doṣera vardhana // HNC_3.65 //
children.translated_text: but in <s>pratibimba-nāmābhāsa</s>, faults increase.

body.text:
māyāvāda o bhakti - iṅhārā paraspara viparīta dharma
māyāvāda-i aparādha
body.translated_text: <s>Māyāvāda</s> and <s>bhakti</s> (devotion) are mutually opposite. <s>Māyāvāda</s> itself is an offense.

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāma rūpa guṇa līlādi sakala /
children.translated_text: The Name, form, qualities, and pastimes of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> — all of these —

children.text: māyāvādi-mate mithyā naśvara sakala // HNC_3.66 //
children.translated_text: according to the <s>Māyāvāda</s> doctrine, are false and perishable.

children.text: sei mate prema-tattva nitya nāhi haya /
children.translated_text: According to that doctrine, the principle of <s>prema</s> (divine love) is not eternal;

children.text: bhakti-viparīta māyāvāda suniścaya // HNC_3.67 //
children.translated_text: <s>Māyāvāda</s> is certainly the opposite of <s>bhakti</s> (devotion).

children.text: bhakti-vairī madhye māyāvādera gaṇana /
children.translated_text: <s>Māyāvādīs</s> (impersonalists) are counted among the enemies of <s>bhakti</s>;

children.text: ataeva māyāvādī aparādhī hana // HNC_3.68 //
children.translated_text: therefore, the <s>Māyāvādī</s> is an offender.

children.text: māyāvādi mukhe nāma nāhi bāhirāya /
children.translated_text: From the mouth of a <s>Māyāvādī</s>, the true Name does not manifest;

children.text: nāma bāhirāya tabu nāmatva nā pāya // HNC_3.69 //
children.translated_text: even if the Name comes from their mouth, it does not attain its true nature as the Name.

children.text: māyāvādī yadi kare nāma uccāraṇa /
children.translated_text: If a <s>Māyāvādī</s> utters the Name,

children.text: nāmake anitya bali labhaye patana // HNC_3.70 //
children.translated_text: considering the Name to be temporary, he falls down.

children.text: nāmera nikaṭe bhoga-mokṣera prārthanā /
children.translated_text: To pray for enjoyment or liberation before the Name,

children.text: nāmera nikaṭe śāṭhya phalete yātanā // HNC_3.71 //
children.translated_text: to practice deceit before the Name — the result is suffering.

body.translated_text: When does the <s>Māyāvādī</s>'s offense cease?

children.text: tabe yadi māyāvādī bhukti mukti āśa /
children.translated_text: Then, if the <s>Māyāvādī</s> abandons the desire for enjoyment (<s>bhukti</s>) and liberation (<s>mukti</s>),

children.text: chāḍiyā karaye nāma haye kṛṣṇa-dāsa // HNC_3.72 //
children.translated_text: and chants the Name becoming a servant of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: tabe tāre chāḍe māyāvāda duṣṭa-mata /
children.translated_text: then the wicked doctrine of <s>Māyāvāda</s> leaves him;

children.text: anutāpa saha haya nāma anugata // HNC_3.73 //
children.translated_text: with remorse, he becomes surrendered to the Name.

children.text: sādhu saṅge kare punaḥ śravaṇa kīrtana /
children.translated_text: In the association of saintly devotees (<s>sādhu-saṅga</s>), he again practices hearing (<s>śravaṇa</s>) and chanting (<s>kīrtana</s>);

children.text: susambandha jñāna tāra ude tata kṣaṇa // HNC_3.74 //
children.translated_text: proper knowledge of one's relationship (<s>su-sambandha-jñāna</s>) arises in him at that very moment.

children.text: aviśrānta nāma kare paḍe cakṣu jala /
children.translated_text: Chanting the Name unceasingly, tears fall from his eyes;

children.text: nāma kṛpā pāya citta haya ta sabala // HNC_3.75 //
children.translated_text: by the mercy of the Name, his heart becomes strong.

body.text: bhaktike anitya baliyā māyāvāda aparādha ha-iyāche
body.translated_text: Calling <s>bhakti</s> (devotion) temporary is the offense of <s>Māyāvāda</s>

children.text: kṛṣṇa-rūpa kṛṣṇa-dāsya jīvera svabhāva /
children.translated_text: The form of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> and servitorship to <s>Kṛṇṣa</s> are the natural constitution of the living being;

children.text: māyāvāda anitya kalpita bale saba // HNC_3.76 //
children.translated_text: <s>Māyāvāda</s> declares all of this to be temporary and imaginary.

children.text: hena māyāvāda nāma aparāde gaṇi /
children.translated_text: Such <s>Māyāvāda</s> is counted as an offense to the Name (<s>nāmāparādha</s>);

children.text: māyāvāda haya sarva vipadera khani // HNC_3.77 //
children.translated_text: <s>Māyāvāda</s> is the mine of all calamities.

body.text: māyāvādī nāmābhāse yukty-ābhāsa-rūpe sāyujya lābha kare
body.translated_text: The <s>Māyāvādī</s> attains <s>sāyujya</s> (merging liberation) through <s>nāmābhāsa</s> in the form of a semblance of reasoning

children.text: nāmābhāsa kalpa-taru māyāvādi-jane /
children.translated_text: <s>Nāmābhāsa</s>, like a wish-fulfilling tree (<s>kalpa-taru</s>), to the <s>Māyāvādī</s>,

children.text: abhīṣṭa arpaṇa kare sāyujya nirvāṇe // HNC_3.78 //
children.translated_text: grants his desired goal of <s>sāyujya</s> (merging) and <s>nirvāṇa</s> (cessation).

children.text: sarva-śakti nāme āche tāi nāmābhāse /
children.translated_text: All potencies reside in the Name; therefore, even through <s>nāmābhāsa</s>,

children.text: pratibimba ha-ile-o dena mukty-ābhāse // HNC_3.79 //
children.translated_text: even if it is a mere reflection (<s>pratibimba</s>), it grants a semblance of liberation (<s>mukty-ābhāsa</s>).

children.text: pañca-vidha mukti madhye sāyujya ābhāsa /
children.translated_text: Among the five types of <s>mukti</s> (liberation), <s>sāyujya</s> (merging) is merely an <s>ābhāsa</s> (semblance);

children.text: bhava kleśa nāśe mātra phale sarva-nāśa // HNC_3.80 //
children.translated_text: it only destroys the miseries of material existence, but its result is total ruin. // HNC_3.80 //

body.translated_text: The <s>Māyāvādī</s> never attains eternal happiness;

children.text: māyāya mohita jana tāhe sukha māne /
children.translated_text: people deluded by <s>Māyā</s> (illusion) consider that to be happiness.

children.text: sukhābhāsa mātra pāya sāyujya nirvāṇe // HNC_3.81 //
children.translated_text: In <s>sāyujya nirvāṇa</s> (liberation through merging), one attains only a semblance of happiness. // HNC_3.81 //

children.text: sac-cit-ānanda sevā parama nirvṛti /
children.translated_text: Service to <s>sac-cid-ānanda</s> (eternal existence, knowledge, and bliss) is the supreme satisfaction;

children.text: sāyujya nā pāya kabhu hata-kṛṣṇa-smṛti // HNC_3.82 //
children.translated_text: <s>sāyujya</s> (merging) is never attained by one whose remembrance of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> has been destroyed. // HNC_3.82 //

children.text: yāṅhā nāhi bhakti prema nityatā viśvāsa /
children.translated_text: Where there is no faith in the eternality of <s>bhakti</s> (devotion) and <s>prema</s> (divine love),

children.text: nitya sukha kaiche tāhe ha-ibe prakāśa // HNC_3.83 //
children.translated_text: how can eternal happiness ever manifest there? // HNC_3.83 //

body.text: chāyā- nāmābhāsī duṣṭa-mate nā praveśa karile krame śuddha nāma pāiyā thākena
body.translated_text: One who has the shadow-<s>nāmābhāsa</s> (semblance of the Name), if he does not enter into corrupt doctrines, gradually attains the pure <s>Nāma</s> (Holy Name) and remains established in it.

children.text: chāyā nāmābhāsī nāhi jāne duṣṭa-mata /
children.translated_text: One who has the shadow-<s>nāmābhāsa</s> does not know corrupt doctrines;

children.text: matavāde citta-bale nahe tāra hata // HNC_3.84 //
children.translated_text: his mental strength is not destroyed by sectarian arguments. // HNC_3.84 //

children.text: se kevala nāhi jāne yathārtha prabhāva /
children.translated_text: He simply does not know the true potency of the <s>Nāma</s>;

children.text: se prabhāva jñāna-dāna nāmera svabhāva // HNC_3.85 //
children.translated_text: bestowing the knowledge of that potency is the inherent nature of the <s>Nāma</s> (Holy Name). // HNC_3.85 //

children.text: meghācchanne sūrya-prabhā pratīta nā haya /
children.translated_text: When clouds cover the sun, its radiance is not perceived,

children.text: kintu meghe nāśi sūrya karena udaya // HNC_3.86 //
children.translated_text: yet the sun destroys the clouds and rises again. // HNC_3.86 //

children.text: chāyā- nāmābhāsī dhanya sad-guru prabhāve /
children.translated_text: One who has the shadow-<s>nāmābhāsa</s> is blessed — by the influence of a true <s>sad-guru</s> (spiritual master),

children.text: alpa-dine nāma prema anāyāse pābe // HNC_3.87 //
children.translated_text: in a short time he will effortlessly attain <s>nāma-prema</s> (love through the Holy Name). // HNC_3.87 //

body.translated_text: A devotee must certainly abandon the association of <s>Māyāvādīs</s>.

children.text: māyāvādī saṅga teṅha satarke chāḍiyā /
children.translated_text: He should carefully abandon the association of <s>Māyāvādīs</s>,

children.text: śuddha nāma parāyaṇa tuṣibe seviyā // HNC_3.88 //
children.translated_text: and being devoted to the pure <s>Nāma</s> (Holy Name), he will please the Lord through service. // HNC_3.88 //

children.text: ei ta tomāra ājñā śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya /
children.translated_text: This is Your command, O <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya</s>!

children.text: sei ājñā yei pāle sei jīva dhanya // HNC_3.89 //
children.translated_text: That soul who follows this command is truly blessed. // HNC_3.89 //

children.text: ye nā pāle tava ājñā sei jīva chāra /
children.translated_text: That soul who does not follow Your command is wretched;

children.text: koṭī janme kichute-i nā habe uddhāra // HNC_3.90 //
children.translated_text: even in millions of births, he will never be delivered. // HNC_3.90 //

children.text: kusaṅga chāḍiye prabhu rākha tava pāya /
children.translated_text: O Lord, abandoning bad association, please keep me at Your feet;

children.text: tava pādapadma vinā nā dekhi upāya // HNC_3.91 //
children.translated_text: apart from Your lotus feet, I see no other means. // HNC_3.91 //

children.text: haridāsa pada-dvandve vinoda yāhāra /
children.translated_text: He whose treasure is the pair of lotus feet of <s>Haridāsa</s> —

children.text: hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi sadā gāna tāra // HNC_3.92 //
children.translated_text: <s>Bhaktivinoda</s> always sings this <s>Hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi</s>. // HNC_3.92 //

body.text:
iti śrī- hari-nāma-cintāmaṇau nāmābhāsa-varṇanaṃ nāma
tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ /
body.translated_text: Thus ends the description of <s>nāmābhāsa</s> (semblance of the Holy Name), the third chapter of <s>Śrī Hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi</s>.

(4)
Fourth Chapter
<s>Nāma-aparādha</s> (Offense against the Holy Name) — Criticism of <s>Sādhus</s> (Saints)

body.text:
satāṃ nindā nāmnaḥ paramam aparādhaṃ vitanute
yataḥ khyātiṃ yātaṃ katham u sahate tad-vigarhām /
body.translated_text: Blaspheming the saints is the greatest offense against the <s>Nāma</s> (Holy Name); how can the <s>Nāma</s>, which has become famous, tolerate the vilification of them?

children.text: gadādhara-prāṇa jaya jāhnavā-jīvana /
children.translated_text: All glories to the life of <s>Gadādhara</s>, the life of <s>Jāhnavā</s>,

children.text: jaya sītānātha śrīvāsādi bhakta-jana // HNC_4.1 //
children.translated_text: all glories to <s>Sītānātha</s>, <s>Śrīvāsa</s>, and all the devotees! // HNC_4.1 //

children.text: prabhu bale haridāsa ebe sa-vistāre /
children.translated_text: The Lord said, "O <s>Haridāsa</s>, now in detail

children.text: nāma aparādha vyākhyā kara ataḥpara // HNC_4.2 //
children.translated_text: explain the offenses against the <s>Nāma</s> (Holy Name) henceforth." // HNC_4.2 //

children.text: haridāsa bale prabhu more yā balābe /
children.translated_text: <s>Haridāsa</s> said, "O Lord, whatever You inspire me to say,

children.text: tāhāi baliba āmi tomāra prabhāve // HNC_4.3 //
children.translated_text: that alone shall I speak, by Your power." // HNC_4.3 //

body.translated_text: The ten types of <s>nāmāparādha</s> (offenses against the Holy Name)

children.text: nāma aparādha daśa-vidha śāstre kaya /
children.translated_text: The scriptures declare ten types of <s>nāma-aparādha</s> (offenses against the Holy Name);

children.text: sei aparādhe mora baḍa haya bhaya // HNC_4.4 //
children.translated_text: I have great fear of these offenses. // HNC_4.4 //

children.text: eka eka kari āmi baliba sakala /
children.translated_text: I shall describe them one by one;

children.text: aparādhe vāṅci yāte deha more bala // HNC_4.5 //
children.translated_text: give me the strength so that I may be saved from these offenses. // HNC_4.5 //

children.text: sādhu-nindā anya-deva svātantrya manana /
children.translated_text: Criticizing <s>sādhus</s> (saints), considering other <s>devas</s> (gods) as independent,

children.text: nāma tattva guru āra śāstra vinindana // HNC_4.6 //
children.translated_text: blaspheming the truth of the <s>Nāma</s>, the <s>guru</s> (spiritual master), and the scriptures; // HNC_4.6 //

children.text: harināme artha vāda kalpita manana /
children.translated_text: interpreting the <s>Hari-nāma</s> (Holy Name) through speculative reasoning, imagining false meanings,

children.text: nāma-bale pāpa śraddhā-hīne nāmārpaṇa // HNC_4.7 //
children.translated_text: faith in sinning on the strength of the <s>Nāma</s>, and giving the <s>Nāma</s> to the faithless; // HNC_4.7 //

children.text: anya śubha-karmera samāna kṛṣṇa-nāma /
children.translated_text: considering <s>Kṛṣṇa-nāma</s> (the Name of Kṛṣṇa) equal to other auspicious activities —

children.text: e kathā balile aparādha aviśrāma // HNC_4.8 //
children.translated_text: speaking such things constitutes unceasing offense. // HNC_4.8 //

children.text: nāmete anavadhāna haya aparādha /
children.translated_text: Inattention to the <s>Nāma</s> (Holy Name) is an offense;

children.text: tāhāke purāṇa kartā balena pramāda // HNC_4.9 //
children.translated_text: the author of the <s>Purāṇas</s> calls this <s>pramāda</s> (negligence). // HNC_4.9 //

children.text: nāmera māhātmya jāne tabu nāhi bhaje /
children.translated_text: One who knows the glories of the <s>Nāma</s> yet does not worship,

children.text: ahaṃ mama āsaktite saṃsārete maje // HNC_4.10 //
children.translated_text: sinks in the material world through attachment to "I" and "mine." // HNC_4.10 //

body.translated_text: Criticism of <s>sādhus</s> (saints) is the first offense.

children.text: sādhu-nindā prathamāparādha bali' jāni /
children.translated_text: Know that criticizing <s>sādhus</s> is the first offense;

children.text: ei aparādhe jīvera haya sarva hāni // HNC_4.11 //
children.translated_text: by this offense, the living being suffers complete ruin. // HNC_4.11 //

body.text: svarūpa o taṭastha lakṣaṇa bhede sādhu lakṣaṇa dvaya vicāra
body.translated_text: Twofold analysis of the characteristics of a <s>sādhu</s> — distinguished by <s>svarūpa-lakṣaṇa</s> (intrinsic characteristics) and <s>taṭastha-lakṣaṇa</s> (marginal characteristics)

children.text: sādhura lakṣaṇa tumi baliyācha prabho /
children.translated_text: O Lord, You have described the characteristics of a <s>sādhu</s> (saint),

children.text: ekādaśe uddhavere kṛṣṇa-rūpe vibho // HNC_4.12 //
children.translated_text: in the Eleventh Canto, in the form of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, to <s>Uddhava</s>. // HNC_4.12 //

children.text: dayālu sahiṣṇu sama droha-śūnya-vrata /
children.translated_text: Compassionate, tolerant, equanimous, vowed to harm none,

children.text: satya-sāra viśuddhātmā para-hite rata // HNC_4.13 //
children.translated_text: truthful in essence, pure in soul, devoted to the welfare of others; // HNC_4.13 //

children.text: kāme akṣubhita buddhi dānta akiñcana /
children.translated_text: with intellect undisturbed by desire, self-controlled, possessing nothing,

children.text: mṛdu śuci parimita-bhojī śānta-mana // HNC_4.14 //
children.translated_text: gentle, clean, moderate in eating, peaceful in mind; // HNC_4.14 //

children.text: anīha dhṛtimān sthira kṛṣṇaika-śaraṇa /
children.translated_text: free from material endeavor, resolute, steady, surrendered solely to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: apramatta sugambhīra vijita ṣaḍ-guṇa // HNC_4.15 //
children.translated_text: vigilant, deeply grave, and having conquered the six enemies; // HNC_4.15 //

children.text: amānī mānada dakṣa avañcaka jñānī /
children.translated_text: free from false prestige, respectful to all, expert, honest, and wise —

children.text: ei saba lakṣaṇete sādhu bali jāni // HNC_4.16 //
children.translated_text: by all these characteristics one is known as a <s>sādhu</s> (saint). // HNC_4.16 //

children.text: ei saba lakṣaṇa prabho haya dvi-prakāra /
children.translated_text: O Lord, all these characteristics are of two kinds;

children.text: svarūpa taṭastha bhede kariba vicāra // HNC_4.17 //
children.translated_text: I shall analyze them by the distinction of <s>svarūpa</s> (intrinsic) and <s>taṭastha</s> (marginal). // HNC_4.17 //

body.text: svarūpa-lakṣaṇa-i pradhāna lakṣaṇa, tad-āśraye taṭastha lakṣaṇa udaya haya
body.translated_text: The <s>svarūpa-lakṣaṇa</s> (intrinsic characteristic) is the primary characteristic; dependent upon it, the <s>taṭastha-lakṣaṇa</s> (marginal characteristics) arise.

children.text: kṛṣṇaika-śaraṇa haya svarūpa-lakṣaṇa /
children.translated_text: Being solely surrendered to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is the <s>svarūpa-lakṣaṇa</s> (intrinsic characteristic);

children.text: taṭastha lakṣaṇe anya guṇera gaṇana // HNC_4.18 //
children.translated_text: the other qualities are counted as <s>taṭastha-lakṣaṇa</s> (marginal characteristics). // HNC_4.18 //

children.text: kona bhāgye sādhu-saṅge nāme ruci haya /
children.translated_text: By some good fortune, in the association of <s>sādhus</s>, taste for the <s>Nāma</s> arises;

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāma gāya kare kṛṣṇa-pādāśraya // HNC_4.19 //
children.translated_text: one chants <s>Kṛṣṇa-nāma</s> and takes shelter of the feet of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // HNC_4.19 //

children.text: svarūpa lakṣaṇa sei ha-ita ha-ila /
children.translated_text: The <s>svarūpa-lakṣaṇa</s> (intrinsic characteristic) thus comes into being;

children.text: gāite gāite nāma anya guṇa āila // HNC_4.20 //
children.translated_text: by continuously chanting the <s>Nāma</s>, the other qualities appear. // HNC_4.20 //

children.text: anya guṇa-gaṇa tāi taṭastha gaṇana /
children.translated_text: The other qualities are therefore counted as <s>taṭastha</s> (marginal);

children.text: avaśya vaiṣṇava dehe habe saṅghaṭana // HNC_4.21 //
children.translated_text: they will inevitably manifest in the body of a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>. // HNC_4.21 //

body.text:
varṇāśrama liṅga, nānā-prakāra veṣa-dvārā sādhutva haya nā,
kṛṣṇaika-śaraṇatāi sādhura lakṣaṇa
body.translated_text: Saintliness does not come through <s>varṇāśrama</s> (caste and social order) designation, or through various kinds of dress; exclusive surrender to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> alone is the characteristic of a <s>sādhu</s>.

children.text: varṇāśrama cihna nānā-veṣera racanā /
children.translated_text: The marks of <s>varṇāśrama</s> (caste and social order) and the arrangement of various garbs

children.text: sādhura lakṣaṇe kabhu nā haya gaṇanā // HNC_4.22 //
children.translated_text: are never counted among the characteristics of a <s>sādhu</s>. // HNC_4.22 //

children.text: śrī-kṛṣṇa-śaraṇāgati sādhura lakṣaṇa /
children.translated_text: Surrender to <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s> is the characteristic of a <s>sādhu</s>;

children.text: tāra mukhe haya kṛṣṇa-nāma-saṅkīrtana // HNC_4.23 //
children.translated_text: from his mouth flows the <s>saṅkīrtana</s> (congregational chanting) of <s>Kṛṣṇa-nāma</s>. // HNC_4.23 //

children.text: gṛhī brahmacārī vānaprastha nyāsi-bhede /
children.translated_text: Whether one is a householder, a <s>brahmacārī</s>, a <s>vānaprastha</s>, or a <s>sannyāsī</s>,

children.text: śūdra vaiśya kṣatra vipra-gaṇera prabhede // HNC_4.24 //
children.translated_text: whether a <s>śūdra</s>, <s>vaiśya</s>, <s>kṣatriya</s>, or <s>brāhmaṇa</s> — // HNC_4.24 //

children.text: sādhutva kakhana nāhi ha-ibe nirṇīta /
children.translated_text: saintliness is never determined by such distinctions;

children.text: kṛṣṇaika-śaraṇa sādhu śāstrera vihita // HNC_4.25 //
children.translated_text: the scriptures ordain that a <s>sādhu</s> is one who is solely surrendered to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // HNC_4.25 //

body.translated_text: Characteristics of a householder <s>sādhu</s> (saint)

children.text: raghunātha-dāse lakṣye kariyā sevāra /
children.translated_text: Looking upon <s>Raghunātha Dāsa</s> as the example, regarding service,

children.text: gṛhi-sādhu-jane śikhāyecha ei sāra // HNC_4.26 //
children.translated_text: You taught this essential instruction to householder saints. // HNC_4.26 //

children.text: sthira haye ghare yāo nā hao bātula /
children.translated_text: "Remain steadfast at home, do not become restless;

children.text: krame krame pāya loka bhava-sindhu-kula // HNC_4.27 //
children.translated_text: gradually one reaches the shore of the ocean of material existence. // HNC_4.27 //

children.text: markaṭa vairāgya chāḍa loka dekhāiyā /
children.translated_text: Abandon monkey renunciation displayed for show;

children.text: yathāyogya viṣaya bhuñja anāsakta hañā // HNC_4.28 //
children.translated_text: enjoy sense objects appropriately, remaining detached. // HNC_4.28 //

children.text: antare niṣṭhā kara bāhye loka vyavahāra /
children.translated_text: Internally maintain firm devotion, externally behave according to worldly convention;

children.text: acire śrī-kṛṣṇa tomāya karibe uddhāra // HNC_4.29 //
children.translated_text: very soon <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s> will deliver you." // HNC_4.29 //

body.translated_text: Characteristics of a <s>sādhu</s> who has renounced household life

children.text: punaḥ tumi tāra dekhi vairāgya grahaṇa /
children.translated_text: Then, seeing his acceptance of renunciation,

children.text: ei mata śikṣā dile apūrva śravaṇa // HNC_4.30 //
children.translated_text: You gave this unprecedented instruction. // HNC_4.30 //

children.text: grāmya-kathā nā śunibe grāmya-vārtā nā kahibe /
children.translated_text: "Do not listen to mundane talk, do not speak of mundane affairs;

children.text: bhāla nā khāibe āra bhāla nā paribe // HNC_4.31 //
children.translated_text: do not eat sumptuously, and do not dress lavishly. // HNC_4.31 //

children.text: amānī mānada hañā kṛṣṇa-nāma sadā labe /
children.translated_text: Being free from desire for honor and offering respect to all, always chant <s>Kṛṣṇa-nāma</s>;

children.text: vraje rādhā-kṛṣṇa-sevā mānase karibe // HNC_4.32 //
children.translated_text: in the mind, serve <s>Rādhā</s> and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> in <s>Vraja</s>." // HNC_4.32 //

body.text: gṛhī o gṛha-tyāgī - ubhayera-i svarūpa lakṣaṇa
body.translated_text: For both the householder and the renunciant, the <s>svarūpa-lakṣaṇa</s> (intrinsic characteristic) is the same.

children.text: svarūpa lakṣaṇa eka sarvatra samāna /
children.translated_text: The <s>svarūpa-lakṣaṇa</s> (intrinsic characteristic) is the same everywhere;

children.text: āśramādi bhede pṛthak taṭastha vidhāna // HNC_4.33 //
children.translated_text: the <s>taṭastha</s> (marginal) regulations differ according to the stage of life (<s>āśrama</s>). // HNC_4.33 //

children.text: ananya-śaraṇe yadi dekhi durācāra /
children.translated_text: If one who is exclusively surrendered is seen to have bad conduct,

children.text: tathāpi se sādhu bali sevya sabākāra // HNC_4.34 //
children.translated_text: still he is to be regarded as a <s>sādhu</s> and worthy of service by all. // HNC_4.34 //

children.text: ei ta śrī-kṛṣṇa-vākya gītā-bhāgavate /
children.translated_text: This is the declaration of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s> Himself in the <s>Gītā</s> and the <s>Bhāgavata</s>;

children.text: ihāke pūjiba yatne sadā sarva mate // HNC_4.35 //
children.translated_text: one should always honor this principle with great care and in every way. // HNC_4.35 //

children.text: ihāte āche ta eka nigūḍha siddhānta /
children.translated_text: In this there is a confidential conclusion;

children.text: kṛpā kari jānāyecha tāi pāi anta // HNC_4.36 //
children.translated_text: by Your mercy You have revealed it, and thus I can understand its purport. // HNC_4.36 //

body.text: pūrva-pāpera gandhāvaśeṣa o pūrva-pāpa lakṣya kariyā yini kṛṣṇaika-śaraṇa sādhura nindā karena, tini nāmāparādhī
body.translated_text: One who criticizes a <s>sādhu</s> exclusively surrendered to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> by pointing to the lingering traces of past sins, past faults, nearly eradicated faults, or occasional faults — that person is a <s>nāmāparādhī</s> (offender against the Holy Name).

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāme ruci yabe ha-ibe udaya /
children.translated_text: When taste for <s>Kṛṣṇa-nāma</s> arises,

children.text: eka nāme pūrva pāpa ha-ibeka kṣaya // HNC_4.37 //
children.translated_text: a single utterance of the <s>Nāma</s> destroys all past sins. // HNC_4.37 //

children.text: pūrva-pāpa gandha tabu thāke kichu dina /
children.translated_text: Yet a trace of past sins may linger for some days;

children.text: nāmera prabhāve krama hañā paḍe kṣīṇa // HNC_4.38 //
children.translated_text: by the power of the <s>Nāma</s>, it gradually diminishes. // HNC_4.38 //

children.text: śīghra sei pāpa-gandha vidūrita haya /
children.translated_text: Quickly that trace of sin is removed,

children.text: parama dharmātmā bali haya paricaya // HNC_4.39 //
children.translated_text: and one becomes known as supremely righteous. // HNC_4.39 //

children.text: ye kayeka dina sei gandha nāhi yāya /
children.translated_text: During the few days when that trace has not yet departed,

children.text: sādhāraṇa jana cakṣe pāpa bali bhāya // HNC_4.40 //
children.translated_text: ordinary people, seeing it, fear it to be sin. // HNC_4.40 //

children.text: se pāpa dekhiyā yei sādhu-nindā kare /
children.translated_text: One who, seeing that residual sin, criticizes the <s>sādhu</s>,

children.text: pūrva-pāpa lakṣi punaḥ avajñā ācare // HNC_4.41 //
children.translated_text: or who, pointing to past sins, shows contempt — // HNC_4.41 //

children.text: sei ta pāṣaṇḍī vaiṣṇavera nindā doṣe /
children.translated_text: that person is indeed a <s>pāṣaṇḍī</s> (heretic); by the offense of blaspheming a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>,

children.text: nāma aparādha maji paḍe kṛṣṇa-roṣe // HNC_4.42 //
children.translated_text: he sinks into <s>nāma-aparādha</s> (offense against the Holy Name) and incurs the wrath of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // HNC_4.42 //

body.text: kṛṣṇaika-śaraṇatāi sādhu lakṣaṇa āpanāke sādhu baliyā paricaya deoyā dāmbhikatā
body.translated_text: Exclusive surrender to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is the characteristic of a <s>sādhu</s>; to introduce oneself as a <s>sādhu</s> is hypocrisy.

children.text: kṛṣṇaika-śaraṇa mātra kṛṣṇa-nāma gāya /
children.translated_text: One who is exclusively surrendered to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> simply chants <s>Kṛṣṇa-nāma</s>;

children.text: sādhu-nāme paricita kṛṣṇera kṛpāya // HNC_4.43 //
children.translated_text: by the mercy of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, he becomes known by the name of <s>sādhu</s>. // HNC_4.43 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa-bhakta vyatīta nāhika sādhu āra /
children.translated_text: Apart from a devotee of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, there is no other <s>sādhu</s>;

children.text: āmi sādhu bali haya dambha avatāra // HNC_4.44 //
children.translated_text: to say "I am a <s>sādhu</s>" is the very incarnation of pride. // HNC_4.44 //

body.translated_text: Determination of a <s>sādhu</s> in brief words

children.text: se balibe-āmi dīna kṛṣṇaika-śaraṇa /
children.translated_text: He should say, "I am lowly, solely surrendered to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāma yāra mukhe sādhu sei jana // HNC_4.45 //
children.translated_text: one from whose mouth <s>Kṛṣṇa-nāma</s> flows — that person is a <s>sādhu</s>." // HNC_4.45 //

children.text: tṛṇa haite hīna bali āpanāke jāne /
children.translated_text: He considers himself lower than a blade of grass;

children.text: sahiṣṇu tarura nyāya āpanāke māne // HNC_4.46 //
children.translated_text: he regards himself as tolerant as a tree, following that principle. // HNC_4.46 //

children.text: nije ta amānī āra sakale mānada /
children.translated_text: He himself is free from desire for honor, and he offers respect to everyone;

children.text: tāra mukhe kṛṣṇa-nāma kṛṣṇa-rati-prada // HNC_4.47 //
children.translated_text: from the mouth of such a one, <s>Kṛṣṇa-nāma</s> bestows attachment to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // HNC_4.47 //

body.translated_text: The <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> alone is a <s>sādhu</s> — regarding offenses against the <s>Nāma</s>; in his body resides the potency of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>.

children.text: hena sādhu-mukhe yabe śuni eka nāma /
children.translated_text: When one hears even a single <s>Nāma</s> (Holy Name) from the mouth of such a <s>sādhu</s>,

children.text: vaiṣṇava baliyā tāre kariba praṇāma // HNC_4.48 //
children.translated_text: one should offer obeisance to him, recognizing him as a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>. // HNC_4.48 //

children.text: vaiṣṇava se jagad-guru jagatera bandhu /
children.translated_text: The <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> is the <s>jagad-guru</s> (universal teacher), the friend of the entire world;

children.text: vaiṣṇava sakala jīve sadā kṛpā sindhu // HNC_4.49 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> is always an ocean of mercy to all living beings. // HNC_4.49 //

children.text: e hena vaiṣṇava-nindā yei jana kare /
children.translated_text: One who criticizes such a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>

children.text: narake paḍibe se janma-janmāntare // HNC_4.50 //
children.translated_text: will fall into hell birth after birth. // HNC_4.50 //

children.text: bhakti labhibāre āra nāhika upāya /
children.translated_text: There is no other means to attain <s>bhakti</s> (devotion);

children.text: bhakti labhe sarva-jīva vaiṣṇava kṛpāya // HNC_4.51 //
children.translated_text: all living beings attain <s>bhakti</s> by the mercy of a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>. // HNC_4.51 //

children.text: vaiṣṇava dehete thāke śrī-kṛṣṇera śakti /
children.translated_text: In the body of a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> resides the potency of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: sei deha sparśe anye haya kṛṣṇa-bhakti // HNC_4.52 //
children.translated_text: by touching that body, others attain <s>Kṛṣṇa-bhakti</s> (devotion to Kṛṣṇa). // HNC_4.52 //

children.text: vaiṣṇava adharāmṛta āra pada jala /
children.translated_text: The nectar from the lips of a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>, the water that has washed his feet,

children.text: vaiṣṇavera pada-rajaḥ tina mahā-bala // HNC_4.53 //
children.translated_text: and the dust of a <s>Vaiṣṇava's</s> feet — these three are supremely powerful. // HNC_4.53 //

body.translated_text: The transmission of potency from a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>

children.text: vaiṣṇava-nikaṭe yadi baise kata-lakṣaṇa /
children.translated_text: When one sits near a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> with certain qualifications,

children.text: deha haite haya kṛṣṇa-śakti niḥsaraṇa // HNC_4.54 //
children.translated_text: the potency of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> emanates from his body. // HNC_4.54 //

children.text: sei śakti śraddhāvān hṛdaye paśiyā /
children.translated_text: That potency enters the heart of the faithful person,

children.text: bhaktira udaya kare deha kāṅpāiyā // HNC_4.55 //
children.translated_text: causing devotion to arise, making the body tremble. // HNC_4.55 //

children.text: ye basila vaiṣṇavera nikaṭe śraddhāya /
children.translated_text: One who sits near a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> with faith —

children.text: tāhāra hṛdaye bhakti ha-ibe udaya // HNC_4.56 //
children.translated_text: in his heart, <s>bhakti</s> (devotion) will arise. // HNC_4.56 //

children.text: prathame āsibe tāra mukhe kṛṣṇa-nāma /
children.translated_text: First, <s>Kṛṣṇa-nāma</s> will come to his mouth;

children.text: nāmera prabhāve pābe sarva-guṇa-grāma // HNC_4.57 //
children.translated_text: by the power of the <s>Nāma</s>, he will attain all virtuous qualities. // HNC_4.57 //

body.text: vaiṣṇavera ki ki doṣa dharile vaiṣṇava-nindā haya-jāti-doṣa pūrva-doṣa naṣṭa-prāya avaśiṣṭa doṣa kādācitka doṣa
body.translated_text: What faults, if attributed to a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>, constitute <s>Vaiṣṇava-nindā</s> (criticism of a Vaiṣṇava): faults of birth, past faults, nearly eradicated faults, and occasional faults.

children.text: vaiṣṇavera jāti āra pūrva doṣa dhare /
children.translated_text: One who holds onto a <s>Vaiṣṇava's</s> caste origin or past faults,

children.text: kādācitka doṣa dekhi yei nindā kare // HNC_4.58 //
children.translated_text: or who, seeing occasional faults, criticizes him — // HNC_4.58 //

children.text: naṣṭa-prāya doṣa laye kare apamāna /
children.translated_text: one who insults a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> by seizing upon nearly eradicated faults —

children.text: yama-daṇḍe kaṣṭa pāya se saba ajñāna // HNC_4.59 //
children.translated_text: all such ignorant persons will suffer the punishment of <s>Yama</s> (the lord of death). // HNC_4.59 //

children.text: vaiṣṇavera mukhe nāma-māhātmya-pracāra /
children.translated_text: The <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> propagates the glories of the <s>Nāma</s> from his mouth;

children.text: se vaiṣṇava-nindā kṛṣṇa nāhi sahe āra // HNC_4.60 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> can no longer tolerate the criticism of such a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>. // HNC_4.60 //

children.text: dharma yoga yāga jñāna-kāṇḍa parihari /
children.translated_text: Abandoning <s>dharma</s> (religious duties), <s>yoga</s>, <s>yāga</s> (sacrifice), and <s>jñāna-kāṇḍa</s> (the path of speculative knowledge),

children.text: ye bhajila kṛṣṇa-nāma sei sarvopari // HNC_4.61 //
children.translated_text: one who worships <s>Kṛṣṇa-nāma</s> is supreme above all. // HNC_4.61 //

body.text: anya deva śāstra nindādi-śūnya nāmāśrayī sādhu
body.translated_text: A <s>sādhu</s> who has taken shelter of the <s>Nāma</s>, free from criticism of other gods and other scriptures.

children.text: anyadera anya-śāstra nā kari nindana /
children.translated_text: A pure <s>sādhu</s> does not criticize other deities or other scriptures;

children.text: nāmera āśraya laya śuddha sādhu-jana // HNC_4.62 //
children.translated_text: he takes shelter of the <s>Nāma</s> (Holy Name). // HNC_4.62 //

children.text: se sādhu gṛhastha ha-u athavā sannyāsī /
children.translated_text: Whether that <s>sādhu</s> be a householder or a <s>sannyāsī</s> (renunciant),

children.text: tāhāra caraṇa-reṇu pāite prayāsī // HNC_4.63 //
children.translated_text: one should endeavor to obtain the dust of his feet. // HNC_4.63 //

children.text: yāba yata nāme rati se tata vaiṣṇava /
children.translated_text: The greater one's attachment to the <s>Nāma</s>, the greater a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> one is;

children.text: vaiṣṇavera krama ei mate anubhava // HNC_4.64 //
children.translated_text: this is the gradation of <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>, to be understood in this way. // HNC_4.64 //

children.text: ithe varṇāśrama dhana pāṇḍitya yauvana /
children.translated_text: Here, <s>varṇāśrama</s> (social order), wealth, learning, and youth —

children.text: kona kārya nāhi kare rūpa bala jana // HNC_4.65 //
children.translated_text: are of no use whatsoever; beauty, strength, and birth count for nothing. // HNC 4.65 //

children.text: ataeva yini karilena nāmāśraya /
children.translated_text: Therefore, one who has taken shelter of the <s>Nāma</s> (Holy Name)

children.text: sādhu-nindā chāḍibena e dharma niścaya // HNC_4.66 //
children.translated_text: will abandon criticism of saints — this is the certain principle. // HNC 4.66 //

children.text: nāmāśrayā śuddhā bhakti bhakta bhakti-rūpā /
children.translated_text: Pure devotion that takes shelter of the <s>Nāma</s> has the form of devotee-and-devotion;

children.text: bhakta bhakti-vivarjitā ha-ile virūpā // HNC_4.67 //
children.translated_text: when devoid of devotee-and-devotion, it becomes deformed. // HNC 4.67 //

children.text: yāṅhā sādhu-nindā tāṅhā nāhi bhakti sthiti /
children.translated_text: Where there is criticism of saints, there devotion cannot remain;

children.text: ataeva aparādhe tathā pariṇati // HNC_4.68 //
children.translated_text: therefore, through offense it undergoes such transformation. // HNC 4.68 //

children.text: sādhu-nindā chāḍi bhakta sādhu-bhakti kare /
children.translated_text: Abandoning criticism of saints, the devotee performs service to saints,

children.text: sādhu-saṅga sādhu-sevā ei dharmācare // HNC_4.69 //
children.translated_text: association with saints and service to saints — this is the practice of <s>dharma</s>. // HNC 4.69 //

body.translated_text: Bad association is of two kinds; among them, association with women-seekers,

children.text: asat-saṅga-tyāge haya vaiṣṇava-ācāra /
children.translated_text: abandoning bad association is the conduct of a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>;

children.text: asat-saṅge haya sādhu-avajñā apāra // HNC_4.70 //
children.translated_text: through bad association, immeasurable disregard for saints arises. // HNC 4.70 //

children.text: asat ye dvi-prakāra sarva-śāstre kaya /
children.translated_text: The impious (<s>asat</s>) are of two kinds, all scriptures say;

children.text: sei duiyera madhye yoṣit-saṅgī eka haya // HNC_4.71 //
children.translated_text: among those two, one kind is the associate of women (<s>yoṣit-saṅgī</s>). // HNC 4.71 //

children.text: yoṣit-saṅgi-saṅgī punaḥ tāra madhye gaṇya /
children.translated_text: The associate of such a women-seeker is also counted among them;

children.text: tāra saṅga-tyāge jīva ha-ibeka dhanya // HNC_4.72 //
children.translated_text: by abandoning their association, a soul becomes blessed. // HNC 4.72 //

body.translated_text: Who is called a women-seeker (<s>yoṣit-saṅgī</s>)?

children.text: kṛṣṇere saṃsāre ye dāmpatya dharma thāke /
children.translated_text: The conjugal relationship that exists in worldly life in relation to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> —

children.text: asat baliyā śāstra nā bale tāhāke // HNC_4.73 //
children.translated_text: the scripture does not call that impious (<s>asat</s>). // HNC 4.73 //

children.text: adharma saṃyoge āra straiṇa bhāve rata /
children.translated_text: One who is attached to unlawful unions and to a womanizing disposition —

children.text: yoṣit-saṅgī jana duṣṭa śāstrera sammata // HNC_4.74 //
children.translated_text: such a women-seeking person is wicked, according to scripture. // HNC 4.74 //

body.text: dvitīya prakāra asat (kṛṣṇete abhakta) tina prakāra
body.translated_text: The second type of impious person (the non-devotee of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>) is of three kinds:

children.text: kṛṣṇete abhakta - asat dvitīya prakāra /
children.translated_text: the non-devotee of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> — this is the second type of impious person;

children.text: māyāvādī dharma-dhvajī nirīśvara āra // HNC_4.75 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Māyāvādī</s> (impersonalist), the religious hypocrite (<s>dharma-dhvajī</s>), and the atheist (<s>nirīśvara</s>). // HNC 4.75 //

body.text: yini balena, ei saba lokera nindāke-o sādhu-nindā bale tini-o varjya
body.translated_text: One who says that criticizing even such people constitutes criticism of saints — he too is to be rejected:

children.text: varjile e saba saṅga sādhu-nindā naya /
children.translated_text: If one avoids all such association, it is not criticism of saints;

children.text: ihāke ye nindā bale sei varjya haya // HNC_4.76 //
children.translated_text: whoever calls this criticism — he himself is to be rejected. // HNC 4.76 //

children.text: ei saba saṅga chāḍi ananya-śaraṇa /
children.translated_text: Abandoning all such association, taking exclusive shelter,

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāma kari pāya kṛṣṇa-prema-dhana // HNC_4.77 //
children.translated_text: chanting <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s <s>Nāma</s>, one obtains the treasure of love for <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // HNC 4.77 //

body.text: vaiṣṇavābhāsa, prākṛta-vaiṣṇava, vaiṣṇava-prāya o kaniṣṭha-vaiṣṇava-ei sakala eka-i kathā
body.translated_text: <s>Vaiṣṇavābhāsa</s> (semblance of a Vaiṣṇava), <s>prākṛta-Vaiṣṇava</s> (materialistic Vaiṣṇava), <s>Vaiṣṇava-prāya</s> (Vaiṣṇava-like), and <s>kaniṣṭha-Vaiṣṇava</s> (neophyte Vaiṣṇava) — all these are the same topic:

children.text: sādhu-sevā-hīna arce laukika śraddhāya /
children.translated_text: One who worships the Deity without service to saints, with worldly faith,

children.text: prākṛta vaiṣṇava haya vaiṣṇavera prāya // HNC_4.78 //
children.translated_text: is a materialistic <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> (<s>prākṛta-Vaiṣṇava</s>), resembling a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>. // HNC 4.78 //

children.text: vaiṣṇava-ābhāsa sei nahe ta' vaiṣṇava /
children.translated_text: That <s>Vaiṣṇavābhāsa</s> (semblance of a Vaiṣṇava) is not truly a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>;

children.text: kemane pāibe sādhu-saṅgera vaiṣṇava // HNC_4.79 //
children.translated_text: how will one who lacks association with saints attain the status of a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>? // HNC 4.79 //

children.text: ataeva kaniṣṭha madhyete tāre gaṇi /
children.translated_text: Therefore, we count such a person among the <s>kaniṣṭha</s> (neophyte) devotees;

children.text: tāre kṛpā karibena vaiṣṇava āpani // HNC_4.80 //
children.translated_text: the true <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> will show mercy to him. // HNC 4.80 //

body.translated_text: The <s>madhyama-Vaiṣṇava</s> (intermediate devotee):

children.text: kṛṣṇa-prema kṛṣṇa-bhakte maitrī ācaraṇa /
children.translated_text: Love for <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, friendship with <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s devotees,

children.text: bāliśete kṛpā āra dveṣī upekṣaṇa // HNC_4.81 //
children.translated_text: mercy to the ignorant, and disregard for the envious. // HNC 4.81 //

children.text: karile madhyama bhakta śuddha bhakta hana /
children.translated_text: By practicing thus, the intermediate devotee becomes a pure devotee

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāmne adhikāra karena arjana // HNC_4.82 //
children.translated_text: and earns eligibility for <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s <s>Nāma</s>. // HNC 4.82 //

body.translated_text: The <s>uttama-Vaiṣṇava</s> (topmost devotee):

children.text: sarvatra yāṅhāra haya kṛṣṇa-daraśana /
children.translated_text: One who sees <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> everywhere,

children.text: kṛṣṇe sakalera sthiti kṛṣṇa prāṇa dhana // HNC_4.83 //
children.translated_text: for whom everything rests in <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is life and treasure — // HNC 4.83 //

children.text: vaiṣṇavāvaiṣṇava-bheda nāhi thāke tāṅra /
children.translated_text: for such a person, the distinction between <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> and non-<s>Vaiṣṇava</s> does not exist;

children.text: vaiṣṇava uttama tini kṛṣṇa-nāma-sāra // HNC_4.84 //
children.translated_text: that topmost <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> embodies the essence of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s <s>Nāma</s>. // HNC 4.84 //

body.translated_text: The <s>madhyama-Vaiṣṇava</s> alone performs service to saints:

children.text: ataeva madhyama vaiṣṇava mahāśaya /
children.translated_text: Therefore, the great-souled <s>madhyama-Vaiṣṇava</s>

children.text: sādhu sevā rata sadā thākena niścaya // HNC_4.85 //
children.translated_text: is always certainly devoted to the service of saints. // HNC 4.85 //

body.translated_text: The <s>prākṛta-Vaiṣṇava</s> is eligible for <s>nāmābhāsa</s> (shadow of the Name):

children.text: prākṛta vaiṣṇava yei vaiṣṇavera prāya /
children.translated_text: The materialistic <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>, who merely resembles a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>,

children.text: nāmābhāse adhikārī sarva-śāstra pāya // HNC_4.86 //
children.translated_text: is eligible for <s>nāmābhāsa</s>, as all scriptures declare. // HNC 4.86 //

body.text: madhyama vaiṣṇava nāmādhikārī o nāmāparādha vicāra karibena
body.translated_text: The <s>madhyama-Vaiṣṇava</s> is eligible for the <s>Nāma</s> and will consider offenses against the Name:

children.text: madhyama vaiṣṇava mātra nāme adhikārī /
children.translated_text: Only the <s>madhyama-Vaiṣṇava</s> has eligibility for the <s>Nāma</s>;

children.text: śrī-nāma-bhajane aparādhera vicārī // HNC_4.87 //
children.translated_text: in the practice of worshiping the Holy Name, he examines offenses (<s>aparādha</s>). // HNC 4.87 //

children.text: uttama vaiṣṇave aparādha asambhava /
children.translated_text: For the <s>uttama-Vaiṣṇava</s>, offenses are impossible,

children.text: sarvatra dekhena tini kṛṣṇera vaibhava // HNC_4.88 //
children.translated_text: for he sees the glory of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> everywhere. // HNC 4.88 //

children.text: nija nija adhikāra kariyā vicāra /
children.translated_text: Considering one's own respective eligibility,

children.text: sādhu-nindā aparādha kari parihāra // HNC_4.89 //
children.translated_text: one should remedy the offense of criticizing saints. // HNC 4.89 //

children.text: sādhu saṅga sādhu sevā nāma saṅkīrtana /
children.translated_text: Association with saints, service to saints, chanting of the <s>Nāma</s> (<s>saṅkīrtana</s>),

children.text: sarva jīve dayā ei bhakta ācaraṇa // HNC_4.90 //
children.translated_text: and compassion to all living beings — this is the conduct of a devotee. // HNC 4.90 //

body.text: sādhu nindā ghaṭile ki karā kartavya ?
body.translated_text: If criticism of a saint occurs, what should one do?

children.text: pramāde yadyapi ghaṭe sādhu-vigarhaṇa /
children.translated_text: If by mistake criticism of a saint occurs,

children.text: tabe anutāpe dhari se sādhu-caraṇa // HNC_4.91 //
children.translated_text: then with remorse, one should grasp the feet of that saint. // HNC 4.91 //

children.text: kāṅdiyā baliba prabho kṣami aparādha /
children.translated_text: Weeping, one should say: 'O Lord, please forgive this offense;

children.text: e duṣṭa-nindake kara vaiṣṇava-prasāda // HNC_4.92 //
children.translated_text: bestow <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> grace upon this wicked critic.' // HNC 4.92 //

children.text: sādhu baḍa dayāmaya tabe ārdra-mane /
children.translated_text: The saint, being very merciful, with a softened heart,

children.text: kṣamibena aparādha kṛpā āliṅgane // HNC_4.93 //
children.translated_text: will forgive the offense with a merciful embrace. // HNC 4.93 //

children.text: ei ta prathama aparādhera vicāra /
children.translated_text: This is the discussion of the first offense;

children.text: śrī-caraṇe nivedinu ājñā anusāra // HNC_4.94 //
children.translated_text: I have submitted it at the holy feet, following the command. // HNC 4.94 //

children.text: hari-dāsa pāda-padme bhrara ye jana /
children.translated_text: One who is a bee at the lotus feet of <s>Haridāsa</s>,

children.text: hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi tāhāra jīvana // HNC_4.95 //
children.translated_text: for such a person, <s>Hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi</s> is life itself. // HNC 4.95 //

body.text:
iti śrī-hari-nāma-cintāmaṇau sādhu-nindāparādha-vicāro
nāma caturthaḥ paricchedaḥ /
body.translated_text:
Thus ends the discussion of the offense of criticizing saints in the <s>Śrī-Hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi</s>,
the fourth chapter.

(5)
Fifth Chapter
The offense of considering other deities as independent (<s>devāntare svātantrya-jñānāparādha</s>)

body.text:
śivasya śrī-viṣṇor ya iha guṇa-nāmādi-sakalaṃ
dhiyā bhinnaṃ paśyet sa khalu hari-nāmāhita-karaḥ
body.translated_text: One who perceives the qualities, names, and all other aspects of <s>Śiva</s> and <s>Śrī Viṣṇu</s> as different through the intellect — he indeed is a committer of offense against <s>Hari</s>'s <s>Nāma</s>.

children.text: jaya gadādhara-prāṇa jāhnavā-jīvana /
children.translated_text: Glory to the life of <s>Gadādhara</s>, the life of <s>Jāhnavī</s>!

children.text: jaya sītānātha jaya gaura bhakta-jana // HNC_5.1 //
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Sītānātha</s>, glory to <s>Gaura</s> and the devotees! // HNC 5.1 //

children.text: haridāsa bale tabe kari yoḍa-hāta /
children.translated_text: <s>Haridāsa</s> says, then folding his hands:

children.text: dvitīyāparādha ebe śuna jagannātha // HNC_5.2 //
children.translated_text: 'Now hear of the second offense, O <s>Jagannātha</s>!' // HNC 5.2 //

body.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu-tattva</s> (the truth about <s>Viṣṇu</s>):

children.text: parama advaya jñāna viṣṇu para-tattva /
children.translated_text: The supreme non-dual knowledge, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, is the highest reality (<s>para-tattva</s>),

children.text: cit-svarūpa jagadīśa sadā śuddha-sattva // HNC_5.3 //
children.translated_text: spiritual in essence, Lord of the universe, ever in pure goodness (<s>śuddha-sattva</s>). // HNC 5.3 //

children.text: goloka-vihārī kṛṣṇa se tattvera sāra /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, who sports in <s>Goloka</s>, is the essence of that reality,

children.text: catuḥ-ṣaṣṭhi guṇe alaṅkṛta rasādhāra // HNC_5.4 //
children.translated_text: adorned with sixty-four qualities, the reservoir of <s>rasa</s>. // HNC 5.4 //

children.text: ṣaṣṭhi-guṇa nārāyaṇa svarūpe prakāśa /
children.translated_text: Sixty qualities are manifest in <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>'s own form;

children.text: sei ṣaṣṭhi-guṇa viṣṇu-sāmānya-vilāsa // HNC_5.5 //
children.translated_text: those same sixty qualities are the general sport (<s>vilāsa</s>) of <s>Viṣṇu</s>. // HNC 5.5 //

children.text: puruṣāvatāre āra svāṃśa avatāre /
children.translated_text: In the <s>puruṣa-avatāras</s> and in the personal expansions (<s>svāṃśa-avatāras</s>),

children.text: sei ṣaṣṭhi-guṇa spaṣṭa kārya anusāre // HNC_5.6 //
children.translated_text: those sixty qualities are clearly manifest according to function. // HNC 5.6 //

body.text: viṣṇura vibhinnāṃśera prakāra bheda jīvera pañcāśad-guṇa
body.translated_text: The types of separated parts (<s>vibhinnāṃśa</s>) of <s>Viṣṇu</s>: the fifty qualities of the <s>jīva</s>:

children.text: viṣṇura ye vibhinnāṃśa dui ta prakāra /
children.translated_text: The separated parts of <s>Viṣṇu</s> are of two kinds;

children.text: pañcāśat guṇa jīve bindu bindu āra // HNC_5.7 //
children.translated_text: in the <s>jīva</s>, the fifty qualities exist in minute proportion. // HNC 5.7 //

body.text: giriśādi devatā vibhinnāṃśa haiyā-o sāmānya jīva nan tāṅhārā pañcāśat-guṇa-viśiṣṭa
body.translated_text: Though <s>Giriśa</s> (Śiva) and other deities are separated parts, they are not ordinary souls — they possess fifty qualities with distinction:

children.text: giriśādi deve ei guṇa pañcāśat /
children.translated_text: In <s>Giriśa</s> (Śiva) and other deities, these fifty qualities

children.text: tad-adhika parimāṇe sarvadā saṃyuta // HNC_5.8 //
children.translated_text: are always present in greater measure. // HNC 5.8 //

children.text: tad-vyatīta āra pañca guṇa aṃśa māne /
children.translated_text: Beyond those, five more qualities are present in partial measure,

children.text: prakāśita āche tabe vicitra-vidhāne // HNC_5.9 //
children.translated_text: manifested in a wondrous manner. // HNC 5.9 //

body.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s>-hood is established through sixty qualities:

children.text: sei pañca pañcāśat guṇa-pūrṇa tāya /
children.translated_text: Those five plus the fifty qualities are fully present

children.text: viṣṇute virājamāna sarva śāstre gāya // HNC_5.10 //
children.translated_text: resplendently in <s>Viṣṇu</s>, as all scriptures sing. // HNC 5.10 //

children.text: tad-vyatīta āra pañca-guṇa nārāyaṇe /
children.translated_text: Beyond those, five more qualities are in <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>;

children.text: āche tāra sattā kabhu nāhi anya jane // HNC_5.11 //
children.translated_text: their existence is never found in any other being. // HNC 5.11 //

children.text: ṣaṣṭhi-guṇe viṣṇu-tattva parama īśvara /
children.translated_text: With sixty qualities, <s>Viṣṇu-tattva</s> is the Supreme Lord;

children.text: giriśa ādi anya-deva tāṅhāra kiṅkara // HNC_5.12 //
children.translated_text: <s>Giriśa</s> (Śiva) and all other deities are His servants. // HNC 5.12 //

children.text: vibhinnāṃśa giriśādi jīva śreṣṭhatara /
children.translated_text: As separated parts (<s>vibhinnāṃśa</s>), <s>Giriśa</s> and others are the best among souls,

children.text: viṣṇu sarva-jīveśvara sarva-deveśvara // HNC_5.13 //
children.translated_text: but <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the Lord of all souls and the Lord of all deities. // HNC 5.13 //

body.text: ajñāna-vyakti anya devatāra sahita viṣṇuke samāna mane kare
body.translated_text: An ignorant person considers <s>Viṣṇu</s> equal to other deities:

children.text: anya-deva saha sama viṣṇuke ye māne /
children.translated_text: One who considers <s>Viṣṇu</s> equal to other deities

children.text: se baḍa ajñāna īśa-tattva nāhi jāne // HNC_5.14 //
children.translated_text: is greatly ignorant and does not know the truth of the Lord. // HNC 5.14 //

children.text: e jaḍa jagate viṣṇu parama īśvara /
children.translated_text: In this material world, <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the Supreme Lord;

children.text: giriśādi yata deva tāṅra vidhikara // HNC_5.15 //
children.translated_text: <s>Giriśa</s> (Śiva) and all other deities are His functionaries. // HNC 5.15 //

children.text: keha bale māyāra tri-guṇe tridiveśa /
children.translated_text: Some say that through the three <s>guṇas</s> of <s>Māyā</s>, the lords of the three realms

children.text: sarvadā samāna brahma tattva saviśeṣa // HNC_5.16 //
children.translated_text: are always equal — <s>Brahman</s> as a qualified reality. // HNC 5.16 //

body.translated_text: The conclusions of various arguments:

children.text: śāstrera siddhānte tabu pūjya nārāyaṇa /
children.translated_text: According to scriptural conclusion, <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> is still worthy of worship;

children.text: brahmā śiva sṛṣṭi-laya kāryera kāraṇa // HNC_5.17 //
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> and <s>Śiva</s> are causes of the functions of creation and dissolution. // HNC 5.17 //

children.text: vāsudeva chāḍi yei anya-deve bhaje /
children.translated_text: One who abandons <s>Vāsudeva</s> and worships other deities

children.text: īśvara chāḍiyā sei saṃsārete maje // HNC_5.18 //
children.translated_text: abandons the Lord and drowns in material existence. // HNC 5.18 //

children.text: keha bale, ṣ viṣṇu para-tattva baṭe jāni /
children.translated_text: Some say: 'We know that <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the highest reality indeed;

children.text: sarva-viṣṇumaya viśva veda-vākya māni // HNC_5.19 //
children.translated_text: the entire universe is pervaded by <s>Viṣṇu</s> — we accept the Vedic statement.' // HNC 5.19 //

children.text: ataeva sarva-deve viṣṇu adhiṣṭhāna /
children.translated_text: 'Therefore, <s>Viṣṇu</s> presides over all deities;

children.text: sarva devārcane haya viṣṇura samāna // HNC_5.20 //
children.translated_text: worshiping all deities is equal to worshiping <s>Viṣṇu</s>.' // HNC 5.20 //

children.text: ei ta niṣedha-para vākya vidhi naya /
children.translated_text: This is a prohibitory statement, not an injunctive one;

children.text: anya deva pūjāra niṣedha ei haya // HNC_5.21 //
children.translated_text: it is a prohibition against worshiping other deities. // HNC 5.21 //

children.text: sarva viṣṇu-maya viśva e kathā balile /
children.translated_text: When it is said that the entire universe is pervaded by <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: viṣṇu-pūjā kaile saba deve pūjā mile // HNC_5.22 //
children.translated_text: by worshiping <s>Viṣṇu</s>, all deities are automatically worshiped. // HNC 5.22 //

children.text: taru-mūle jala dile śākhāra ullāsa /
children.translated_text: When water is poured at the root of a tree, the branches flourish;

children.text: pallave ḍhālile jala vṛkṣera vināśa // HNC_5.23 //
children.translated_text: when water is poured on the leaves, the tree is destroyed. // HNC 5.23 //

children.text: ataeva pūji viṣṇu anya-deva tyaji /
children.translated_text: Therefore, worship <s>Viṣṇu</s> and abandon other deities;

children.text: tāhātei anyadeva kāje kāje pūji // HNC_5.24 //
children.translated_text: through that alone, other deities are served in their respective functions. // HNC 5.24 //

children.text: ei vidhi - devera sammata cira-dina /
children.translated_text: This principle has been accepted by the deities for all time;

children.text: durvipāke ei vidhi chāḍe arvācīna // HNC_5.25 //
children.translated_text: only in misfortune do modern people abandon this principle. // HNC 5.25 //

children.text: māyāvāda-doṣe jīva kali āgamane /
children.translated_text: Due to the fault of <s>Māyāvāda</s> (impersonalism), with the advent of <s>Kali</s>-yuga, souls

children.text: bahu-deva pūje viṣṇu-sāmānya-darśane // HNC_5.26 //
children.translated_text: worship many deities, seeing them as equal to <s>Viṣṇu</s>. // HNC 5.26 //

children.text: eka eka deva eka eka phala dātā /
children.translated_text: Each deity bestows a particular result;

children.text: sarva phala dātā viṣṇu sakalera pātā // HNC_5.27 //
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s> alone bestows all results and is the protector of all. // HNC 5.27 //

children.text: kāmi jana yadi tattva jānibāre pāre /
children.translated_text: If a person with material desires can understand this truth,

children.text: viṣṇu pūji phala pāya chāḍe devāntare // HNC_5.28 //
children.translated_text: by worshiping <s>Viṣṇu</s> he obtains the result and abandons other deities. // HNC 5.28 //

body.translated_text: The prescribed duties of a householder <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>:

children.text: gṛhastha ha-iyā yei viṣṇu-bhakta haya /
children.translated_text: A householder who is a devotee of <s>Viṣṇu</s>

children.text: sarva-kārye kṛṣṇa pūje chāḍiyā saṃśaya // HNC_5.29 //
children.translated_text: worships <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> in all activities, abandoning all doubt. // HNC 5.29 //

children.text: niṣekādi śmaśānānta saṃskāra yata /
children.translated_text: From the <s>saṃskāras</s> (purificatory rites) beginning with <s>niṣeka</s> (conception) to the cremation ground,

children.text: tāhāte pūjaye kṛṣṇa veda mantra mata // HNC_5.30 //
children.translated_text: in all these one worships <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> through Vedic <s>mantras</s> and injunctions. // HNC 5.30 //

children.text: viṣṇu vaiṣṇavera pūjā vedete vidhāna /
children.translated_text: The worship of <s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s> is prescribed in the <s>Vedas</s>;

children.text: deva-pitṛ-gaṇe kṛṣṇa nirmālya pradāna // HNC_5.31 //
children.translated_text: to the deities and ancestors, one offers <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s remnants (<s>nirmālya</s>). // HNC 5.31 //

children.text: māyāvādi-mate pitṛ-śrāddha yei kare /
children.translated_text: One who performs <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestral rites) for the ancestors in the manner of <s>Māyāvādīs</s>,

children.text: yevā anyadeva pūje aparādhe mare // HNC_5.32 //
children.translated_text: or worships other deities — such a person dies through offense. // HNC 5.32 //

children.text: viṣṇu-tattve dvaita-buddhi nāma aparādha /
children.translated_text: Perceiving duality in <s>Viṣṇu-tattva</s> is an offense against the <s>Nāma</s>;

children.text: sei aparādhe tāra haya bhakti bādha // HNC_5.33 //
children.translated_text: through that offense, one's devotion is obstructed. // HNC 5.33 //

children.text: śivādi devatā gaṇe pṛthak īśvara /
children.translated_text: Considering <s>Śiva</s> and other deities as independently supreme lords —

children.text: mānile nāmāparādha haya bhayaṅkara // HNC_5.34 //
children.translated_text: such an offense against the <s>Nāma</s> is fearsome indeed. // HNC 5.34 //

children.text: viṣṇu-śakti parā śakti haite deva yata /
children.translated_text: All the deities arise from the supreme energy (<s>parā śakti</s>) of <s>Viṣṇu</s>;

children.text: bhinna śakti siddha naya vedera sammata // HNC_5.35 //
children.translated_text: they are not established as a separate energy — this is the verdict of the <s>Vedas</s>. // HNC 5.35 //

children.text: śiva-brahmā-gaṇapati-sūrya-dikpāla /
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Gaṇapati</s>, <s>Sūrya</s>, and the guardians of the directions —

children.text: kṛṣṇa-śakti-balete īśvara cira-kāla // HNC_5.36 //
children.translated_text: are lords for all time by the power of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s energy. // HNC 5.36 //

children.text: ataeva pareśvara eka-mātra jāni /
children.translated_text: Therefore, know the Supreme Lord as one alone;

children.text: āra saba deve tāṅra śakti-madhye gaṇi // HNC_5.37 //
children.translated_text: count all other deities within His energy. // HNC 5.37 //

children.text: ataeva sarva-kārye karma jaḍa bhāva /
children.translated_text: Therefore, abandoning the materialistic attitude of <s>karma</s> in all activities,

children.text: chāḍiyā gṛhastha pāya bhaktira sad-bhāva // HNC_5.38 //
children.translated_text: a householder attains the true nature of devotion (<s>bhakti</s>). // HNC 5.38 //

body.text: ki rūpa vaiṣṇava gārhasthya dharma kariben
body.translated_text: What kind of <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> householder duties should one perform?

children.text: bhaktira sad-bhāve thāki sat-kriyā karaṇe /
children.translated_text: Remaining in the true nature of devotion and performing righteous deeds,

children.text: deva-pitṛ-gaṇe tuṣe nirmālya arpaṇe // HNC_5.39 //
children.translated_text: one satisfies the deities and ancestors through the offering of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s remnants. // HNC 5.39 //

children.text: bahu deva-devī pūjā karibe varjana /
children.translated_text: One should abandon the worship of many gods and goddesses;

children.text: kṛṣṇa-bhakta bali sabe karibe tarpaṇa // HNC_5.40 //
children.translated_text: regarding all as devotees of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, one should satisfy them. // HNC 5.40 //

children.text: śrī-kṛṣṇa vaiṣṇavārcane sarva phala pāya /
children.translated_text: Through the worship of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s> and <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>, one obtains all results;

children.text: nāme aparādha nahe sadā nāma gāya // HNC_5.41 //
children.translated_text: there is no offense against the <s>Nāma</s> — one always sings the <s>Nāma</s>. // HNC 5.41 //

body.translated_text: The prescribed method of livelihood for the four <s>varṇas</s>:

children.text: jagate mānava-gaṇa varṇa-dharmācari /
children.translated_text: In this world, human beings practicing <s>varṇa-dharma</s> (duties of social orders)

children.text: karibeka jīvana-yātrā dharma patha dhari // HNC_5.42 //
children.translated_text: shall conduct their livelihood following the path of <s>dharma</s>. // HNC 5.42 //

body.translated_text: The rules for the <s>antyajas</s> (outcastes):

children.text: saṅkara antyaja sabe tyaji nīca-dharma /
children.translated_text: The mixed castes (<s>saṅkaras</s>) and outcastes (<s>antyajas</s>) — all should abandon low-caste practices

children.text: śūdrācāra kare sadā saṃsārera karma // HNC_5.43 //
children.translated_text: and always perform the duties of worldly life following <s>Śūdra</s> conduct. // HNC 5.43 //

children.text: saṅkara antyaja thākibeka śūdrācāre /
children.translated_text: The mixed castes and outcastes should remain in <s>Śūdra</s> conduct;

children.text: cāturvarṇa vinā dharma nāhika saṃsāre // HNC_5.44 //
children.translated_text: there is no <s>dharma</s> in worldly life apart from the four <s>varṇas</s>. // HNC 5.44 //

body.text: varṇa-dharmera dvārā jīvana-yātrā kariyā saṃsāri vyakti bhakti-pathe bhāvārjana kariben
body.translated_text: Having conducted livelihood through <s>varṇa-dharma</s>, a worldly person should earn spiritual sentiment (<s>bhāva</s>) on the path of devotion:

children.text: cātur-varṇa varṇa-dharme karibe saṃsāra /
children.translated_text: The four <s>varṇas</s> should conduct worldly life through their respective duties;

children.text: śuddha kṛṣṇa-bhakti bale habe sadācāra // HNC_5.45 //
children.translated_text: through the power of pure <s>Kṛṣṇa-bhakti</s>, good conduct will arise. // HNC 5.45 //

children.text: cātur-varṇa yadyapi śrī-kṛṣṇa nāhi bhaje /
children.translated_text: Even if the four <s>varṇas</s> do not worship <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s> —

children.text: varṇa-dharmācāre thāki rauravete maje // HNC_5.46 //
children.translated_text: While remaining in the conduct of <s>varṇa-dharma</s> (duties of one's social order), one drowns in the hell of <s>Raurava</s>. [HNC 5.46]

children.text: varṇa vinā gṛhasthera nāhi āra dharma /
children.translated_text: For a householder, there is no other <s>dharma</s> besides <s>varṇa</s> (social duty);

children.text: varṇa dharmācāre gṛhasthera saba karma // HNC_5.47 //
children.translated_text: all the activities of a householder are in the conduct of <s>varṇa-dharma</s>. [HNC 5.47]

children.text: varṇa-dharme e saṃsāra nirvāha karibe /
children.translated_text: One should maintain this worldly existence through <s>varṇa-dharma</s>,

children.text: yāvad artha parigrahe śrī-kṛṣṇa bhajibe // HNC_5.48 //
children.translated_text: and with minimal possessions, worship <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>. [HNC 5.48]

children.text: nisargataḥ vidhi-vākya ye paryanta nara /
children.translated_text: By nature, as long as a person [follows] the scriptural injunctions,

children.text: varṇa-dharma sva-nirvāhe karibe ādara // HNC_5.49 //
children.translated_text: he should honor <s>varṇa-dharma</s> for his own sustenance. [HNC 5.49]

children.text: bhakti-yoga-nāme ei tattva-nirūpaṇa /
children.translated_text: In the name of <s>bhakti-yoga</s> (the yoga of devotion), this is the ascertainment of truth;

children.text: bhakti-yoge bhāvodaya siddhānta-vacana // HNC_5.50 //
children.translated_text: in <s>bhakti-yoga</s>, the arising of <s>bhāva</s> (spiritual emotion) is the doctrinal statement. [HNC 5.50]

children.text: bhāvodaye vidhira pravṛtti nāhi raya /
children.translated_text: When <s>bhāva</s> arises, the impulse of [scriptural] rules no longer remains;

children.text: bhāvodita kārye deha-yātrā siddha haya // HNC_5.51 //
children.translated_text: through the activities born of <s>bhāva</s>, bodily sustenance is accomplished. [HNC 5.51]

children.text: gṛhi-vaiṣṇavera ei advaya-sādhana /
children.translated_text: This is the non-dual practice of a householder <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>;

children.text: śrī-viṣṇu advaya-tattve dvaita-nivartana // HNC_5.52 //
children.translated_text: cessation of duality through the non-dual reality of <s>Śrī Viṣṇu</s>. [HNC 5.52]

body.text: nāma-nāmī o guṇa-guṇīra abhede viṣṇu-jñāna śuddha haya
body.translated_text: Through the non-difference of the Name and the Named, and of Quality and the Possessor of Quality, pure knowledge of <s>Viṣṇu</s> arises.

children.text: āra eka kathā āche dvaita-nivartane /
children.translated_text: There is another point regarding the cessation of duality:

children.text: viṣṇu-nāma viṣṇu-rūpa viṣṇu-guṇa-gaṇe // HNC_5.53 //
children.translated_text: the Name of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the Form of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the Qualities of <s>Viṣṇu</s> — [HNC 5.53]

children.text: viṣṇu haite pṛthag rūpe nā mānibe kabhu /
children.translated_text: one should never consider them as separate from <s>Viṣṇu</s>;

children.text: advaya akhaṇḍa viṣṇu cinmayatve vibhu // HNC_5.54 //
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s> is non-dual, indivisible, all-pervading in His nature of pure consciousness. [HNC 5.54]

children.text: ajñānete yadi haya dvaita upadrava /
children.translated_text: If through ignorance the disturbance of duality arises,

children.text: nāmābhāsa haya tāra prema asambhava // HNC_5.55 //
children.translated_text: only <s>nāmābhāsa</s> (a semblance of the Name) occurs; <s>prema</s> (divine love) is impossible. [HNC 5.55]

children.text: sad-guru-kṛpāya sei anartha vināśa /
children.translated_text: By the grace of a true teacher (<s>sad-guru</s>), that obstacle (<s>anartha</s>) is destroyed;

children.text: bhajite bhajite śuddha-nāmera prakāśa // HNC_5.56 //
children.translated_text: by chanting and chanting, the pure Name is manifested. [HNC 5.56]

body.translated_text: The false reasoning and offense of the <s>Māyāvādīs</s> (illusionists)

children.text: mata-vāda-jñāne dvaita haila pravartana /
children.translated_text: Through the knowledge of doctrinal debate, duality has been propagated;

children.text: aparādha haya āra nahe nivartana // HNC_5.57 //
children.translated_text: offense occurs, and there is no cessation [of it]. [HNC 5.57]

children.text: māyāvādī bale brahma haya para-tattva /
children.translated_text: The <s>Māyāvādī</s> says that <s>Brahman</s> is the supreme reality,

children.text: nirviśeṣa nirvikāra nirākāra sattva // HNC_5.58 //
children.translated_text: attributeless, changeless, formless being. [HNC 5.58]

children.text: viṣṇu-rūpa viṣṇu-nāma māyāya kalpita /
children.translated_text: The Form of <s>Viṣṇu</s> and the Name of <s>Viṣṇu</s> are fabrications of <s>Māyā</s>;

children.text: māyā antardhāne viṣṇu hana brahma-gata // HNC_5.59 //
children.translated_text: when <s>Māyā</s> disappears, <s>Viṣṇu</s> becomes merged in <s>Brahman</s>. [HNC 5.59]

children.text: e saba kutarka mātra satya śūnyavāda /
children.translated_text: All these are mere false arguments — in truth, [it is] voidism;

children.text: para-tattve sarva-śakti abhāva-pramāda // HNC_5.60 //
children.translated_text: it is the error of denying all potencies in the Supreme Reality. [HNC 5.60]

children.text: śaktimān brahma yei sei viṣṇu haya /
children.translated_text: That <s>Brahman</s> who possesses potency is <s>Viṣṇu</s>;

children.text: nāmera vivāda-mātra vedera nirṇaya // HNC_5.61 //
children.translated_text: the dispute over names alone is the conclusion of the <s>Vedas</s>. [HNC 5.61]

body.translated_text: The Relationship between <s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Brahman</s>

children.text: viṣṇu para-tattva tāṅra nirviśeṣa dharma /
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the Supreme Reality; His attributeless aspect

children.text: saviśeṣa dharma saha haya eka marma // HNC_5.62 //
children.translated_text: and His aspect with attributes are one in essence. [HNC 5.62]

children.text: viṣṇura acintya-śakti virodha-bhañjana /
children.translated_text: The inconceivable potency (<s>acintya-śakti</s>) of <s>Viṣṇu</s> resolves contradictions

children.text: anāyāse kari kare saundarya sthāpana // HNC_5.63 //
children.translated_text: and effortlessly establishes beauty. [HNC 5.63]

children.text: jīva-buddhi sahajete ati alpatara /
children.translated_text: The intelligence of the <s>jīva</s> (individual soul) is by nature very limited;

children.text: acintya-śaktira bhāva nā kare gocara // HNC_5.64 //
children.translated_text: it cannot perceive the nature of the inconceivable potency. [HNC 5.64]

children.text: nija-buddhye cāhe eka sthāpite īśvara /
children.translated_text: By one's own intellect, one wishes to establish the Lord,

children.text: khaṇḍa-jñāne pāya brahma-tattvete avara // HNC_5.65 //
children.translated_text: but through fragmentary knowledge, one arrives at an inferior [understanding of] the <s>Brahman</s> reality. [HNC 5.65]

children.text: viṣṇura parama pada chāḍi devārcita /
children.translated_text: Abandoning the supreme abode of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, worshipped by the gods,

children.text: brahme baddha haya nāhi bujhe hitāhita // HNC_5.66 //
children.translated_text: one becomes bound in [impersonal] <s>Brahman</s>, not understanding what is beneficial and what is harmful. [HNC 5.66]

children.text: cinmaya-svarūpa-jñāna ye bujhite jāne /
children.translated_text: One who is capable of understanding the knowledge of the conscious essential nature —

children.text: viṣṇu viṣṇu-nāma-guṇa eka kari māne // HNC_5.67 //
children.translated_text: he accepts <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the Name of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and the qualities [of <s>Viṣṇu</s>] as one. [HNC 5.67]

children.text: ei ta viśuddha jñāna śrī-kṛṣṇa-svarūpa /
children.translated_text: This indeed is pure knowledge — the essential form of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: sambandha buddhite labhi bhaje nāma-rūpa // HNC_5.68 //
children.translated_text: with the understanding of relationship, one obtains [it] and worships the Name-Form. [HNC 5.68]

body.text: śiva o viṣṇura ki rūpe abheda-buddhi karibe
body.translated_text: How should one cultivate non-difference between <s>Śiva</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>?

children.text: jaḍa-nāma jaḍa-rūpa-guṇe yei bheda /
children.translated_text: The difference that exists in material names, forms, and qualities —

children.text: se bheda cit-tattve nāi ei ta prabheda // HNC_5.69 //
children.translated_text: that difference does not exist in the spiritual reality; this is the distinction. [HNC 5.69]

children.text: viṣṇu-tattve bheda-jñāna anartha vikāra /
children.translated_text: The knowledge of difference in the <s>Viṣṇu</s> reality is a harmful distortion;

children.text: śivete viṣṇute bheda ati avicāra // HNC_5.70 //
children.translated_text: perceiving difference between <s>Śiva</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s> is extremely thoughtless. [HNC 5.70]

body.text: bhakta o māyāvādīra ācāra o pravṛtti bheda
body.translated_text: Difference in the conduct and inclination of a devotee and a <s>Māyāvādī</s>

children.text: nāmaika-śaraṇa yei bhakti mahājana /
children.translated_text: One who takes sole shelter of the Name — a great soul of <s>bhakti</s> —

children.text: ekeśvara kṛṣṇe bhaji chāḍe anya jana // HNC_5.71 //
children.translated_text: worships <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> alone as the one Lord, abandoning all others. [HNC 5.71]

children.text: anya-deva anya-śāstra nindā nāhi kare /
children.translated_text: He does not criticize other gods or other scriptures;

children.text: kṛṣṇa-dāsa bali anye pūje samādare // HNC_5.72 //
children.translated_text: calling others 'servants of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,' he worships them with respect. [HNC 5.72]

children.text: pratidina gṛhi-bhakta nirmālya arpaṇe /
children.translated_text: Daily, the householder devotee, through offering of <s>nirmālya</s> (remnants of worship),

children.text: deva pitṛ sarva jīve karena tarpaṇe // HNC_5.73 //
children.translated_text: performs <s>tarpaṇa</s> (oblation) to the gods, ancestors, and all living beings. [HNC 5.73]

children.text: yathā yathā anya deve karena darśana /
children.translated_text: Whenever he beholds another deity,

children.text: kṛṣṇa-dāsa bali tāṅre karena vandana // HNC_5.74 //
children.translated_text: he offers salutation, considering that [deity] a servant of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. [HNC 5.74]

children.text: māyāvādi-gaṇa yadi viṣṇu-pūjā kare /
children.translated_text: If <s>Māyāvādīs</s> perform worship of <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: prasāda nirmālya bhakta nāhi laya ḍare // HNC_5.75 //
children.translated_text: devotees should not fearfully accept the <s>prasāda</s> (consecrated offerings) or <s>nirmālya</s>. [HNC 5.75]

children.text: māyāvādī hari-nāme aparādhī haya /
children.translated_text: The <s>Māyāvādī</s> is an offender to the holy Name of <s>Hari</s>;

children.text: tāhāra pradatta pūjā hari nāhi laya // HNC_5.76 //
children.translated_text: the worship offered by him is not accepted by <s>Hari</s>. [HNC 5.76]

children.text: anya-deva-nirmālya grahaṇe aparādha /
children.translated_text: Accepting the <s>nirmālya</s> of other deities constitutes an offense;

children.text: śuddha bhakti sādhane sarvadā sādhe bādha // HNC_5.77 //
children.translated_text: in the practice of pure <s>bhakti</s>, it always creates obstruction. [HNC 5.77]

children.text: tabe yadi śuddha bhakta śrī-kṛṣṇa pūjiyā /
children.translated_text: But if a pure devotee, having worshipped <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: anya deve pūjā kare tat-prasāda diyā // HNC_5.78 //
children.translated_text: then worships other deities by giving them that <s>prasāda</s> — [HNC 5.78]

children.text: se prasāda grahaṇete nāhi aparādha /
children.translated_text: accepting that <s>prasāda</s> is not an offense;

children.text: sei rūpa devārcane nāhi bhakti-bādha // HNC_5.79 //
children.translated_text: such worship of other deities does not obstruct <s>bhakti</s>. [HNC 5.79]

children.text: śuddha-bhakta nāma aparādhī nāhi haya /
children.translated_text: A pure devotee does not become an offender to the Name;

children.text: nāma kari' prema pāya nāme deya jaya // HNC_5.80 //
children.translated_text: chanting the Name, he attains <s>prema</s> and gives glory to the Name. [HNC 5.80]

body.translated_text: The Remedy for This Offense

children.text: pramāde yadyapi haya anye viṣṇu-jñāna /
children.translated_text: If inadvertently one perceives other [deities as equal to] <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: tabe anutāpe kari viṣṇu-tattva-dhyāna // HNC_5.81 //
children.translated_text: then with remorse, one should meditate on the truth of <s>Viṣṇu</s>. [HNC 5.81]

children.text: śrī-viṣṇu smariyā kari aparādha kṣaya /
children.translated_text: Remembering <s>Śrī Viṣṇu</s>, one destroys the offense;

children.text: yatne dekhi āra nā se aparādha haya // HNC_5.82 //
children.translated_text: with care, one ensures that such an offense does not occur again. [HNC 5.82]

children.text: pūrva doṣa kṣamā śīla bhaktera bāndhava /
children.translated_text: Forgiving past faults — [such] is the nature of the friend of devotees;

children.text: dayāra sāgara kṛṣṇa kṣamāra arṇava // HNC_5.83 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is an ocean of mercy, a sea of forgiveness. [HNC 5.83]

children.text: bahu deva sevi saṅga kariba varjana /
children.translated_text: One should avoid the association of those who worship many gods;

children.text: ekeśvara vaiṣṇavera kariba pūjana // HNC_5.84 //
children.translated_text: one should worship <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s> who [worship] the one Lord. [HNC 5.84]

children.text: hari-dāsa pade bhaktivinoda ye jana /
children.translated_text: One who [places himself] at the feet of <s>Haridāsa</s> — <s>Bhaktivinoda</s> [says] —

children.text: harināma-cintāmaṇi tāhāra jīvana // HNC_5.85 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Harināma Cintāmaṇi</s> is that person's very life. [HNC 5.85]

body.text:
