iti śrī- hari-nāma-cintāmaṇau devāntare svātantrya-jñānaāparādha
nāma pañcamaḥ paricchedaḥ /
body.translated_text: Thus ends the Fifth Chapter of <s>Śrī Harināma Cintāmaṇi</s>, entitled 'The Offense of Regarding Other Deities as Independent.'
(6) Sixth Chapter: Disrespect to the <s>Guru</s>
Disrespect to the <s>Guru</s>

children.text: pañca-tattva jaya jaya śrī-rādhā-mādhava /
children.translated_text: All glories to the <s>Pañca-tattva</s>! All glories to <s>Śrī Rādhā-Mādhava</s>!

children.text: jaya navadvīpa vraja yamunā vaiṣṇava // HNC_6.1 //
children.translated_text: All glories to <s>Navadvīpa</s>, <s>Vraja</s>, <s>Yamunā</s>, and the <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>! [HNC 6.1]

children.text: hari-dāsa bale prabhu kari nivedana /
children.translated_text: <s>Haridāsa</s> says: 'O Lord, making a submission,

children.text: tṛtīyāparādha nāme ye rūpe ghaṭana // HNC_6.2 //
children.translated_text: the third offense to the Name — how it manifests — [HNC 6.2]

children.text: vistāri baliba āmi tomāri ājñāya /
children.translated_text: I shall describe elaborately, by Your command;

children.text: yei saba aparādha guru avajñāya // HNC_6.3 //
children.translated_text: all those offenses [arising from] disrespect to the <s>guru</s>. [HNC 6.3]

children.text: bahu yoni bhrami mānava-śarīra
children.translated_text: Having wandered through many births, the human body

children.text: durlabha śubhada ati /
children.translated_text: is rare and most auspicious;

children.text: tathāpi anitya pāileka yei
children.translated_text: yet it is impermanent — whoever has obtained it,

children.text: yāvat jīvane sthiti // HNC_6.4 //
children.translated_text: as long as life remains — [HNC 6.4]

children.text: parama maṅgala labhibāre tare
children.translated_text: if one does not make effort

children.text: yadi nā yatana kare /
children.translated_text: to obtain the supreme auspiciousness,

children.text: punarāya bhave anitya śarīra
children.translated_text: once again in this world, obtaining an impermanent body,

children.text: labhiyā ābāra mare // HNC_6.5 //
children.translated_text: one will die again. [HNC 6.5]

body.text:
subodha ye haya durlabha nṛ-deha
labhiyā bhava saṃsāre /
body.translated_text: It is well understood that, having obtained the rare human body in this world of <s>saṃsāra</s>,

body.text: saṃsārī jīva avaśya sad-guru āśraya karibe
body.translated_text: the soul in <s>saṃsāra</s> must certainly take shelter of a true <s>guru</s>.

children.text: kṛṣṇa ānukūlye tare // HNC_6.6 //
children.translated_text: one crosses over, favorable to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. [HNC 6.6]

body.translated_text: Taking shelter of the <s>guru</s> as the helmsman [of the boat],

children.text: śānta kṛṣṇa-bhakta lakṣaṇa ye guru
children.translated_text: A <s>guru</s> whose characteristic is being a peaceful devotee of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> —

children.text: sa-dainya vacane tāṅre /
children.translated_text: with humble words to him,

children.text: santoṣa kariyā kṛṣṇa-dīksā laya
children.translated_text: having pleased him, receiving <s>dīkṣā</s> (initiation) into <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: yāya saṃsārera pāre // HNC_6.7 //
children.translated_text: one goes beyond <s>saṃsāra</s>. [HNC 6.7]

children.text: sahaje jīvera āche kṛṣṇe mati
children.translated_text: By nature, the <s>jīva</s> has an inclination toward <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: vṛthā tarke tāhā yāya /
children.translated_text: that is lost through futile argumentation.

children.text: vitarka chāḍiyā sumati āśraye
children.translated_text: Abandoning false reasoning, taking shelter of right understanding,

children.text: guru hate mantra pāya // HNC_6.8 //
children.translated_text: one receives the <s>mantra</s> from the <s>guru</s>. [HNC 6.8]

body.text:
gṛhī jīva-gaṇa varṇāśrame thāki
sad-guru āśraya kare /
brāhmaṇādi ucca-varṇe sat-pātra thākile tini haibāra yogya
body.translated_text: Householder souls, remaining in <s>varṇāśrama</s> (the social and spiritual orders), take shelter of a true <s>guru</s>. If a worthy recipient is found among the <s>brāhmaṇas</s> and other higher <s>varṇas</s>, that person is fit to become [the <s>guru</s>].

children.text: yadi kṛṣṇa bhakti dhare // HNC_6.9 //
children.translated_text: if he possesses devotion to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. [HNC 6.9]

body.translated_text: A <s>brāhmaṇa</s> <s>ācārya</s> (teacher) is [suitable] for all <s>varṇas</s>

children.text: brāhmaṇa kulete supātra abhāve
children.translated_text: In the absence of a worthy recipient in the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> lineage,

children.text: anya kule dīkṣā pāya /
children.translated_text: one may receive <s>dīkṣā</s> from another lineage;

children.text: ucca varṇa guru gṛhīra ucita
children.translated_text: a <s>guru</s> of higher <s>varṇa</s> is appropriate for householders —

children.text: guru śiṣya parīkṣāya // HNC_6.10 //
children.translated_text: [but] the <s>guru</s> and disciple should examine each other. [HNC 6.10]

body.text: varṇa-vicāra apekṣā supātrera vicāra adhika śreyaḥ
body.translated_text: Consideration of a worthy vessel is of greater benefit than consideration of <s>varṇa</s>.

children.text: kṛṣṇa tattva vettā prakṛta ye haya
children.translated_text: One who is a genuine knower of the <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> reality —

children.text: se ha-ite pāre guru /
children.translated_text: that person can become a <s>guru</s>;

children.text: kibā vipra śūdra ki gṛhī sannyāsī
children.translated_text: whether a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, a <s>śūdra</s>, a householder, or a <s>sannyāsī</s> —

children.text: guru hana kalpa-taru // HNC_6.11 //
children.translated_text: as a <s>guru</s>, he is a wish-fulfilling tree. [HNC 6.11]

children.text: varṇera maryādā pātrera vicāre
children.translated_text: The propriety of <s>varṇa</s>, in the consideration of worthy vessels,

children.text: paramārthe laghu ati /
children.translated_text: is very minor in terms of ultimate purpose;

children.text: supātra milana prayojana sadā
children.translated_text: finding a worthy vessel is always the real purpose,

children.text: yadi cāi śuddhā rati // HNC_6.12 //
children.translated_text: if one desires pure devotion. [HNC 6.12]

children.text: supātrera prāpti mūla prayojana
children.translated_text: Obtaining a worthy vessel is the primary purpose —

children.text: pavitra suvarṇa hena /
children.translated_text: like pure gold;

children.text: tāhe ucca varṇa labhile saṃyoga
children.translated_text: if one obtains the conjunction of a higher <s>varṇa</s> with it,

children.text: sohāgā suvarṇe yena // HNC_6.13 //
children.translated_text: it is like adding borax to gold. [HNC 6.13]

body.translated_text: One who renounces household life may take shelter of a non-householder <s>guru</s>.

children.text: ye kona kāraṇe sei gṛhi dharma
children.translated_text: For whatever reason, that householder <s>dharma</s>

children.text: chāḍi anyāśrama laya /
children.translated_text: is abandoned and one takes another <s>āśrama</s> (stage of life);

children.text: tāhe paramārtha nā pāiyā śeṣe
children.translated_text: not obtaining the ultimate purpose therein, finally

children.text: sādhu guru anveṣaya // HNC_6.14 //
children.translated_text: one searches for a saintly <s>guru</s>. [HNC 6.14]

children.text: tāhāra pakṣete agṛhī ācārya
children.translated_text: For such a person, a non-householder <s>ācārya</s>

children.text: praśasta sakala mate /
children.translated_text: is praiseworthy according to all views;

children.text: tāṅra dīkṣā śikṣā pāiyā se jana
children.translated_text: receiving <s>dīkṣā</s> and <s>śikṣā</s> (instruction) from him,

children.text: bhāse nāma-rasāmṛte // HNC_6.15 //
children.translated_text: that person floats in the nectar-rasa of the Name. [HNC 6.15]

body.text: gṛhi-bhakti gṛha-tyāga karile-o pūrva-guru tyāga karite haya nā
body.translated_text: Even if a householder devotee renounces household life, one should not abandon the former <s>guru</s>.

children.text: gṛhī bhakta-jane virāga labhile
children.translated_text: If a householder devotee attains dispassion

children.text: chāḍaye saṃsāra vidhi /
children.translated_text: and abandons the regulations of worldly life,

children.text: tabu pūrva-guru caraṇa āśraya
children.translated_text: still, one should take shelter of the feet of the former <s>guru</s>

children.text: karibe jīvanāvadhi // HNC_6.16 //
children.translated_text: for one's entire lifetime. [HNC 6.16]

children.text: gṛhi jana madhye gṛhi guru śasta
children.translated_text: Among householders, a householder <s>guru</s> is recommended,

children.text: yadi śuddha bhakta hana /
children.translated_text: if he is a pure devotee;

children.text: natuvā agṛhī suyogya ha-ile
children.translated_text: otherwise, if a non-householder is well-qualified,

children.text: guru-yogya sarva-kṣaṇa // HNC_6.17 //
children.translated_text: he is fit to be <s>guru</s> at all times. [HNC 6.17]

children.text: sad-guru pāiyā bhajie bhajite
children.translated_text: Having found a true <s>guru</s>, while worshipping and worshipping,

children.text: bhāvera udaya yabe /
children.translated_text: when the arising of <s>bhāva</s> occurs,

children.text: saṃsāra virakti saṃsāra chāḍiyā
children.translated_text: with dispassion toward <s>saṃsāra</s>, leaving <s>saṃsāra</s>,

children.text: vairāgī ha-ibe tabe // HNC_6.18 //
children.translated_text: then one will become a renunciant. [HNC 6.18]

body.text: yini vairāgya āśraye la-ibena tini vairāgī guru kariben
body.translated_text: One who takes the renounced order should take a renunciant <s>guru</s>.

children.text: vairāgya āśrama grahaṇete tyāgī
children.translated_text: By accepting the renounced <s>āśrama</s>, the renunciant

children.text: puruṣa ha-ibe guru /
children.translated_text: man will become the <s>guru</s>;

children.text: tāṅhāra caraṇe śikhibe virāga
children.translated_text: at his feet one will learn dispassion —

children.text: guru śikṣā kalpa taru // HNC_6.19 //
children.translated_text: the <s>guru</s>'s instruction is a wish-fulfilling tree. [HNC 6.19]

body.text: dīkṣā o śikṣā guru ubhayake-i samāna sammāna karā āvaśyaka
body.translated_text: It is necessary to give equal respect to both the initiating <s>guru</s> and the instructing <s>guru</s>.

children.text: dīkṣā śikṣā bhede guru du' prakāra
children.translated_text: The <s>guru</s> is of two kinds by the distinction of <s>dīkṣā</s> (initiation) and <s>śikṣā</s> (instruction);

children.text: ubhaye samāna māna /
children.translated_text: equal honor should be given to both.

children.text: arpibe sujana paramārtha dhana
children.translated_text: A good person will offer the treasure of ultimate purpose

children.text: anāyāse yadi cān // HNC_6.20 //
children.translated_text: effortlessly, if one desires [it]. [HNC 6.20]

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāma mantra dena dīkṣā guru
children.translated_text: The <s>dīkṣā-guru</s> (initiating teacher) gives the <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>-Name <s>mantra</s>;

children.text: śikṣā guru tattva dātā /
children.translated_text: the <s>śikṣā-guru</s> (instructing teacher) is the giver of truth.

children.text: vaiṣṇava sakala śikṣā guru hana
children.translated_text: All <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s> serve as <s>śikṣā-gurus</s>,

children.text: sarva śubha janayitā // HNC_6.21 //
children.translated_text: the generators of all auspiciousness. [HNC 6.21]

body.text: sampradāyera ādi-gurura śikṣā avalambana kariyā ācaraṇa karibe
body.translated_text: One should practice following the instruction of the founding <s>ācārya</s> of the <s>sampradāya</s> (lineage).

children.text: sādhu sampradāye ācārya sakala
children.translated_text: In the saintly <s>sampradāya</s>, all the <s>ācāryas</s>

children.text: śikṣā guru pratiṣṭhita /
children.translated_text: are established as <s>śikṣā-gurus</s>;

children.text: ādyācārya yini guru śiromaṇi
children.translated_text: the founding <s>ācārya</s>, who is the crest-jewel of <s>gurus</s> —

children.text: pūji tāṅre yathocita // HNC_6.22 //
children.translated_text: worship him appropriately. [HNC 6.22]

children.text: tāṅra susiddhānta anugata haye
children.translated_text: Following his well-established conclusions,

children.text: nā māniba anya śikṣā /
children.translated_text: one should not accept any other teaching;

children.text: tāṅhāra ādeśa pāliba yatane
children.translated_text: one should carefully obey his instructions

children.text: nā la-iba anya dīkṣā // HNC_6.23 //
children.translated_text: and not take <s>dīkṣā</s> from another. [HNC 6.23]

body.translated_text: One should choose a <s>guru</s> within the <s>sampradāya</s>.

children.text: sampradāya guru-gaṇe śikṣā guru jāni /
children.translated_text: Know the <s>gurus</s> of the <s>sampradāya</s> as <s>śikṣā-gurus</s>;

children.text: anya-mata paṇḍitera śikṣā nāhi māni // HNC_6.24 //
children.translated_text: do not accept the instruction of a scholar of another doctrine. [HNC 6.24]

children.text: sei mate suśikṣita sādhu sucarita /
children.translated_text: One well-instructed in that tradition, saintly, of good conduct —

children.text: dīkṣā guru yogya sadā jāne supaṇḍita // HNC_6.25 //
children.translated_text: the learned always recognize such a one as fit to be a <s>dīkṣā-guru</s>. [HNC 6.25]

body.text: māyāvādīra nikaṭa kṛṣṇa-mantra la-ile paramārtha haya nā
body.translated_text: If one receives the <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>-<s>mantra</s> from a <s>Māyāvādī</s>, the ultimate purpose is not achieved.

children.text: māyāvādi-mate thāke kṛṣṇa mantra laya /
children.translated_text: If one remains in the <s>Māyāvādī</s> doctrine and receives the <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>-<s>mantra</s>,

children.text: tāra paramārtha lābha kabhu nāhi haya // HNC_6.26 //
children.translated_text: the attainment of the ultimate purpose never occurs. [HNC 6.26]

body.text: śuddha-bhakta vyatīta anyake guru karibe nā
body.translated_text: One should not make anyone other than a pure devotee one's <s>guru</s>.

children.text: ye anyāya śikhe yei śikṣā deya āra /
children.translated_text: One who learns injustice and teaches it to others —

children.text: ubhaye narake yāya nā pāya uddhāra // HNC_6.27 //
children.translated_text: both go to hell and obtain no deliverance. [HNC 6.27]

children.text: śuddha bhakti chāḍi yini śikhilena bāda /
children.translated_text: One who, abandoning pure <s>bhakti</s>, has learned [mere] argumentation —

children.text: tāṅhāra jīvana mātra vāda visaṃvāda // HNC_6.28 //
children.translated_text: that person's life is nothing but dispute and contradiction. [HNC 6.28]

children.text: se kemane guru habe uddhāribe jīve /
children.translated_text: How can such a one become a <s>guru</s> and deliver souls?

children.text: āpani asiddha anye kibā śubha dibe // HNC_6.29 //
children.translated_text: Being himself imperfect, what good can he give to others? [HNC 6.29]

children.text: ataeva śuddha bhakta ye se kene naya /
children.translated_text: Therefore, whoever a pure devotee may be,

children.text: upayukta guru haya sarva-śāste kaya // HNC_6.30 //
children.translated_text: all scriptures declare such a one to be a suitable <s>guru</s>. [HNC 6.30]

children.text: guru tattva
children.translated_text: The Truth about the <s>Guru</s>

children.text: dīkṣā guru śikṣā guru duṅhe kṛṣṇa dāsa /
children.translated_text: Both the <s>dīkṣā-guru</s> and the <s>śikṣā-guru</s> are servants of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: duṅhe vraja jana kṛṣṇa śaktira prakāśa // HNC_6.31 //
children.translated_text: both are residents of <s>Vraja</s>, manifestations of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s potency. [HNC 6.31]

children.text: guruke sāmānya jīva nā jānibe kabhu /
children.translated_text: One should never consider the <s>guru</s> as an ordinary <s>jīva</s>;

children.text: guru kṛṣṇa śakti kṛṣṇa-preṣṭha nitya prabhu // HNC_6.32 //
children.translated_text: the <s>guru</s> is <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s potency, most dear to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, an eternal master. [HNC 6.32]

children.text: ei buddhi saha sadā guru bhakti kare /
children.translated_text: With this understanding, one should always perform devotion to the <s>guru</s>;

children.text: sei guru-bhakti bale saṃsārete tare // HNC_6.33 //
children.translated_text: by the power of that <s>guru-bhakti</s>, one crosses over <s>saṃsāra</s>. [HNC 6.33]

body.translated_text: Worship of the <s>Guru</s>

children.text: agre guru pūjā pare śrī kṛṣṇa pūjana /
children.translated_text: First worship the <s>guru</s>, then worship <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: gurudeve śrī-kṛṣṇa prasāda samarpaṇa // HNC_6.34 //
children.translated_text: offer the <s>prasāda</s> of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s> to the <s>gurudeva</s>. // HNC 6.34 //

children.text: guru ājñā laye kṛṣṇa pūjibe yatane /
children.translated_text: Taking the <s>guru</s>'s command, one should worship <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> with care;

children.text: śrī guru smariyā kṛṣṇa balibe vadane // HNC_6.35 //
children.translated_text: remembering <s>Śrī Guru</s>, one should utter <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s name with the mouth. // HNC 6.35 //

body.text: gurute ki rūpe śraddhā karā ucita
body.translated_text: How One Should Have Faith in the <s>Guru</s>

children.text: gurute avajñā yāra tāra aparādha /
children.translated_text: One who shows contempt for the <s>guru</s> commits an offense (<s>aparādha</s>);

children.text: sei aparādhe tāra haya bhakti bādha // HNC_6.36 //
children.translated_text: by that offense, an obstruction arises in one's <s>bhakti</s>. // HNC 6.36 //

children.text: guru kṛṣṇa vaiṣṇavete sama bhakti kari /
children.translated_text: Maintaining equal devotion to the <s>guru</s>, <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, and the <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>,

children.text: nāmāśraye śuddha bhakta śīghra yāya tari // HNC_6.37 //
children.translated_text: the pure devotee who takes shelter of the Name quickly crosses over. // HNC 6.37 //

children.text: gurute acalā śraddhā kare yei jana /
children.translated_text: The person who has unwavering faith in the <s>guru</s>

children.text: śuddha nāma bale sei pāya prema dhana // HNC_6.38 //
children.translated_text: obtains the treasure of <s>prema</s> (divine love) by the power of the pure Name. // HNC 6.38 //

body.text: kon sthāne guru tyāga karite ha-ibe
body.translated_text: Under What Circumstances One Must Abandon the <s>Guru</s>

children.text: tabe yadi e rūpa ghaṭanā kabhu haya /
children.translated_text: If such a situation ever arises —

children.text: asat saṅge gurura yogyatā haya kṣaya // HNC_6.39 //
children.translated_text: through bad association, the <s>guru</s>'s qualification becomes diminished — // HNC 6.39 //

children.text: prathame chilena tini sad guru pradhāna /
children.translated_text: at first he was a foremost genuine <s>guru</s> (<s>sad-guru</s>),

children.text: pare nāma aparādhe hañā hata jñāna // HNC_6.40 //
children.translated_text: but later, through offenses to the Name, his knowledge was destroyed. // HNC 6.40 //

children.text: vaiṣṇave vidveṣa kari chāḍe nāma rasa /
children.translated_text: Bearing malice toward <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>, he abandons the rasa of the Name;

children.text: krame krame hana artha kāminīra vaśa // HNC_6.41 //
children.translated_text: gradually he falls under the sway of wealth and women. // HNC 6.41 //

children.text: sei guru chāḍi śiṣya śrī-kṛṣṇa-kṛpāya /
children.translated_text: Abandoning such a <s>guru</s>, the disciple, by <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>'s mercy,

children.text: sad guru labhiyā punaḥ śuddha nāma gāya // HNC_6.42 //
children.translated_text: obtains a genuine <s>guru</s> (<s>sad-guru</s>) and again sings the pure Name. // HNC 6.42 //

body.text: guru śiṣya sambandhera pūrve-I parasparera parīkṣā
body.translated_text: Mutual Examination Between <s>Guru</s> and Disciple Before Establishing the Relationship

children.text: ayogya śiṣyere guru kariben daṇḍa /
children.translated_text: The <s>guru</s> should discipline an unfit disciple;

children.text: bhajiyā ayogya guru śiṣya haya paṇḍa // HNC_6.43 //
children.translated_text: a disciple who worships an unfit <s>guru</s> becomes a fool. // HNC 6.43 //

children.text: duṅhera yogyatā yata dina sthira raya /
children.translated_text: As long as both parties' qualification remains firm,

children.text: paraspara sambandha kakhana tyajya naya // HNC_6.44 //
children.translated_text: their mutual relationship should never be abandoned. // HNC 6.44 //

body.text: śuddha guru parīkṣā kariyā varaṇa karibe
body.translated_text: One Should Examine and Then Accept a Pure <s>Guru</s>

children.text: sad gurura prati yei avajñā ācare /
children.translated_text: One who shows contempt toward a genuine <s>guru</s> (<s>sad-guru</s>)

children.text: se pāpiṣṭha aparādhī sarvatra saṃsāre // HNC_6.45 //
children.translated_text: is the most sinful offender in all of <s>saṃsāra</s>. // HNC 6.45 //

children.text: ataeva prathame viśeṣa yatna kari /
children.translated_text: Therefore, at the outset, with special care,

children.text: śuddha bhakte la-ibena guru-rūpe vari // HNC_6.46 //
children.translated_text: one should choose a pure devotee as <s>guru</s>. // HNC 6.46 //

children.text: guru tyāga kleśa yena kabhu nāhi ghaṭe /
children.translated_text: So that the distress of abandoning the <s>guru</s> never occurs —

children.text: e rūpa cintile kabhu nā paḍe saṅkaṭe // HNC_6.47 //
children.translated_text: if one thinks this way, one never falls into difficulty. // HNC 6.47 //

children.text: guru yathā bhakti-hīna śiṣya tāra prāya /
children.translated_text: Just as a <s>guru</s> devoid of <s>bhakti</s> — the disciple likewise becomes;

children.text: ataeva śuddha guru labe parīkṣāya // HNC_6.48 //
children.translated_text: therefore one should accept a pure <s>guru</s> through examination. // HNC 6.48 //

children.text: sad guru avajñā aparādha bhayaṅkara /
children.translated_text: Contempt for a genuine <s>guru</s> is a terrifying offense;

children.text: ei aparādhe naṣṭa haya deva nara // HNC_6.49 //
children.translated_text: by this offense, both <s>devas</s> and humans are ruined. // HNC 6.49 //

body.translated_text: The Procedure of Service to the <s>Guru</s> (<s>Guru-sevā</s>)

children.text: guru śayyāsana āra pādukādi yāna /
children.translated_text: The <s>guru</s>'s bed, seat, sandals, and vehicle,

children.text: pāda pīṭha snānodaka chāyāra laṅghana // HNC_6.50 //
children.translated_text: his footstool, bathing water, and shadow — one should not transgress these. // HNC 6.50 //

children.text: gurura agrete anya pūjā dvaita jñāna /
children.translated_text: Worshipping others before the <s>guru</s>, maintaining a sense of duality,

children.text: dīkṣā vyākhyā prabhutvādi karibe vandana // HNC_6.51 //
children.translated_text: giving initiation, giving instruction, or assuming lordship — these one should venerate (only in the <s>guru</s>). // HNC 6.51 //

children.text: yathā yathā gurura pāibe daraśana /
children.translated_text: Whenever one has the sight (<s>darśana</s>) of the <s>guru</s>,

children.text: daṇḍavat paḍi bhūme karibe vandana // HNC_6.52 //
children.translated_text: one should fall flat on the ground and offer obeisance. // HNC 6.52 //

children.text: guru nāma bhaktite karibe uccāraṇa /
children.translated_text: One should utter the <s>guru</s>'s name with devotion;

children.text: guru ājñā helā nā karibe kadācana // HNC_6.53 //
children.translated_text: one should never disregard the <s>guru</s>'s command. // HNC 6.53 //

children.text: gurura prasāda sevā avaśya karibe /
children.translated_text: One must serve the <s>guru</s>'s <s>prasāda</s> (remnants);

children.text: gurura apriya vākya kabhu nā kahibe // HNC_6.54 //
children.translated_text: one should never speak words displeasing to the <s>guru</s>. // HNC 6.54 //

children.text: gurura caraṇe dainye la-ibe śaraṇa /
children.translated_text: With humility one should take shelter at the <s>guru</s>'s feet;

children.text: karibe gurura sadā priya ācaraṇa // HNC_6.55 //
children.translated_text: one should always conduct oneself in a way dear to the <s>guru</s>. // HNC 6.55 //

children.text: e rūpa ācāre kṛṣṇa nāma saṅkīrtane /
children.translated_text: Through such conduct, in the <s>saṅkīrtana</s> of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name,

children.text: sarva siddhi haya prabho bale śruti gaṇe // HNC_6.56 //
children.translated_text: all perfection is attained, O Lord — so declare the <s>śrutis</s>. // HNC 6.56 //

children.text: nāma guru prati yadi avajñā ghaṭaye /
children.translated_text: If contempt for the <s>guru</s> of the Name should occur,

children.text: duṣṭa saṅge duṣṭa śāstra mata samāśraye // HNC_6.57 //
children.translated_text: through bad association and bad scriptures one takes shelter of corrupt views. // HNC 6.57 //

children.text: tabe sei saṅga sei śāstra dūra kari /
children.translated_text: Then, casting aside such association and such scriptures,

children.text: vilāpa kariba sei guru pade dhari // HNC_6.58 //
children.translated_text: one should weep, holding fast to the feet of that <s>guru</s>. // HNC 6.58 //

children.text: kṛpā kari gurudeva ha-ibe sadaya /
children.translated_text: Mercifully the <s>gurudeva</s> will become compassionate;

children.text: nāme prema dibe se vaiṣṇava dayāmaya // HNC_6.59 //
children.translated_text: that merciful <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> will bestow love through the Name. // HNC 6.59 //

children.text: hari-dāsa pada reṇu bharasā yāhāra /
children.translated_text: One whose trust is in the dust of <s>Haridāsa</s>'s feet,

children.text: nāma cintāmaṇi gāya tṛṇādhika chāra // HNC_6.60 //
children.translated_text: who is lower than straw — sings the <s>Nāma-cintāmaṇi</s>. // HNC 6.60 //

body.text:
iti śrī- hari-nāma-cintāmaṇau gurv-avajñā-vicāro
nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ paricchedaḥ /
body.translated_text:
Thus ends the Sixth Chapter in <s>Śrī Harināma-cintāmaṇi</s>,
entitled 'Deliberation on Contempt for the <s>Guru</s>'.

(7)
Seventh Chapter
Blaspheming the <s>Śruti</s>-scriptures (<s>Śruti-śāstra-nindanam</s>)

children.text: jaya jaya gadāi gaurāṅga nityānanda /
children.translated_text: Glory, glory to <s>Gadāi Gaurāṅga</s> and <s>Nityānanda</s>!

children.text: jaya sītāpati jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda // HNC_7.1 //
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Sītāpati</s>! Glory to the host of <s>Gaura</s>'s devotees! // HNC 7.1 //

children.text: haridāsa bale prabhu caturthāparādha /
children.translated_text: <s>Haridāsa</s> says: "O Lord, the fourth offense (<s>aparādha</s>) is

children.text: śruti-śāstra-vinindana bhakti-rasa-bādha // HNC_7.2 //
children.translated_text: blaspheming the <s>śruti</s>-scriptures — an obstruction to the rasa of <s>bhakti</s>. // HNC 7.2 //

body.translated_text: The <s>Āmnāya</s> (revealed tradition) Is the Sole Authority (<s>Pramāṇa</s>)

children.text: śruti-śāstra veda upaniṣat purāṇa /
children.translated_text: The <s>śruti</s>-scriptures — Vedas, <s>Upaniṣads</s>, <s>Purāṇas</s> —

children.text: kṛṣṇa-niśvasita haya sarvatra pramāṇa // HNC_7.3 //
children.translated_text: are the exhalation of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> and are the authority (<s>pramāṇa</s>) everywhere. // HNC 7.3 //

children.text: viśeṣataḥ aprākṛta-tattve jñāna yata /
children.translated_text: Especially regarding knowledge of transcendental realities (<s>aprākṛta-tattva</s>),

children.text: sakali āmnāya siddha tāhe ha-i rata // HNC_7.4 //
children.translated_text: everything is established by the <s>āmnāya</s>; one should be devoted to it. // HNC 7.4 //

children.text: jaḍātīta vastu indriyera agocara /
children.translated_text: Realities beyond matter are beyond the reach of the senses;

children.text: kṛṣṇa-kṛpā vinā tāhā nā haya gocara // HNC_7.5 //
children.translated_text: without the grace of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, they cannot come within perception. // HNC 7.5 //

children.text: karaṇāpaṭava bhrama vipralipsā āra /
children.translated_text: Imperfection of the senses (<s>karaṇāpaṭava</s>), error (<s>bhrama</s>), deception (<s>vipralipsā</s>), and

children.text: pramāda sarvatra nara jñāne doṣa ei cāra // HNC_7.6 //
children.translated_text: inattention (<s>pramāda</s>) — these are the four defects in human knowledge everywhere. // HNC 7.6 //

children.text: sei saba doṣa śūnya veda catuṣṭaya /
children.translated_text: The four Vedas are free from all these defects;

children.text: veda vinā paramārthe gati nāhi haya // HNC_7.7 //
children.translated_text: without the Vedas, there is no progress in the supreme truth (<s>paramārtha</s>). // HNC 7.7 //

children.text: māyā baddha jīve kṛṣṇa bahu kṛpā kari /
children.translated_text: To the <s>jīvas</s> bound by <s>māyā</s>, <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, showing much mercy,

children.text: veda purāṇādi dila ārṣa jñāna dhari // HNC_7.8 //
children.translated_text: gave the Vedas and <s>Purāṇas</s> bearing the knowledge of the sages (<s>ārṣa-jñāna</s>). // HNC 7.8 //

body.text: āmnāya haite daśa mūla śikṣā prameya nayaṭā
body.translated_text: The Ten Fundamental Teachings (<s>Daśa Mūla</s>) Derived from the <s>Āmnāya</s> — Nine Principles (<s>Prameya</s>) and the Methodology (<s>Nayaṭā</s>)

children.text: sei śruti śāstre jāni karma jñāna chāra /
children.translated_text: From those <s>śruti</s>-scriptures we know that <s>karma</s> and <s>jñāna</s> are worthless;

children.text: nirmala bhaktite mātra pāi sarva sāra // HNC_7.9 //
children.translated_text: only in pure devotion (<s>nirmala bhakti</s>) do we find the essence of everything. // HNC 7.9 //

children.text: māyā mūḍha jīve karma jñāne śuddha kari /
children.translated_text: Purifying the <s>jīvas</s> deluded by <s>māyā</s> through <s>karma</s> and <s>jñāna</s>,

children.text: śuddha bhakti adhikāra śikhāilā hari // HNC_7.10 //
children.translated_text: <s>Hari</s> taught the qualification for pure devotion (<s>śuddha-bhakti</s>). // HNC 7.10 //

children.text: pramāṇa se veda vākya nayaṭī prameya /
children.translated_text: The Vedic statements are the authority (<s>pramāṇa</s>); the methodology yields the object of knowledge (<s>prameya</s>);

children.text: śikhāya sambandha prayojana abhidheya // HNC_7.11 //
children.translated_text: they teach the relationship (<s>sambandha</s>), the goal (<s>prayojana</s>), and the means (<s>abhidheya</s>). // HNC 7.11 //

children.text: ei daśa mūla sāra avidyā vināśa /
children.translated_text: These ten fundamental truths destroy ignorance (<s>avidyā</s>)

children.text: kariyā jīvera kare suvidyā prakāśa // HNC_7.12 //
children.translated_text: and illuminate true knowledge (<s>suvidyā</s>) for the <s>jīva</s>. // HNC 7.12 //

body.text: 1. hari eka para tattva, 2. tini sarva śaktimān, 3. tini rasa mūrti
body.translated_text: 1. <s>Hari</s> is the one supreme reality; 2. He is possessed of all powers; 3. He is the embodiment of <s>rasa</s>

children.text: prathame śikhāya para tattva eka hari /
children.translated_text: First, the teaching is that <s>Hari</s> is the one supreme reality (<s>para-tattva</s>);

children.text: śyāma sarva-śaktimān rasa-mūrti-dhārī // HNC_7.13 //
children.translated_text: the dark-complexioned one (<s>Śyāma</s>), possessed of all powers (<s>sarva-śaktimān</s>), who bears the form of <s>rasa</s>. // HNC 7.13 //

children.text: jīvera paramānanda karena vidhāna /
children.translated_text: He ordains the supreme bliss (<s>paramānanda</s>) for the <s>jīvas</s>;

children.text: saṃvyoma dhāmete tāra nitya adhiṣṭhāna // HNC_7.14 //
children.translated_text: His eternal abode is in the spiritual sky (<s>saṃvyoma-dhāma</s>). // HNC 7.14 //

children.text: e tina prameya haya śrī-kṛṣṇa-visaye /
children.translated_text: These three truths (<s>prameyas</s>) pertain to <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: veda-śāstra śikṣā dena jīvera hṛdaye // HNC_7.15 //
children.translated_text: the Vedic scriptures impart this teaching in the hearts of the <s>jīvas</s>. // HNC 7.15 //

body.translated_text: 4. The Nature of the <s>Jīva</s> (<s>Jīva-tattva</s>)

children.text: dvitīye śikhāya vibhinnāṃśa jīva tattva /
children.translated_text: Second, the teaching is that the <s>jīvas</s> are separated parts (<s>vibhinnāṃśa</s>);

children.text: ananta saṅkhyaka cit paramāṇu sattva // HNC_7.16 //
children.translated_text: infinite in number, they are atomic particles of spiritual existence (<s>cit-paramāṇu</s>). // HNC 7.16 //

body.text: 5. nitya-baddha o 6. nitya mukta bhede jīva dui prakāra
body.translated_text: 5. Eternally bound and 6. Eternally liberated — the <s>jīva</s> is of two types

children.text: nitya baddha nitya mukta bhede jīva dvi-prakāra /
children.translated_text: The <s>jīva</s> is of two types: eternally bound (<s>nitya-baddha</s>) and eternally liberated (<s>nitya-mukta</s>);

children.text: saṃvyoma brahmāṇḍa bhari saṃsthiti tāhāra // HNC_7.17 //
children.translated_text: their abode fills the spiritual sky and the material universes. // HNC 7.17 //

body.translated_text: The Bound <s>Jīva</s>

children.text: baddha jīva māyā bhaji kṛṣṇa bahirmukha /
children.translated_text: The bound <s>jīva</s> worships <s>māyā</s> and turns away from <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: ananta brahmāṇḍe bhoga kare duḥkha sukha // HNC_7.18 //
children.translated_text: in infinite material universes, it experiences misery and happiness. // HNC 7.18 //

body.translated_text: The Liberated <s>Jīva</s>

children.text: nitya mukta kṛṣṇa bhaji kṛṣṇa pāriṣada /
children.translated_text: The eternally liberated <s>jīva</s> worships <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> and serves as His associate (<s>Kṛṣṇa-pāriṣada</s>);

children.text: para vyome bhoga kare premera sampada // HNC_7.19 //
children.translated_text: in the spiritual sky (<s>para-vyoma</s>), it enjoys the wealth of <s>prema</s> (divine love). // HNC 7.19 //

children.text: tina-ṭī prameya ei jīvera viṣaye /
children.translated_text: These three truths pertain to the <s>jīva</s>;

children.text: śruti śāstra śikṣā dena kṛṣṇa dāsī haye // HNC_7.20 //
children.translated_text: the <s>śruti</s>-scriptures, serving <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, impart this teaching. // HNC 7.20 //

body.translated_text: 7. The Relationship of Inconceivable Simultaneous Difference and Non-difference (<s>Acintya-bhedābheda</s>)

children.text: cid-vyāpāra āra yata jaḍera vyāpāra /
children.translated_text: All spiritual activities (<s>cid-vyāpāra</s>) and all material activities (<s>jaḍa-vyāpāra</s>) —

children.text: sakali acintya bhedābheda prakāra // HNC_7.21 //
children.translated_text: everything is of the nature of inconceivable difference and non-difference (<s>acintya-bhedābheda</s>). // HNC 7.21 //

children.text: jīva jaḍa sarva vastu kṛṣṇa śakti maya /
children.translated_text: The <s>jīva</s>, matter (<s>jaḍa</s>), and all things consist of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s energy (<s>śakti</s>);

children.text: avicintya bhedābheda śruti śāstre kaya // HNC_7.22 //
children.translated_text: the <s>śruti</s>-scriptures declare inconceivable difference and non-difference. // HNC 7.22 //

children.text: ei jñāne jīva jāne āmi kṛṣṇa dāsa /
children.translated_text: By this knowledge, the <s>jīva</s> understands: 'I am <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s servant;

children.text: kṛṣṇa mora nitya prabhu cit sūrya prakāśa // HNC_7.23 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is my eternal Lord, the radiance of the spiritual sun.' // HNC 7.23 //

children.text: śakti pariṇāma mātra veda śāstra bale /
children.translated_text: The Vedic scriptures declare it to be solely transformation of energy (<s>śakti-pariṇāma</s>);

children.text: vivartādi duṣṭa-mate veda ninde chale // HNC_7.24 //
children.translated_text: through the corrupt doctrine of <s>vivarta</s> (illusory appearance), the Vedas are covertly blasphemed. // HNC 7.24 //

body.translated_text: These Seven Truths Constitute Relational Knowledge (<s>Sambandha-jñāna</s>)

children.text: ei ta sambandha jñāna sāta-ṭī prameya /
children.translated_text: This relational knowledge (<s>sambandha-jñāna</s>) comprises seven truths (<s>prameyas</s>);

children.text: śruti-śāstra śikṣā dena ati upādeya // HNC_7.25 //
children.translated_text: the <s>śruti</s>-scriptures impart this most worthy teaching. // HNC 7.25 //

children.text: veda punaḥ śikṣā dena abhidheya sāra /
children.translated_text: The Vedas further teach the essence of the means (<s>abhidheya</s>):

children.text: nava vidha kṛṣṇa bhakti vidhi rāga āra // HNC_7.26 //
children.translated_text: ninefold devotion to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, both regulated (<s>vidhi</s>) and spontaneous (<s>rāga</s>). // HNC 7.26 //

body.translated_text: 8. The Means (<s>Abhidheya</s>) — Ninefold Devotion (<s>Nava-vidhā Bhakti</s>)

children.text: śravaṇa kīrtana smṛti pūjana vandana /
children.translated_text: Hearing (<s>śravaṇa</s>), chanting (<s>kīrtana</s>), remembering (<s>smṛti</s>), worship (<s>pūjana</s>), offering prayers (<s>vandana</s>),

children.text: paricaryā dāsya sakhya ātma-nivedana // HNC_7.27 //
children.translated_text: attending (<s>paricaryā</s>), servitude (<s>dāsya</s>), friendship (<s>sakhya</s>), and complete self-surrender (<s>ātma-nivedana</s>). // HNC 7.27 //

children.text: bhaktira prakāra madhye nāma sarva-sāra /
children.translated_text: Among all the forms of <s>bhakti</s>, the Name (<s>nāma</s>) is the essence of all;

children.text: praṇava-māhātmya veda karena pracāra // HNC_7.28 //
children.translated_text: the Vedas propagate the greatness of <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ). // HNC 7.28 //

body.translated_text: 9. The Goal (<s>Prayojana</s>) Is Love of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> (<s>Kṛṣṇa-prema</s>)

children.text: śuddha bhakti samāśraya kariyā mānava /
children.translated_text: Taking shelter of pure devotion (<s>śuddha-bhakti</s>),

children.text: kṛṣṇa kṛpā bale pāya premera vaibhava // HNC_7.29 //
children.translated_text: a human being, by the power of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s grace, attains the opulence of <s>prema</s>. // HNC 7.29 //

body.translated_text: Blaspheming This Teaching of <s>Śruti</s> Is an Offense

children.text: e nava prameya śruti karena pramāṇa /
children.translated_text: The <s>śruti</s> provides the authority (<s>pramāṇa</s>) for these nine truths;

children.text: śruti tattvābhijña guru karena sandhāna // HNC_7.30 //
children.translated_text: the <s>guru</s> who knows the essence of <s>śruti</s> makes the connection. // HNC 7.30 //

children.text: e hena śrutira yei kare vinindana /
children.translated_text: Whoever blasphemes such <s>śruti</s>

children.text: nāma aparādhī sei narādhama jana // HNC_7.31 //
children.translated_text: is an offender to the Name — the lowest of humanity. // HNC 7.31 //

body.translated_text: The Host of Anti-Vedic Doctrines

children.text: jaimini kapila nagna nāstika sugata /
children.translated_text: <s>Jaimini</s>, <s>Kapila</s>, the Jainas (<s>Nagna</s>), the atheists (<s>Nāstika</s>), the Buddhists (<s>Sugata</s>),

children.text: gautama - e chaya jana hetu vāde rata // HNC_7.32 //
children.translated_text: and <s>Gautama</s> — these six persons are devoted to logic-based argument. // HNC 7.32 //

children.text: veda māne mukhe tabu īśa nāhi māne /
children.translated_text: He verbally accepts the Vedas but does not accept God (<s>Īśa</s>);

children.text: karma kāṇḍa śreṣṭha bali jaimin bākhāne // HNC_7.33 //
children.translated_text: <s>Jaimini</s> declares <s>karma-kāṇḍa</s> to be supreme. // HNC 7.33 //

children.text: īśvara asiddha kapilera kalpanāya /
children.translated_text: In <s>Kapila</s>'s speculation, <s>Īśvara</s> (God) is unestablished;

children.text: tabu yoga māne artha bujhā nāhi yāya // HNC_7.34 //
children.translated_text: yet he accepts <s>yoga</s> — the meaning is incomprehensible. // HNC 7.34 //

children.text: nagna se tāmasa tattva karaya vistāra /
children.translated_text: The Jainas (<s>Nagna</s>) propagate a dark (<s>tāmasa</s>) doctrine;

children.text: vedera viruddha dharma karaye pracāra // HNC_7.35 //
children.translated_text: they preach a religion opposed to the Vedas. // HNC 7.35 //

children.text: nāstika cārvāka kabhu veda nāhi māne /
children.translated_text: The atheistic <s>Cārvākas</s> never accept the Vedas;

children.text: sugata bauddherā eka prakāra bākhāne // HNC_7.36 //
children.translated_text: the Buddhists (<s>Sugata</s>) preach in a similar manner. // HNC 7.36 //

children.text: gautama nyāyera kartā īśvara nā bhaje /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautama</s>, the author of <s>Nyāya</s> (logic), does not worship <s>Īśvara</s>;

children.text: tāra hetu vāda mate nara mātra maje // HNC_7.37 //
children.translated_text: in his doctrine of logic, humans merely drown. // HNC 7.37 //

body.text: ei saba matavāda dvārā śruti-nindā haya
body.translated_text: Through All These Doctrines, Blasphemy of <s>Śruti</s> Occurs

children.text: ei saba duṣṭa mate śrutira nindana /
children.translated_text: In all these corrupt doctrines, blasphemy of <s>śruti</s> takes place;

children.text: kabhu spaṣṭa kabhu gupta bujhe vijña jana // HNC_7.38 //
children.translated_text: sometimes openly, sometimes covertly — the wise understand. // HNC 7.38 //

children.text: ei saba mate thāki aparādhī haya /
children.translated_text: Remaining in these doctrines, one becomes an offender;

children.text: ataeva ei sabe tyajibe niścaya // HNC_7.39 //
children.translated_text: therefore one must certainly abandon all of them. // HNC 7.39 //

body.text: māyāvādī ati duṣṭa mata - veda viruddha
body.translated_text: <s>Māyāvāda</s> — the Most Corrupt Doctrine, Opposed to the Vedas

children.text: ei saba kumata chāḍi āra māyāvāda /
children.translated_text: Leaving aside all these corrupt views, there is <s>Māyāvāda</s> (illusionism) —

children.text: śuddha bhakti anubhavi haya nirvivāda // HNC_7.40 //
children.translated_text: one who experiences pure devotion knows it is beyond dispute. // HNC 7.40 //

children.text: māyāvāda asat śāstra gupta bauddha mata /
children.translated_text: <s>Māyāvāda</s> is a false scripture, a covert form of Buddhism;

children.text: vedārtha vikṛti kali kālete sammata // HNC_7.41 //
children.translated_text: a distortion of the meaning of the Vedas, accepted in the age of <s>Kali</s>. // HNC 7.41 //

children.text: umāpati brāhmaṇa rūpete prakāśila /
children.translated_text: The consort of <s>Umā</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) manifested in the form of a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>;

children.text: tomāra ājñāya teṅha ācārya ha-ila // HNC_7.42 //
children.translated_text: by Your command, he became the <s>ācārya</s> (teacher). // HNC 7.42 //

children.text: jaimini ye rūpa mukhe veda mātra māne /
children.translated_text: Just as <s>Jaimini</s> verbally accepts only the Vedas,

children.text: śrutira vikṛta artha jagate bākhāne // HNC_7.43 //
children.translated_text: yet proclaims a distorted meaning of <s>śruti</s> to the world — // HNC 7.43 //

children.text: māyāvādī guru sei rūpa bauddha dharma /
children.translated_text: the <s>Māyāvādī</s> <s>guru</s> similarly, preaching a Buddhist doctrine,

children.text: veda vākye sthāpi ācchādila bhakti marma // HNC_7.44 //
children.translated_text: established it through Vedic words, covering the essence of <s>bhakti</s>. // HNC 7.44 //

children.text: ei saba matavāde bhakti dūre yāya /
children.translated_text: Through all these doctrinal disputes, <s>bhakti</s> goes far away;

children.text: śrī-kṛṣṇa-nāmete jīva aparādha pāya // HNC_7.45 //
children.translated_text: the <s>jīva</s> incurs offenses (<s>aparādha</s>) to <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name. // HNC 7.45 //

body.translated_text: The Pure Procedure in Deliberation on <s>Śruti</s>

children.text: śrutira abhidhā vṛtti kari saṃyojana /
children.translated_text: By applying the direct meaning (<s>abhidhā-vṛtti</s>) of <s>śruti</s>,

children.text: śuddha bhakti jīva pāya prema dhana // HNC_7.46 //
children.translated_text: the <s>jīva</s> attains pure devotion and the treasure of <s>prema</s>. // HNC 7.46 //

children.text: śrutite lakṣaṇā kare ayathā prakāre /
children.translated_text: When one applies secondary meaning (<s>lakṣaṇā</s>) to <s>śruti</s> in an improper way,

children.text: nitya satya dūre yāya aparādhe mare // HNC_7.47 //
children.translated_text: the eternal truth goes far away, and one dies in offense. // HNC 7.47 //

children.text: sarva veda sammata praṇava kṛṣṇa nāma /
children.translated_text: Accepted by all the Vedas, <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ) is the Name of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: sei nāme jīva saba pāya nitya dhāma // HNC_7.48 //
children.translated_text: by that Name, all <s>jīvas</s> attain the eternal abode. // HNC 7.48 //

children.text: praṇava se mahāvākya haya kṛṣṇa nāma /
children.translated_text: <s>Praṇava</s> — that <s>mahāvākya</s> (great statement) — is the Name of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: tāhāte-i śrī-bhaktera satata viśrāma // HNC_7.49 //
children.translated_text: in it alone the devotees of <s>Śrī</s> find their constant rest. // HNC 7.49 //

children.text: veda bale nāma cit svarūpa jagate /
children.translated_text: The Vedas declare that the Name is the spiritual reality (<s>cit-svarūpa</s>) in the world;

children.text: nāmera ābhāse siddha haya sarva mate // HNC_7.50 //
children.translated_text: even by the semblance of the Name (<s>nāmābhāsa</s>), perfection is achieved according to all views. // HNC 7.50 //

body.text: veda kevala śuddha nāma bhajana śikṣā dena
body.translated_text: The Vedas Teach Only the Worship of the Pure Name

children.text: ei saba veda śikṣā abhāgā nā māne /
children.translated_text: All these Vedic teachings — the unfortunate do not accept them;

children.text: nāme aparādha kare vedera nindane // HNC_7.51 //
children.translated_text: they commit offenses to the Name by blaspheming the Vedas. // HNC 7.51 //

children.text: śuddha nāma parāyaṇa yei mahājana /
children.translated_text: The great souls (<s>mahājanas</s>) devoted to the pure Name,

children.text: vedāśraye pāya nāma rasa prema dhana // HNC_7.52 //
children.translated_text: by taking shelter of the Vedas, attain the rasa of the Name and the treasure of <s>prema</s>. // HNC 7.52 //

children.text: sarva veda bale gāo hari-nāma sāra /
children.translated_text: All the Vedas say: 'Sing the essence — <s>Hari</s>'s Name!

children.text: pāibe paramā prīti ānanda apāra // HNC_7.53 //
children.translated_text: You will attain the supreme love and boundless bliss.' // HNC 7.53 //

children.text: veda punaḥ bale yata mukta mahājana /
children.translated_text: The Vedas further say: 'All the liberated <s>mahājanas</s> (great souls)

children.text: para-vyome sadā kare nāma saṅkīrtana // HNC_7.54 //
children.translated_text: in the spiritual sky, they always perform <s>Nāma-saṅkīrtana</s> (congregational chanting of the Name). // HNC_7.54 //

body.translated_text: The teachings of <s>tāmasika</s> (ignorant) <s>tantras</s> are contrary to the <s>Vedas</s>

children.text: kali yuge mahā jana māyā śakti bhaje /
children.translated_text: In the Age of <s>Kali</s>, great persons worship <s>Māyā-śakti</s> (the illusory potency);

children.text: cid ātmā puruṣa kṛṣṇa nāma rasa tyāje // HNC_7.55 //
children.translated_text: they abandon the spiritual self, the Supreme Person <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, and the <s>rasa</s> (flavor) of the Name. // HNC_7.55 //

children.text: tāmasika tantra dhari śruti nindā kare /
children.translated_text: Adopting <s>tāmasika tantras</s> (scriptures in the mode of ignorance), they blaspheme the <s>Śruti</s> (Vedas);

children.text: madya-māṃse prīti kari adharmete mare // HNC_7.56 //
children.translated_text: delighting in wine and meat, they perish in irreligion. // HNC_7.56 //

children.text: se saba ninduka nāhi pāya kṛṣṇa nāma /
children.translated_text: All such blasphemers do not obtain <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name;

children.text: kabhu nāhi pāya kṛṣṇera vṛndāvana dhāma // HNC_7.57 //
children.translated_text: they never obtain <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s abode of <s>Vṛndāvana</s>. // HNC_7.57 //

body.translated_text: The sincere grace of <s>Māyā Devī</s> (the goddess of illusion) is what is needed

children.text: māyā devī se saba pāṣaṇḍe adhogati /
children.translated_text: <s>Māyā Devī</s> sends all such <s>pāṣaṇḍas</s> (heretics) to degradation;

children.text: diyā nāmāmṛta āra nāhi dena mati // HNC_7.58 //
children.translated_text: giving [them] the nectar of the Name, she no longer grants [them] the intellect [to appreciate it]. // HNC_7.58 //

children.text: tabe yadi sādhu sevāya tuṣṭa hana māyā /
children.translated_text: But if <s>Māyā</s> becomes pleased by service to the <s>sādhus</s> (saints),

children.text: akapaṭe dena tabe kṛṣṇa pada chāyā // HNC_7.59 //
children.translated_text: then without duplicity she bestows the shade of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s lotus feet. // HNC_7.59 //

children.text: māyā kṛṣṇa dāsī bahirmukha jīve daṇḍe /
children.translated_text: <s>Māyā</s> is <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s maidservant; she punishes the <s>jīvas</s> (souls) who turn away [from Him];

children.text: māyā pūjile-o śubha nāhi pāya bhaṇḍe // HNC_7.60 //
children.translated_text: even if one worships <s>Māyā</s>, the rogue does not obtain auspiciousness. // HNC_7.60 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa nāma kare yei māyā devī tāre /
children.translated_text: One who chants <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name — <s>Māyā Devī</s>

children.text: niṣkapaṭe kṛpā kari laya bhava pāre // HNC_7.61 //
children.translated_text: sincerely bestows grace upon him and takes him across the ocean of material existence. // HNC_7.61 //

children.text: ataeva śruti-nindā aparādha tyaji /
children.translated_text: Therefore, abandoning the offense of blaspheming the <s>Śruti</s> (Vedas),

children.text: aharahaḥ nāma saṅkīrtana rase maji // HNC_7.62 //
children.translated_text: one should immerse oneself day after day in the <s>rasa</s> (flavor) of <s>Nāma-saṅkīrtana</s>. // HNC_7.62 //

body.translated_text: The remedy for that offense

children.text: pramāde yadyapi haya se śruti-nindana /
children.translated_text: If by mistake one happens to blaspheme the <s>Śruti</s>,

children.text: anutāpe kari punaḥ se śruti vandana // HNC_7.63 //
children.translated_text: with remorse one should again offer praise to that <s>Śruti</s>. // HNC_7.63 //

children.text: kusama tulasī diyā sei śruti gaṇe /
children.translated_text: Offering flowers and <s>Tulasī</s> (holy basil) to those <s>Śrutis</s>,

children.text: bhāgavata saha sadā pūjiba yatane // HNC_7.64 //
children.translated_text: one should always carefully worship [them] together with the <s>Bhāgavata</s>. // HNC_7.64 //

children.text: bhāgavata śruti sāra kṛṣṇa avatāra /
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhāgavata</s> is the essence of the <s>Śruti</s>, an incarnation of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: avaśya karibe more karuṇā apāra // HNC_7.65 //
children.translated_text: it will surely bestow upon me boundless mercy. // HNC_7.65 //

children.text: haridāsa pada rajaḥ bharasā yāhāra /
children.translated_text: One whose hope rests in the dust of <s>Haridāsa</s>'s feet —

children.text: nāma-cintāmaṇi hāra galāya tāhāra // HNC_7.66 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Nāma-cintāmaṇi</s> (wish-fulfilling gem of the Name) is a necklace around his neck. // HNC_7.66 //

body.text:
iti śrī- hari-nāma-cintāmaṇau śruti-nindā aparādha vicāro
nāma saptamaḥ paricchedaḥ /
body.translated_text: Thus ends the seventh chapter of <s>Śrī Hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi</s>, entitled 'Consideration of the Offense of Blaspheming the <s>Śruti</s>.'

(8)
Eighth Chapter
Imagining the glories of <s>Hari</s>'s Name to be figurative praise (<s>arthavāda</s>)

children.text: jaya gaura gadādhara śrī-rādhā-mādhava /
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Gaura</s> and <s>Gadādhara</s>! Glory to <s>Śrī Rādhā-Mādhava</s>!

children.text: jaya gaura-līlā-sthalī jāhnavī vaiṣṇava // HNC_8.1 //
children.translated_text: Glory to the sites of <s>Gaura</s>'s pastimes! Glory to <s>Jāhnavī</s> and the <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>! // HNC_8.1 //

children.text: hari nāme artha vāda kalpanā cintana /
children.translated_text: Figurative interpretation (<s>arthavāda</s>) and imaginative speculation about <s>Hari</s>'s Name —

children.text: pañcamāparādha prabho śrī śacīnandana // HNC_8.2 //
children.translated_text: this is the fifth offense, O Lord <s>Śrī Śacīnandana</s> (son of <s>Śacī</s>). // HNC_8.2 //

body.translated_text: The glories of the Name

children.text: smṛti kahe helāya śraddhāya nāma laya /
children.translated_text: The <s>Smṛti</s> says: whether one takes the Name carelessly or with faith,

children.text: kṛṣṇa tāre kṛpā kari hayena sadaya // HNC_8.3 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> bestows grace upon that person and becomes compassionate. // HNC_8.3 //

children.text: nāmera sadṛśa jñāna nāhika nirmala /
children.translated_text: There is no knowledge as pure as the Name;

children.text: nāmera sadṛśa vrata nāhika prabala // HNC_8.4 //
children.translated_text: there is no vow as powerful as the Name. // HNC_8.4 //

children.text: nāmera sadṛśa dhyāna nāhi e jagate /
children.translated_text: There is no meditation equal to the Name in this world;

children.text: nāmera sadṛśa phala nāhi kona mate // HNC_8.5 //
children.translated_text: there is no fruit equal to the Name in any way. // HNC_8.5 //

children.text: nāmera sadṛśa tyāga kona rūpe naya /
children.translated_text: There is no renunciation comparable to the Name;

children.text: nāmera sadṛśa sama kabhu nāhi haya // HNC_8.6 //
children.translated_text: there is never any peace comparable to the Name. // HNC_8.6 //

children.text: nāmera sadṛśa puṇya nāhi e saṃsāre /
children.translated_text: There is no merit equal to the Name in this <s>Saṃsāra</s> (material existence);

children.text: nāmera sadṛśa gati nā dekhi vicāre // HNC_8.7 //
children.translated_text: upon reflection, I see no destination equal to the Name. // HNC_8.7 //

children.text: nāma-i parama mukti nāma ucca gati /
children.translated_text: The Name is the supreme liberation; the Name is the highest destination;

children.text: nāma-i parama śānti nāma ucca sthiti // HNC_8.8 //
children.translated_text: the Name is the supreme peace; the Name is the highest state. // HNC_8.8 //

children.text: nāma-i parama bhakti nāma śuddhā mati /
children.translated_text: The Name is the supreme devotion; the Name is the pure intellect;

children.text: nāma-i parama prīti nāma parā smṛti // HNC_8.9 //
children.translated_text: the Name is the supreme love; the Name is the transcendent remembrance. // HNC_8.9 //

children.text: nāma-i kāraṇa tattva nāma sarva prabhu /
children.translated_text: The Name is the causal principle; the Name is the Lord of all;

children.text: parama ārādhya nāma guru-rūpe vibhu // HNC_8.10 //
children.translated_text: the Name, supremely worshipable, is the all-pervading Lord in the form of <s>Guru</s>. // HNC_8.10 //

body.translated_text: The supremacy of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name

children.text: sahasra viṣṇu nāmera tulya haya eka rāma nāma /
children.translated_text: One Name of <s>Rāma</s> equals a thousand Names of <s>Viṣṇu</s>;

children.text: tina rāma nāma tulya eka kṛṣṇa nāma // HNC_8.11 //
children.translated_text: one Name of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> equals three Names of <s>Rāma</s>. // HNC_8.11 //

body.text: nāmera artha vāda naraka gamana avaśya ghaṭe
body.translated_text: Figurative interpretation of the Name certainly leads to hell

children.text: śruti gaṇa nāmera māhātmya sadā gāya /
children.translated_text: The <s>Śruti</s> scriptures always sing the glories of the Name;

children.text: nāmera cit-tattva bali jagate jānāya // HNC_8.12 //
children.translated_text: they make it known in the world that the Name is a spiritual truth. // HNC_8.12 //

children.text: śruti smṛti pradarśita nāmera ye phala /
children.translated_text: The fruits of the Name as shown by <s>Śruti</s> and <s>Smṛti</s> —

children.text: tāhe artha vāda kare pāṣaṇḍa prabala // HNC_8.13 //
children.translated_text: a powerful heretic treats them as figurative praise. // HNC_8.13 //

children.text: harināme artha vāda ye adhama kare /
children.translated_text: The lowly person who treats the glories of <s>Hari</s>'s Name as figurative,

children.text: se pāpiṣṭha narakete paci' paci' mare // HNC_8.14 //
children.translated_text: that worst sinner suffers repeatedly in hell and perishes. // HNC_8.14 //

children.text: ye bale nāmera phala-śruti satya naya /
children.translated_text: He who says the scriptural statements about the Name's fruits are not true,

children.text: nāme ruci dite mātra tata phala kaya // HNC_8.15 //
children.translated_text: that they are stated merely to create interest in the Name — // HNC_8.15 //

children.text: śāstrera tātparya āra jīva hitāhita /
children.translated_text: the purport of the scriptures and the welfare and harm of the <s>jīva</s> —

children.text: se adhama nāhi jāne bujhe viparīta // HNC_8.16 //
children.translated_text: that wretched person does not know, and understands them in reverse. // HNC_8.16 //

body.text: nāmera phala satya | tāhāte artha vādera prayojana nāi
body.translated_text: The fruits of the Name are real; there is no need for figurative interpretation of them

children.text: karma kāṇḍa āche ta kaitava svārtha jñāna /
children.translated_text: In the <s>karma-kāṇḍa</s> (section of ritualistic action), there is indeed the deception of selfish motives;

children.text: bhakti tattve nāme tāhā nahe vidyamāna // HNC_8.17 //
children.translated_text: in the truth of devotion and the Name, that is not present. // HNC_8.17 //

children.text: karma kāṇḍa phala śruti rocanārtha jāni /
children.translated_text: We understand the scriptural statements about the fruits of <s>karma-kāṇḍa</s> as meant to create interest;

children.text: bhakti tattve phala śruti nitya satya māni // HNC_8.18 //
children.translated_text: but in the truth of devotion, we accept the scriptural statements about fruits as eternally true. // HNC_8.18 //

children.text: nāma tattve śāṭhya nāhi pāya kabhu sthāna /
children.translated_text: In the truth of the Name, deception never finds a place;

children.text: nijera nāhika svārtha nāma kari dāna // HNC_8.19 //
children.translated_text: the Name has no selfish motive of its own — it is freely bestowed as a gift. // HNC_8.19 //

body.translated_text: Figurative interpretation of the fruits of <s>karma</s> should not be abandoned

children.text: nāma dāna śraddāvāne yei jana kare /
children.translated_text: One who gives the Name to a faithful person

children.text: kṛṣṇa dāsya kare sei svārtha parihāre // HNC_8.20 //
children.translated_text: serves <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, abandoning selfish interest. // HNC_8.20 //

children.text: karma karāile yājakera artha lābha /
children.translated_text: When rituals are performed, the priest gains material profit;

children.text: ataeva tāhe kaitavera ta prabhāva // HNC_8.21 //
children.translated_text: therefore in that [domain], deception has its influence. // HNC_8.21 //

children.text: veda smṛti nāma phala ananta bākhāne /
children.translated_text: The <s>Vedas</s> and <s>Smṛti</s> describe the fruits of the Name as infinite;

children.text: svārtha buddhi śūnya se ye tāhā nāhi māne // HNC_8.22 //
children.translated_text: one devoid of selfish motives does not disregard them. // HNC_8.22 //

children.text: karma saba śubhāśubha jaḍera āśraye /
children.translated_text: All actions, whether auspicious or inauspicious, depend on matter;

children.text: jaḍa-maya-phala yāce yajamāna caye // HNC_8.23 //
children.translated_text: the <s>yajamāna</s> (patron of sacrifice) seeks and desires fruits made of matter. // HNC_8.23 //

children.text: karma phala dūre pheli' yebā kare karma /
children.translated_text: One who performs action while casting far away the desire for its fruits —

children.text: hṛdaya viśuddha tāra haya ei marma // HNC_8.24 //
children.translated_text: his heart becomes purified; this is the essential point. // HNC_8.24 //

children.text: viśuddha hṛdaye ātma rati sunirmala /
children.translated_text: In a purified heart, love for the self, perfectly pure,

children.text: udaya ha-iyā haya kramaśaḥ prabala // HNC_8.25 //
children.translated_text: arises and gradually becomes powerful. // HNC_8.25 //

body.text: nāma cinmaya, tāhāte artha-vāda ha-ite pāre nā
body.translated_text: The Name is spiritual — figurative interpretation cannot apply to it

children.text: nāma sei ātma-rati nije upasthita /
children.translated_text: The Name is that very <s>ātma-rati</s> (self-delight) that presents itself;

children.text: sādhana kālete sādhya vastura vihita // HNC_8.26 //
children.translated_text: in the time of practice, it is the goal itself that is ordained. // HNC_8.26 //

children.text: karmera carama phala nāma-rasa haya /
children.translated_text: The ultimate fruit of action is the <s>rasa</s> (flavor) of the Name;

children.text: sādhu-rūpe anuṣṭhita karmete niścaya // HNC_8.27 //
children.translated_text: this is certain when action is performed in the manner of the <s>sādhus</s> (saints). // HNC_8.27 //

children.text: ataeva caudda loka bhramiyā brāhmaṇa /
children.translated_text: Therefore, the fruit that the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> does not obtain even after wandering the fourteen worlds,

children.text: yei phala nāhi pāna nāma tāhā hana // HNC_8.28 //
children.translated_text: the Name itself becomes. // HNC_8.28 //

children.text: nāma phala sarvopari avaśya ha-ibe /
children.translated_text: The fruit of the Name is above everything — it will certainly be attained;

children.text: karmī jñānī hiṃsā kari' nāme ki karibe // HNC_8.29 //
children.translated_text: what will the ritualists and speculators accomplish by doing violence to the Name? // HNC_8.29 //

body.text: nāmābhāse sarva karma o brahma-jñānera phala ha-iyā thāke
body.translated_text: Through <s>nāmābhāsa</s> (semblance of the Name), the fruits of all rituals and <s>Brahman</s>-knowledge are already obtained

children.text: sarva-karma-phala nāmābhāse labdha haya /
children.translated_text: The fruits of all rituals are obtained through <s>nāmābhāsa</s>;

children.text: sarva-jñāna-phala nāmābhāsete milaya // HNC_8.30 //
children.translated_text: the fruits of all knowledge are attained through <s>nāmābhāsa</s>. // HNC_8.30 //

children.text: ābhāse milila yadi eta ucca phala /
children.translated_text: If such exalted fruits are obtained through mere semblance,

children.text: nāma vastu tato'dhika pradāne prabala // HNC_8.31 //
children.translated_text: the Name itself is even more powerful in bestowing [its gifts]. // HNC_8.31 //

children.text: ataeva śāstre yata nāma phala gāya /
children.translated_text: Therefore, whatever fruits of the Name the scriptures extol,

children.text: śuddha nāmāśrita jana niścaya tā pāya // HNC_8.32 //
children.translated_text: one who takes shelter of the pure Name certainly obtains them. // HNC_8.32 //

body.text: nāma phale yāhāra sandeha, tāhāra maṅgala nāi
body.translated_text: There is no welfare for one who doubts the fruits of the Name

children.text: ihāte sandeha yāra se adhama jana /
children.translated_text: Whoever has doubt about this is a fallen person;

children.text: nāma aparādhe tāra avaśya patana // HNC_8.33 //
children.translated_text: by offense to the Name, his downfall is certain. // HNC_8.33 //

children.text: vede rāmāyaṇe āra bhārate purāṇe /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Vedas</s>, the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s>, the <s>Mahābhārata</s>, and the <s>Purāṇas</s>,

children.text: ādi antye madhye harināmere bākhāne // HNC_8.34 //
children.translated_text: at the beginning, end, and middle, they describe <s>Hari</s>'s Name. // HNC_8.34 //

children.text: nāma phala śruti vākya anādi niścala /
children.translated_text: The scriptural statements about the Name's fruits are beginningless and immutable;

children.text: tāhe artha vāda kalpanāra kibā phala // HNC_8.35 //
children.translated_text: what is the use of superimposing figurative interpretation upon them? // HNC_8.35 //

body.text: karma-jñānera śakti apekṣā nāme ananta-guṇa śakti āche
body.translated_text: Compared to the power of <s>karma</s> and <s>jñāna</s>, the Name has infinite potency

children.text: nāma nāmī eka nāme diyā sarva śakti /
children.translated_text: The Name and the Named are one; You have given all potency to the Name;

children.text: sarvopari kariyācha tava nāma śakti // HNC_8.36 //
children.translated_text: You have made the power of Your Name supreme above all. // HNC_8.36 //

children.text: tumi ta svatantra tattva sarva śaktimān /
children.translated_text: You are the independent truth, possessing all potencies;

children.text: tomāra icchāya yata vidhira vidhāna // HNC_8.37 //
children.translated_text: by Your will are all the ordinances of providence. // HNC_8.37 //

children.text: karmake karecha jaḍa āra brahma jñāne /
children.translated_text: You have made <s>karma</s> (action) material, and to <s>Brahman</s>-knowledge

children.text: diyācha nirvāṇa śakti svatantra vidhāne // HNC_8.38 //
children.translated_text: You have given the power of <s>nirvāṇa</s> (cessation) by Your independent arrangement. // HNC_8.38 //

children.text: icchāmaya tumi prabhu svīya nāmākṣare /
children.translated_text: You are the Lord whose will is supreme; in the very syllables of Your Name,

children.text: arpiyācha saba śakti āra ke ki kare // HNC_8.39 //
children.translated_text: You have placed all potencies — what else can anyone do? // HNC_8.39 //

children.text: ataeva tava nāma sarva śaktimān /
children.translated_text: Therefore Your Name is all-powerful;

children.text: nāme artha-vāda nāhi karibe vidvān // HNC_8.40 //
children.translated_text: a learned person will not treat the Name as figurative praise. // HNC_8.40 //

body.translated_text: The remedy for that offense

children.text: nāme artha-vāda aparādha ghaṭe yadi /
children.translated_text: If the offense of figurative interpretation of the Name occurs,

children.text: dante tṛṇa dhari yāi vaiṣṇava-saṃsadi // HNC_8.41 //
children.translated_text: one should go to the assembly of <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s> with a blade of grass between one's teeth. // HNC_8.41 //

children.text: aparādha jānāiyā vaiṣṇava-caraṇe /
children.translated_text: Confessing the offense at the feet of the <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>,

children.text: kṣamā māgi kākuti kariyā ṛju-mane // HNC_8.42 //
children.translated_text: one should beg forgiveness with entreaty, in a straightforward mind. // HNC_8.42 //

children.text: nāmera mahimā jñātā bhāgavata jana /
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhāgavata</s> devotees, who know the glories of the Name,

children.text: kṣamā kari kṛpā kari dibe āliṅgana // HNC_8.43 //
children.translated_text: will forgive and bestow grace, giving an embrace. // HNC_8.43 //

children.text: nāme artha vāda āra kalpana-manana /
children.translated_text: Figurative interpretation and speculative imagination about the Name

children.text: kabhu nāhi habe citte māyā viḍambana // HNC_8.44 //
children.translated_text: will never again arise in the mind as <s>Māyā</s>'s mockery. // HNC_8.44 //

children.text: artha-vāda-kārī saha haile sambhāṣaṇa /
children.translated_text: If one happens to converse with one who engages in figurative interpretation,

children.text: sa-cele jāhnavī-jale kariba majjana // HNC_8.45 //
children.translated_text: one should bathe fully clothed in the waters of the <s>Jāhnavī</s> (Ganges). // HNC_8.45 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa priyā vaṃśī kṛpā bharasā yāhāra /
children.translated_text: One whose hope rests in the grace of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s beloved flute —

children.text: harināma cintāmaṇi tāra alaṅkāra // HNC_8.46 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Harināma Cintāmaṇi</s> (wish-fulfilling gem of the Holy Name) is his ornament. // HNC_8.46 //

body.text:
iti śrī- hari-nāma-cintāmaṇau artha-vādāparādha-vicāro
nāma aṣṭamaḥ paricchedaḥ /
body.translated_text: Thus ends the eighth chapter of <s>Śrī Hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi</s>, entitled 'Consideration of the Offense of Figurative Interpretation (<s>Arthavāda</s>).'

(9)
Ninth Chapter
The mentality of sinning on the strength of the Name

body.text:
nāmno balād yasya hi pāpa-buddhir
na vidyate tasya yamair hi śuddhiḥ
body.translated_text: One who has the mentality of sinning on the strength of the Name — for him there is no purification even through the rules of <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: gaura gadādhara jaya jāhnavā-jīvana /
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Gaura</s> and <s>Gadādhara</s>! Glory to <s>Jāhnavā</s>, the life [of <s>Nityānanda</s>]!

children.text: jaya jaya sītādvaita jaya bhakta-gaṇa // HNC_9.1 //
children.translated_text: Glory, glory to <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Advaita</s>! Glory to the host of devotees! // HNC_9.1 //

body.translated_text: By chanting the Name, all obstacles are removed

children.text: haridāsa bale nāma śuddha sattva maya /
children.translated_text: <s>Haridāsa</s> says: the Name is made of pure goodness;

children.text: bhāgyavān jīva kare nāmera āśraya // HNC_9.2 //
children.translated_text: the fortunate <s>jīva</s> (soul) takes shelter of the Name. // HNC_9.2 //

children.text: ati śīghra tāhāra anartha dūre yāya /
children.translated_text: Very quickly, his obstacles depart;

children.text: hṛdaya-daurbalya āra sthāna nāhi pāya // HNC_9.3 //
children.translated_text: the weakness of heart no longer finds a place. // HNC_9.3 //

children.text: nāme dṛḍha haile nāhi haya pāpe mati /
children.translated_text: When one becomes firm in the Name, the mind does not incline toward sin;

children.text: pūrva pāpa dagdha haya citta śuddha ati // HNC_9.4 //
children.translated_text: former sins are burned away, and the consciousness becomes extremely pure. // HNC_9.4 //

children.text: pāpa āra pāpa-bīja pāpera vāsanā /
children.translated_text: Sin, the seed of sin, and the residual desire for sin —

children.text: avidyā tāhāra mūla e tina yantranā // HNC_9.5 //
children.translated_text: <s>avidyā</s> (ignorance) is their root — these are the three afflictions. // HNC_9.5 //

children.text: sarva jīve dayā āsi ha-ibe udaya /
children.translated_text: Compassion for all beings will arise;

children.text: jīvera maṅgala ceṣṭā satata karaya // HNC_9.6 //
children.translated_text: one will constantly endeavor for the welfare of all <s>jīvas</s> (souls). // HNC_9.6 //

children.text: jīvera santāpa kabhu sahite nā pāre /
children.translated_text: One cannot bear the suffering of other beings;

children.text: yāhe para-tāpa yāya tāra ceṣṭā kare // HNC_9.7 //
children.translated_text: one strives for whatever removes the distress of others. // HNC_9.7 //

children.text: viṣaya-pipāsā ati tuccha mane haya /
children.translated_text: Thirst for sense objects becomes very insignificant in one's mind;

children.text: indriya-lālasā tāra citte nāhi raya // HNC_9.8 //
children.translated_text: craving for sensual indulgence does not remain in one's heart. // HNC_9.8 //

children.text: kanaka-kāminī ceṣṭā prati ghṛṇā kare /
children.translated_text: One feels revulsion toward the pursuit of wealth and women;

children.text: yathā dharma lābhe tuṣṭa thāki prāṇa dhare // HNC_9.9 //
children.translated_text: content with rightful gains, one maintains one's life. // HNC_9.9 //

children.text: bhakti anukūla saba karaye svīkāra /
children.translated_text: One accepts everything favorable to devotion;

children.text: bhakti pratikūla nāhi kare aṅgīkāra // HNC_9.10 //
children.translated_text: one does not accept anything unfavorable to devotion. // HNC_9.10 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa rakṣā kartā eka mātra bali jāne /
children.translated_text: One knows <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> alone as one's sole protector;

children.text: jīvane pālana-kartā kṛṣṇa ihā māne // HNC_9.11 //
children.translated_text: one accepts that <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is the sustainer of one's life. // HNC_9.11 //

children.text: ahaṃ mama buddhy-āsakti nā rākhe hṛdaye /
children.translated_text: One does not retain in one's heart attachment to 'I' and 'mine';

children.text: dīna-bhāve nāma laya sakala samaye // HNC_9.12 //
children.translated_text: in a humble mood, one chants the Name at all times. // HNC_9.12 //

children.text: svabhāvataḥ yāra ei rūpa nāmāśraya /
children.translated_text: For one who naturally has such shelter of the Name,

children.text: pāpe mati pāpācāra tāhāra ki haya // HNC_9.13 //
children.translated_text: how can a sinful mentality or sinful conduct arise? // HNC_9.13 //

body.text: pūrva-pāpa o pāpa-gandha śīghra dūra haya
body.translated_text: Former sins and even the scent of sin are quickly removed

children.text: pūrva dṛṣṭa-bhāva tāra krame haya kṣīṇa /
children.translated_text: The previously ingrained dispositions gradually become weakened;

children.text: pavitra svabhāva śīghra ha-ibe pravīṇa // HNC_9.14 //
children.translated_text: a pure character quickly becomes well-established. // HNC_9.14 //

children.text: ei sandhi kāle pūrva pāpera sambandha /
children.translated_text: During this transitional period, connection with former sins

children.text: thākite-o pāre kichu dina pāpa gandha // HNC_9.15 //
children.translated_text: may linger for some time — a trace of sin [may remain]. // HNC_9.15 //

children.text: nāmera saṃsarge yata sumati udaya /
children.translated_text: By association with the Name, as good intelligence arises,

children.text: haye sei pāpa gandha śīghra kare kṣaya // HNC_9.16 //
children.translated_text: that trace of sin is quickly destroyed. // HNC_9.16 //

children.text: pratijñā karecha nātha arjuna nikaṭe /
children.translated_text: You have made a promise, O Lord, in the presence of <s>Arjuna</s>:

children.text: mora bhakta kabhu nāhi paḍibe saṅkaṭe // HNC_9.17 //
children.translated_text: 'My devotee will never fall into calamity.' // HNC_9.17 //

children.text: saṅkaṭa samaye āmi ha-iba sahāya /
children.translated_text: 'In times of distress, I shall be [his] helper;

children.text: ataeva pāpa yāya tomāra kṛpāya // HNC_9.18 //
children.translated_text: therefore, sin departs by Your grace.' // HNC_9.18 //

children.text: jñāna mārgī kaṣṭe pāpa kariyā damana /
children.translated_text: The follower of the path of <s>jñāna</s> (knowledge) suppresses sin with great difficulty;

children.text: tavāśraya chāḍi śīghra haya ta patana // HNC_9.19 //
children.translated_text: abandoning Your shelter, he quickly falls. // HNC_9.19 //

children.text: tava padāśraya yāra sei mahājana /
children.translated_text: One who has shelter at Your feet — that great soul

children.text: vighna nā pāibe kabhu siddhānta vacana // HNC_9.20 //
children.translated_text: will never encounter obstacles; this is the conclusive teaching. // HNC_9.20 //

body.text: pramāde pāpa upasthita ha-ile tāhāra prāyaścittera prayojana nāi
body.translated_text: If sin arises by accident, there is no need for atonement

children.text: yadi kabhu pramāde ghaṭaya kona pāpa /
children.translated_text: If at some time, by accident, some sin occurs,

children.text: bhakta tabu nāhi sahe prāyaścitta tāpa // HNC_9.21 //
children.translated_text: the devotee still does not bear the pain of atonement (<s>prāyaścitta</s>). // HNC_9.21 //

children.text: se pāpa kṣaṇika nāhi pāya avasthiti /
children.translated_text: That sin is momentary and does not find a lasting place.

children.text: nāma rase bhese yāya nā deya durgati // HNC_9.22 //
children.translated_text: One floats in the <s>rasa</s> (divine taste) of the Name and is never given ill fortune. // HNC_9.22 //

body.translated_text: The Result of One Who Commits Sinful Acts on the Strength of the Name

children.text: kintu yadi kona jana nāme kari bala /
children.translated_text: But if someone, taking strength from the Name,

children.text: ācare nūtana pāpa, se jana cañcala // HNC_9.23 //
children.translated_text: engages in new sins, that person is fickle. // HNC_9.23 //

children.text: se kevala kapaṭatā kariyā āśraya /
children.translated_text: Such a person, taking shelter of sheer deceit,

children.text: nāma-aparādha pāya śoka-mṛti-bhaya // HNC_9.24 //
children.translated_text: incurs <s>nāmāparādha</s> (offense to the Name) and meets sorrow, death, and fear. // HNC_9.24 //

body.translated_text: The Difference Between Inadvertent and Deliberate Sins

children.text: pramāda ghaṭanā āra vicārita karme /
children.translated_text: Between inadvertent occurrences and deliberate actions,

children.text: sampūrṇa prabheda āche bhakti-śāstra marme // HNC_9.25 //
children.translated_text: there is a complete distinction — this is the essence of the devotional scriptures. // HNC_9.25 //

body.text: nāmāśrayīra pāpa karā dūre thākuka, pāpe mati ha-ile-i nāmāparādha haya
body.translated_text: Let Alone Committing Sin, Even the Mere Intention to Sin on the Strength of the Name Constitutes <s>Nāmāparādha</s>

children.text: saṃsārī mānava yebā ācaraye pāpa /
children.translated_text: A worldly person who commits sin —

children.text: prāyaścitta āche tāra āra anutāpa // HNC_9.26 //
children.translated_text: for him there is atonement (<s>prāyaścitta</s>) and also remorse. // HNC_9.26 //

children.text: kintu nāma-bale yadi pāpe kare mati /
children.translated_text: But if one turns the mind toward sin on the strength of the Name,

children.text: prāyaścitta nāhi tāra baḍa-i durgati // HNC_9.27 //
children.translated_text: there is no atonement for him — great is his misfortune. // HNC_9.27 //

children.text: bahu yama yātanādi pāile-o tāra /
children.translated_text: Even if he undergoes the many punishments of <s>Yama</s>,

children.text: sei aparādha ha-ite nā haya uddhāra // HNC_9.28 //
children.translated_text: from that offense he is never delivered. // HNC_9.28 //

children.text: pāpa mati-mātre haya e-rūpa yantranā /
children.translated_text: If the mere intention to sin brings such suffering,

children.text: pāpācāre yata doṣe tāra ki gaṇanā // HNC_9.29 //
children.translated_text: then what measure can be made of the fault of actually sinning? // HNC_9.29 //

body.text: pravañcaka śaṭhera nāma-bharasāya pāpa-kriyā markaṭa-vairāgya mātra
body.translated_text: A Deceitful Rogue's Sinful Acts Relying on the Name Are Mere Monkey Renunciation

children.text: śāstre śuniyāche nāma yata pāpa hare /
children.translated_text: The scriptures say that the Name destroys as many sins

children.text: koṭi janme mahā pāpī karite nā pāre // HNC_9.30 //
children.translated_text: as a great sinner could not commit in ten million lifetimes. // HNC_9.30 //

children.text: pañca vidha pāpa mahā pātaka avadhi /
children.translated_text: The five kinds of sin, up to the great mortal sins (<s>mahāpātaka</s>) —

children.text: nāmābhāse yāya śāstra gāya niravadhi // HNC_9.31 //
children.translated_text: the scriptures ceaselessly proclaim that even <s>nāmābhāsa</s> (the semblance of the Name) removes them. // HNC_9.31 //

children.text: sei ta bharasā kari pravañcaka jana /
children.translated_text: Relying on that assurance, a deceitful person

children.text: śaṭhatā kariyā nāma karaye grahaṇa // HNC_9.32 //
children.translated_text: takes up the Name with cunning intent. // HNC_9.32 //

children.text: kaṣṭera saṃsāra chāḍi vairāgīra veśe /
children.translated_text: Abandoning this miserable world in the garb of a renunciant,

children.text: kanaka kāminī āśe phire deśe deśe // HNC_9.33 //
children.translated_text: he wanders from land to land in pursuit of wealth and women. // HNC_9.33 //

children.text: tumi ta balecha prabhu markaṭa vairāgī /
children.translated_text: You have said, O Lord, that such a monkey-renunciant,

children.text: kāminī sambhāṣi phire dharma gṛha tyāgī // HNC_9.34 //
children.translated_text: abandoning hearth and religion, roams about speaking with women. // HNC_9.34 //

body.text: niṣkapaṭa nāmāśraya nā karile ei aparādha anirvārya
body.translated_text: Unless One Takes Honest Shelter of the Name, This Offense Is Unavoidable

children.text: vairāgyera chale keha gṛhe kāṭe kāla /
children.translated_text: Under the pretext of renunciation, some spend their days at home,

children.text: sambhāṣya nā haya saba viśvera jañjāla // HNC_9.35 //
children.translated_text: yet that is no excuse — it is just the world's entanglement. // HNC_9.35 //

children.text: gṛhe thāku vane yāu tāte nāhi doṣa /
children.translated_text: Whether one stays at home or goes to the forest, there is no fault in that;

children.text: niṣpāpe karuk nāma pāiyā santoṣa // HNC_9.36 //
