children.translated_text: let one chant the Name sinlessly, finding contentment. // HNC_9.36 //

children.text: nāma bale pāpa mati mahā aparādha /
children.translated_text: The intention to sin on the strength of the Name is a great offense;

children.text: tāhāte majile haya bhakti tattve bādha // HNC_9.37 //
children.translated_text: if one is immersed in that, it becomes an obstacle to the truth of <s>bhakti</s> (devotion). // HNC_9.37 //

body.text: nāmābhāsi-vyakti-gaṇa ei kapaṭa lokera saṅge aparādhī hana
body.translated_text: Those Who Chant <s>Nāmābhāsa</s> Become Offenders by Associating with Such Deceitful People

children.text: nāmābhāsī janera kusaṅga yadi haya /
children.translated_text: If those who chant <s>nāmābhāsa</s> keep bad company,

children.text: tabe ei aparādha ghaṭibe niścaya // HNC_9.38 //
children.translated_text: then this offense will surely occur. // HNC_9.38 //

children.text: śuddha nāmodaya yāra hṛdaye ha-ibe /
children.translated_text: In whose heart the pure Name will arise,

children.text: ei nāma aparādha tāra nā ghaṭibe // HNC_9.39 //
children.translated_text: for that person this offense to the Name will never occur. // HNC_9.39 //

body.text: śuddha nāmāśrita vyaktira daśa vidha aparādha sparśa kare nā
body.translated_text: The Ten Offenses Do Not Touch One Who Has Taken Shelter of the Pure Name

children.text: śuddha-nāmāśrita jane aparādha daśa /
children.translated_text: For one who has taken shelter of the pure Name, the ten offenses

children.text: kona rūpe kona kāle nā kare paraśa // HNC_9.40 //
children.translated_text: in no form and at no time ever touch him. // HNC_9.40 //

children.text: nāmāśrita jane nāma sadā rakṣā kare /
children.translated_text: The Name always protects one who has taken its shelter;

children.text: aparādha kabhu tāra nā ha-ite pāre // HNC_9.41 //
children.translated_text: offense can never befall such a person. // HNC_9.41 //

children.text: yata dina śuddha nāma nā haya udaya /
children.translated_text: As long as the pure Name has not arisen,

children.text: tata dina aparādha ākramaṇe bhaya // HNC_9.42 //
children.translated_text: so long is there fear of the onslaught of offenses. // HNC_9.42 //

children.text: ataeva nāmābhāsī yadi bhāla cāya /
children.translated_text: Therefore, if one who chants <s>nāmābhāsa</s> desires the good,

children.text: nāma bale pāpa buddhi ha-ite palāya // HNC_9.43 //
children.translated_text: let him flee from the sinful mentality on the strength of the Name. // HNC_9.43 //

body.text: kata dina sāvadhāne aparādha parityāga karā cāi ?
body.translated_text: For How Long Must One Carefully Abandon Offenses?

children.text: śuddha-nāmāśrita-jana-saṅga-bala dhari' /
children.translated_text: Holding fast to the company of those sheltered by the pure Name,

children.text: aparādha sa-tarkatā sarvadā ācari' // HNC_9.44 //
children.translated_text: one should always practice vigilance against offenses. // HNC_9.44 //

children.text: śuddha-nāma yāra mukhe tāra dṛḍha mana /
children.translated_text: One whose mouth bears the pure Name has a resolute mind;

children.text: kṛṣṇa haite vicalita nahe eka kṣaṇa // HNC_9.45 //
children.translated_text: not for a single moment is he diverted from <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // HNC_9.45 //

children.text: ataeva nāma bala yata dina naya /
children.translated_text: Therefore, for as long as the Name does not become firm,

children.text: tata dina aparādhe karibeka bhaya // HNC_9.46 //
children.translated_text: for that long one must remain fearful of offenses. // HNC_9.46 //

children.text: viśeṣa yatane pāpa buddhi dūra kari' /
children.translated_text: With special effort, driving the sinful mentality far away,

children.text: aharniśi mukhe balibeka hari hari // HNC_9.47 //
children.translated_text: day and night one should chant '<s>Hari</s>, <s>Hari</s>' with the mouth. // HNC_9.47 //

children.text: śrī-guru-kṛpāya habe susambandha-jñāna /
children.translated_text: By the grace of <s>Śrī Guru</s>, proper knowledge of one's relationship (<s>sambandha-jñāna</s>) will arise;

children.text: kṛṣṇa-bhakti kṛṣṇa-nāma tāhāte vidhāna // HNC_9.48 //
children.translated_text: devotion to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> and the Name of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> — therein lies the ordained path. // HNC_9.48 //

body.translated_text: The Remedy When This Offense Occurs

children.text: yadyapi pramāde nāma-bale pāpa-buddhi /
children.translated_text: Even if inadvertently the sinful mentality arises on the strength of the Name,

children.text: śuddha vaiṣṇavera saṅge kari tāra śuddhi // HNC_9.49 //
children.translated_text: one should purify it in the company of pure <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>. // HNC_9.49 //

children.text: pāpa-spṛhā bāṭapāḍa pathe āsi' dhare /
children.translated_text: The desire for sin, like a highway robber, seizes one on the path;

children.text: viśuddha vaiṣṇava gaṇa patha rakṣā kare // HNC_9.50 //
children.translated_text: the pure <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s> guard the path. // HNC_9.50 //

children.text: uccaiḥ-svare ḍāki rakṣakera nāma dhari' /
children.translated_text: Calling out loudly, invoking the name of the protector,

children.text: palāibe bāṭapāḍa āsibe praharī // HNC_9.51 //
children.translated_text: the robber will flee and the guard will come. // HNC_9.51 //

children.text: ādare balibe bhāi nāhi kara bhaya /
children.translated_text: He will say with affection, 'Brother, do not fear;

children.text: āmi ta rakṣaka tava śuna mahāśaya // HNC_9.52 //
children.translated_text: I am your protector — listen, O noble one.' // HNC_9.52 //

children.text: kevala vaiṣṇava-pada-dāsya-vrata yāra /
children.translated_text: Only one whose vow is servitude to the feet of the devotees —

children.text: harināma-cintāmaṇi pāya sei chāra // HNC_9.53 //
children.translated_text: that lowly one obtains the <s>Harināma-cintāmaṇi</s> (the wish-fulfilling gem of the Holy Name). // HNC_9.53 //

body.text:
iti śrī- hari-nāma-cintāmaṇau nāma-bale pāpa-buddhir
nāma navamaḥ paricchedaḥ /
body.translated_text: Thus ends the ninth chapter of <s>Śrī Hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi</s>, entitled 'The Sinful Mentality on the Strength of the Name.'
(10) Tenth Chapter

body.text:
aśraddadhāne vimukhe 'py aśṛṇvati
yaś copadeśaḥ śiva-nāmāparādhaḥ
body.translated_text: Instructing those who are faithless, averse, or unwilling to hear — this is an offense to the auspicious Name.

children.text: gaura gadādhara jaya jāhnavā-jīvana /
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Gaura</s> and <s>Gadādhara</s>, glory to the life of <s>Jāhnavā</s>,

children.text: jaya jaya sītādvaita jaya bhakta-gaṇa // HNC_10.1 //
children.translated_text: glory, glory to <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Advaita</s>, glory to the devotees! // HNC_10.1 //

children.text: kara yuḍi' haridāsa balena vacana /
children.translated_text: <s>Haridāsa</s> speaks with folded hands:

children.text: āra nāma aparādha karaha śravaṇa // HNC_10.2 //
children.translated_text: 'Hear now of another offense to the Name.' // HNC_10.2 //

body.text: nāme dṛḍha viśvāsake śraddhā bali, tāhā ha-ile-i nāme adhikāra haya
body.translated_text: Firm Faith in the Name Is Called <s>Śraddhā</s>; Only When It Arises Does One Have Eligibility for the Name

children.text: yāhāra hṛdaye śraddhā nā ha-ila udaya /
children.translated_text: One in whose heart <s>śraddhā</s> (faith) has not arisen,

children.text: nāma nāhi śune bahirmukha durāśaya // HNC_10.3 //
children.translated_text: who is outward-turning and of wicked hopes — such a person does not hear the Name. // HNC_10.3 //

children.text: nā janme se janāra nāme adhikāra /
children.translated_text: For such a person, eligibility for the Name is never born;

children.text: śraddhā mātra adhikāra ei tattva-sāra // HNC_10.4 //
children.translated_text: <s>śraddhā</s> alone is the qualification — this is the essence of truth. // HNC_10.4 //

children.text: sajjāti, sat-kula, jñāna, bala, vidyā dhana /
children.translated_text: Good birth, noble family, knowledge, strength, learning, wealth —

children.text: nāme adhikāra dite nā haya kāraṇa // HNC_10.5 //
children.translated_text: none of these is a cause for eligibility for the Name. // HNC_10.5 //

children.text: nāmera māhātmya yei sudṛḍha viśvāsa /
children.translated_text: One who has firm conviction in the greatness of the Name —

children.text: śāstra-mate śraddhā sei sarvatra prakāśa // HNC_10.6 //
children.translated_text: such <s>śraddhā</s>, according to scripture, shines forth everywhere. // HNC_10.6 //

body.text: śraddhā-hīna janake nāma dile nāmāparādhī haya
body.translated_text: Giving the Name to One Without Faith Makes One an Offender to the Name

children.text: śraddhā nāhi janme yāra hari nāma tāre /
children.translated_text: To one in whom <s>śraddhā</s> has not been born, the <s>Hari</s> Name —

children.text: sādhu jana nāhi dena vaiṣṇava ācāre // HNC_10.7 //
children.translated_text: the saintly do not give it, following <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> conduct. // HNC_10.7 //

children.text: śraddhā hīna jana yadi hari nāma pāya /
children.translated_text: If a faithless person obtains the <s>Hari</s> Name,

children.text: avajñā karibe mātra sarva śāstre gāya // HNC_10.8 //
children.translated_text: he will only disrespect it — all scriptures proclaim this. // HNC_10.8 //

children.text: śūkarake dile ratna se cūrṇa karibe /
children.translated_text: If you give a jewel to a pig, it will crush it;

children.text: bānarake dile vastra chiṅḍiyā phelibe // HNC_10.9 //
children.translated_text: if you give cloth to a monkey, it will tear it and throw it away. // HNC_10.9 //

children.text: śraddhā hīna peye nāma aparādha mare /
children.translated_text: A faithless person, receiving the Name, dies by <s>nāmāparādha</s>;

children.text: saṅge saṅge guruke abhakta śīghra kare // HNC_10.10 //
children.translated_text: and along with that, it quickly makes the <s>guru</s> a non-devotee as well. // HNC_10.10 //

body.text: śraddhā hīna vyakti nāma pāite prārthanā karile tāhāra sahita ki rūpe vyavahāra karā ucita
body.translated_text: How Should One Deal with a Faithless Person Who Requests the Name?

children.text: śraddhā virahita jana śaṭhatā kariyā /
children.translated_text: A person devoid of faith, acting deceitfully,

children.text: hari nāma māge vaiṣṇavera kāche giyā // HNC_10.11 //
children.translated_text: goes to a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> and asks for the <s>Hari</s> Name. // HNC_10.11 //

children.text: tāhāra vañcanā vākya bujhi sādhu jana /
children.translated_text: Understanding his deceptive words, the saintly person

children.text: hari nāma nāhi dena tāre kadācana // HNC_10.12 //
children.translated_text: never gives him the <s>Hari</s> Name. // HNC_10.12 //

children.text: sādhu bale ohe bhāi śāṭhya parihara /
children.translated_text: The saint says, 'O brother, abandon your dishonesty;

children.text: pratiṣṭhāśā dūre rākhi nāme śraddhā kara // HNC_10.13 //
children.translated_text: cast aside the desire for prestige and develop faith in the Name.' // HNC_10.13 //

children.text: nāme śraddhā haile nāma anāyāse pābe /
children.translated_text: 'When faith in the Name arises, you will obtain the Name effortlessly;

children.text: nāmera prabhāve e saṃsāre tare yābe // HNC_10.14 //
children.translated_text: by the power of the Name, you will cross over this material world.' // HNC_10.14 //

children.text: yata dina nāhi tava nāme śraddhā bhāi /
children.translated_text: 'As long as you do not have faith in the Name, O brother,

children.text: nāma laite tomāra ta adhikāra nāi // HNC_10.15 //
children.translated_text: you have no eligibility to chant the Name.' // HNC_10.15 //

children.text: śrī nāma māhātmya sādhu śāstra mukhe śuna /
children.translated_text: 'Hear the glories of <s>Śrī Nāma</s> (the Holy Name) from the mouths of saints and scriptures;

children.text: pratiṣṭhāśā chāḍi dainya karaha grahaṇa // HNC_10.16 //
children.translated_text: abandon the desire for prestige and accept humility.' // HNC_10.16 //

children.text: nāme śraddhā hale tabe guru mahājana /
children.translated_text: 'When faith in the Name arises, then the <s>guru</s> and the great souls

children.text: nāma arpibena bhāi nāma mahā dhana // HNC_10.17 //
children.translated_text: will bestow the Name upon you, O brother — the Name is a great treasure.' // HNC_10.17 //

children.text: śraddhā hīna jane artha lobhe nāma diyā /
children.translated_text: One who gives the Name to a faithless person out of greed for money,

children.text: narakete yāya nāmāparādha majiyā // HNC_10.18 //
children.translated_text: goes to hell, drowning in <s>nāmāparādha</s>. // HNC_10.18 //

children.text: ei aparādhera pratikāra
children.translated_text: The Remedy for This Offense

children.text: pramāde yadyapi nāma upadeśa haya /
children.translated_text: If inadvertently the Name has been given as instruction,

children.text: śraddhā hīne tabe guru pāya mahā bhaya // HNC_10.19 //
children.translated_text: then the <s>guru</s> is seized with great fear regarding the faithless one. // HNC_10.19 //

children.text: vaiṣṇava samāje tāhā kari vijñāpana /
children.translated_text: He makes this known in the <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> assembly,

children.text: sei duṣṭa śiṣya tyāga kare mahā jana // HNC_10.20 //
children.translated_text: and the great souls reject that wicked disciple. // HNC_10.20 //

children.text: tāhā nā karile guru aparādha krame /
children.translated_text: If this is not done, the <s>guru</s> gradually becomes an offender,

children.text: bhakti hīna durācāra haya māyā bhrame // HNC_10.21 //
children.translated_text: becomes devoid of devotion, and falls into wicked conduct through the delusion of <s>māyā</s>. // HNC_10.21 //

children.text: ataeva prabhu yāre ādeśa karile /
children.translated_text: Therefore, the Lord, when He gave His command,

children.text: nāma pracārite tāre ei ājñā dile // HNC_10.22 //
children.translated_text: gave this instruction for propagating the Name: // HNC_10.22 //

body.translated_text: The Lord's Instruction on This Matter

children.text: śraddhāvān jane kara nāma upadeśa /
children.translated_text: 'Give instruction of the Name to those who have faith;

children.text: nāma mahimāya pūrṇa kara sarva-deśa // HNC_10.23 //
children.translated_text: fill every land with the glories of the Name.' // HNC_10.23 //

children.text: ucca saṅkīrtane kara śraddhāra pracāra /
children.translated_text: 'Through loud <s>saṅkīrtana</s> (congregational chanting), spread faith;

children.text: śraddhā labhi jīva kare sad guru vicāra // HNC_10.24 //
children.translated_text: having gained faith, the soul (<s>jīva</s>) will seek a true <s>guru</s>.' // HNC_10.24 //

children.text: sad guru nikaṭe kare śrī nāma grahaṇa /
children.translated_text: 'From the true <s>guru</s>, one receives <s>Śrī Nāma</s>,

children.text: anāyāse pāya tabe kṛṣṇa prema dhana // HNC_10.25 //
children.translated_text: and effortlessly obtains the treasure of <s>Kṛṣṇa-prema</s> (love of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>).' // HNC_10.25 //

children.text: cora veśyā śaṭha ādi pāpāsakta jane /
children.translated_text: 'Thieves, harlots, rogues, and others attached to sin —

children.text: chāḍāiyā pāpa mati dibe śraddhā dhane // HNC_10.26 //
children.translated_text: rid them of the sinful mentality and bestow upon them the wealth of faith.' // HNC_10.26 //

children.text: suśraddha haile dibe nāma upadeśa /
children.translated_text: 'When firm faith has arisen, give them instruction of the Name;

children.text: ei rūpe nāma diyā tāra sarva deśa // HNC_10.27 //
children.translated_text: in this way, give the Name and thus deliver every land.' // HNC_10.27 //

body.translated_text: The Consequence of This Kind of Offense

children.text: ihā nā kariyā yini dena nāma dhana /
children.translated_text: One who does not follow this and gives the treasure of the Name,

children.text: sei aparādhe tāṅra narake patana // HNC_10.28 //
children.translated_text: by that offense falls into hell. // HNC_10.28 //

children.text: nāma peye śiṣya kare nāma aparādha /
children.translated_text: Having received the Name, the disciple commits <s>nāmāparādha</s>;

children.text: tāhāte gurura haya bhakti rasa bādha // HNC_10.29 //
children.translated_text: thereby the <s>guru</s>'s realization of the <s>rasa</s> (taste) of devotion is obstructed. // HNC_10.29 //

children.text: ei nāma aparādhe duṅhe śiṣya guru /
children.translated_text: By this offense to the Name, both disciple and <s>guru</s>

children.text: narakete yāya ei aparādha uru // HNC_10.30 //
children.translated_text: go to hell — this is a grave offense. // HNC_10.30 //

body.text: agre śraddhā diyā nāma upadeśa dibe
body.translated_text: One Should First Give Faith, Then Give Instruction of the Name

children.text: jagā mādhā prati tumi mahā kṛpā kari /
children.translated_text: 'You showed great mercy to <s>Jagā</s> and <s>Mādhā</s> (<s>Jagāi</s> and <s>Mādhāi</s>);

children.text: nāme śraddhā diyā nāma dile gaura hari // HNC_10.31 //
children.translated_text: giving them faith in the Name, You gave them the Name, O <s>Gaura Hari</s>!' // HNC_10.31 //

children.text: adbhuta caritra tava sarva jana gaṇa /
children.translated_text: 'Your wonderful deeds — may all people

children.text: śraddhāya karuka anukaraṇa caraṇa // HNC_10.32 //
children.translated_text: follow the footsteps of Your lotus feet with faith.' // HNC_10.32 //

children.text: bhakta pāda bhaktite vinoda yāhāra /
children.translated_text: One whose delight is devotion to the feet of the devotees — that is <s>Vinoda</s> (<s>Bhaktivinoda</s>);

children.text: hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi alaṅkāra tāra // HNC_10.33 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Harināma-cintāmaṇi</s> is his ornament. // HNC_10.33 //

body.text:
(11)
ekādaśa pariccheda
anya śubha-karmera sahita nāmake tulya-jñāna
body.translated_text: (11) Eleventh Chapter: Considering the Name Equal to Other Auspicious Activities
Equating the Name with <s>dharma</s> (religious duty), vows, renunciation, fire sacrifice, and all other auspicious acts is an error.

children.text: jaya jaya gauracandra nāma avatāra /
children.translated_text: Glory, glory to <s>Gauracandra</s> (the moon-like <s>Gaura</s>), the incarnation of the Name!

children.text: jaya jaya harināma sarva-tattva-sāra // HNC_11.1 //
children.translated_text: Glory, glory to <s>Harināma</s> (the Holy Name), the essence of all truths! // HNC_11.1 //

body.translated_text: The Name Is Both the Means (<s>Upāya</s>) and the Goal (<s>Upeya</s>)

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāma haya prabhu pūrṇānanda tattva /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name, O Lord, is the reality of complete bliss (<s>pūrṇānanda</s>);

children.text: upeya vā siddhi bali yāhāra mahattva // HNC_11.26 //
children.translated_text: it is called the goal (<s>upeya</s>) or perfection (<s>siddhi</s>) — such is its greatness. // HNC_11.26 //

children.text: upāya ha-iyā āvirbhūta dharātale /
children.translated_text: Having appeared on the surface of the earth as the means (<s>upāya</s>),

children.text: upeya upāya aikya sarva śāstre bale // HNC_11.27 //
children.translated_text: the unity of the goal and the means — all scriptures declare this. // HNC_11.27 //

children.text: adhikāra-bhede yini upāya svarūpa /
children.translated_text: According to differences in eligibility, He who is the means in nature

children.text: tini-i upeya anye baḍa aparūpa // HNC_11.28 //
children.translated_text: is also the goal — this is most wonderful. // HNC_11.28 //

body.translated_text: Auspicious Deeds Are the Secondary Means; the Name Is the Primary Means

children.text: ataeva upāya dvividha guṇa dhāma /
children.translated_text: Therefore, the means is of two kinds, the abode of all qualities:

children.text: gauṇopāya śubha karma mukhyopāya nāma // HNC_11.29 //
children.translated_text: auspicious deeds are the secondary means (<s>gauṇopāya</s>); the Name is the primary means (<s>mukhyopāya</s>). // HNC_11.29 //

body.translated_text: The Transcendental Nature of the Name

children.text: ataeva śāstre yata anya śubha karma /
children.translated_text: Therefore, all other auspicious deeds described in the scriptures

children.text: nāma saha nahe ei sarva śāstra marma // HNC_11.30 //
children.translated_text: are not equal to the Name — this is the essence of all scriptures. // HNC_11.30 //

children.text: sarala hṛdaye yabe kṛṣṇa-nāma gāya /
children.translated_text: When one sings the Name of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> with a sincere heart,

children.text: atīndriya-sukha āsi cittake nācāya // HNC_11.31 //
children.translated_text: transcendental bliss (<s>atīndriya-sukha</s>) comes and makes the mind dance. // HNC_11.31 //

children.text: sei sukha kṛṣṇa-nāma-svabhāva tatpara /
children.translated_text: That bliss is the inherent nature of the Name of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: ātma-rati ātma-krīḍā nāhi yāra para // HNC_11.32 //
children.translated_text: it is self-delighting and self-sporting — nothing is beyond it. // HNC_11.32 //

body.text: sāyujya kaivalya sukha ānanda sukhera chāyā mātra
body.translated_text: The Bliss of <s>Sāyujya</s> (Merging) and <s>Kaivalya</s> (Liberation) Is Merely a Shadow of True Bliss

children.text: brahma jñāne yoge ye ānanda vaibhava /
children.translated_text: The splendor of bliss found in <s>Brahma-jñāna</s> (knowledge of <s>Brahman</s>) and <s>yoga</s>

children.text: jaḍera viccheda sukha chāyā anubhava // HNC_11.33 //
children.translated_text: is merely the experience of a shadow — the cessation-bliss of the material. // HNC_11.33 //

children.text: abhedya kaivalya sukha svalpa bali' jāni /
children.translated_text: The undifferentiated bliss of <s>kaivalya</s> (liberation) I consider insignificant;

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāmānanda-sukha bhūmā bali' māni // HNC_11.34 //
children.translated_text: the bliss of the Name of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> I regard as <s>bhūmā</s> (the infinite, the supreme). // HNC_11.34 //

body.text: anya śubha karma ha-ite nāmera vailakṣaṇya
body.translated_text: The Distinction of the Name from Other Auspicious Deeds

children.text: sādhana-kālete nāma upāya svarūpa /
children.translated_text: During the stage of practice (<s>sādhana</s>), the Name is the means in nature;

children.text: siddhi-kāle upeya se ei aparūpa // HNC_11.35 //
children.translated_text: at the time of perfection (<s>siddhi</s>), it is the goal — this is most wonderful. // HNC_11.35 //

children.text: upāya svarūpa nāme upeyatva siddha /
children.translated_text: The Name as the means already has the nature of the goal established within it;

children.text: anya śubha karme aiche nahe ta prasiddha // HNC_11.36 //
children.translated_text: such as it is, [this] is not so well-known in other auspicious activities. // HNC 11.36 //

children.text: anya śubha karma yata saba jaḍāśrita /
children.translated_text: All other auspicious activities are dependent on the material body,

children.text: nāma ta cinmaya sadā svataḥ siddhodita // HNC_11.37 //
children.translated_text: but the Name is purely spiritual (<s>cinmaya</s>), eternally self-manifest and perfect. // HNC 11.37 //

children.text: sādhana kāleo nāma śuddha sunirmala /
children.translated_text: Even during the stage of practice (<s>sādhana</s>), the Name is pure and spotless,

children.text: sādhakera anarthete dekhāya sa-mala // HNC_11.38 //
children.translated_text: but due to the practitioner's impediments (<s>anarthas</s>), it appears to be contaminated. // HNC 11.38 //

children.text: sādhu-saṅge nāma laite jaḍa-buddhi yāya /
children.translated_text: When one chants the Name in the association of saints (<s>sādhu-saṅga</s>), the materialistic mentality departs,

children.text: anartha niḥśeṣa haile śuddha nāma bhāya // HNC_11.39 //
children.translated_text: and when the impediments (<s>anarthas</s>) are completely destroyed, the pure Name manifests. // HNC 11.39 //

children.text: anya śubha karmī kare tyajiyā upāya /
children.translated_text: One who performs other auspicious activities abandons the means at the end,

children.text: upeya parama bhāva carame āśraya // HNC_11.40 //
children.translated_text: as the supreme goal of <s>bhāva</s> (divine ecstasy) becomes the final refuge. // HNC 11.40 //

children.text: kintu nāmāśrayī jana nāma nāhi tyaje /
children.translated_text: But one who has taken shelter of the Name never abandons the Name,

children.text: nāmera śuddhatā mātra siddhi-kāle bhaje // HNC_11.41 //
children.translated_text: for the purity of the Name itself is what one worships at the stage of perfection (<s>siddhi</s>). // HNC 11.41 //

children.text: anya śubha karma haite ati vilakṣaṇa /
children.translated_text: Completely distinct from other auspicious activities,

children.text: nāmera svarūpa haya apūrva lakṣaṇa // HNC_11.42 //
children.translated_text: the essential nature (<s>svarūpa</s>) of the Name possesses unprecedented characteristics. // HNC 11.42 //

children.text: sādhana daśāya ei vilakṣaṇa jñāna /
children.translated_text: Knowledge of this distinction during the stage of practice (<s>sādhana</s>)

children.text: guru kṛpā haite haya vedera pramāṇa // HNC_11.43 //
children.translated_text: arises from the grace of the <s>guru</s>, as confirmed by Vedic authority. // HNC 11.43 //

children.text: sādhana daśāya yini ei jñāna hīna /
children.translated_text: One who lacks this knowledge during the stage of practice

children.text: nāma aparādhī tiṃha ati arvācīna // HNC_11.44 //
children.translated_text: remains an offender against the Name, being of immature understanding. // HNC 11.44 //

children.text: nāma sarvopari nāma-tulya kichu naya /
children.translated_text: The Name is supreme above all; nothing is equal to the Name —

children.text: e dṛḍha viśvāsa kari yei nāma laya // HNC_11.45 //
children.translated_text: one who chants the Name with this firm conviction, // HNC 11.45 //

children.text: acire tāṅhāte haya śuddha-nāmodaya /
children.translated_text: in that person the pure Name quickly arises,

children.text: pūrṇānanda nāma-rasa karena āśraya // HNC_11.46 //
children.translated_text: and the complete bliss of the Name's <s>rasa</s> (flavor) takes shelter in them. // HNC 11.46 //

body.translated_text: The remedy for this offense:

children.text: kāhāro yadyapi anya śubha karma sane /
children.translated_text: If someone, due to association with other auspicious activities,

children.text: nāme sama buddhi haya duṣkṛti bandhane // HNC_11.47 //
children.translated_text: considers the Name equal to them — that is bondage born of misdeeds. // HNC 11.47 //

children.text: se duṣkṛti kṣaya lāgi karibe yatana /
children.translated_text: One should make effort to destroy that sinful tendency,

children.text: nāme śuddha buddhi pābe prema dhana // HNC_11.48 //
children.translated_text: and then one will attain pure understanding of the Name and the treasure of <s>prema</s> (divine love). // HNC 11.48 //

children.text: antyaja gṛhastha śuddha nāma parāyaṇa /
children.translated_text: Even an outcast householder who is devoted to the pure Name —

children.text: tāṅra pada dhūli dehe karibe mṛkṣaṇa // HNC_11.49 //
children.translated_text: one should smear the dust of his feet upon one's body. // HNC 11.49 //

children.text: khāibe adharāmṛta pibe pada-jala /
children.translated_text: One should eat the remnants of his food and drink the water that washed his feet,

children.text: tabe śuddha nāme mati ha-ibe nirmala // HNC_11.50 //
children.translated_text: and then one's inclination toward the pure Name will become spotless. // HNC 11.50 //

children.text: kāli dāse ei rūpe duṣkṛti khaṇḍana /
children.translated_text: In this way, O <s>Kāli Dāsa</s>, the sinful tendency is eradicated,

children.text: punaḥ tava kṛpā-prāpti gāya jagaj-jana // HNC_11.51 //
children.translated_text: and the people of the world sing of attaining Your grace once again. // HNC 11.51 //

children.text: āmi jaḍa buddhi nātha eka mātra gāi /
children.translated_text: I am of dull material intelligence, O Lord, I can only sing this much —

children.text: nāma-cintāmaṇi-tattva kabhu nāhi pāi // HNC_11.52 //
children.translated_text: the truth of the <s>Nāma-cintāmaṇi</s> (wish-fulfilling gem of the Name) I can never fully grasp. // HNC 11.52 //

body.translated_text: <s>Haridāsa Ṭhākura</s>'s firm conviction regarding the Name:

children.text: kṛpā kari' nāma-rūpe āmāra jihvāya /
children.translated_text: By Your mercy, O Lord, in the form of the Name, upon my tongue,

children.text: nirantara nāca prabhu dhari tava pāya // HNC_11.53 //
children.translated_text: dance incessantly! I clasp Your feet and pray. // HNC 11.53 //

children.text: rākha iṅhā lao tāṅhā tava icchā mata /
children.translated_text: Keep me here or take me there — as You wish,

children.text: yāṅhā rākha deha more kṛṣṇa-nāmāmṛta // HNC_11.54 //
children.translated_text: wherever You keep me, give me the nectar of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name. // HNC 11.54 //

children.text: jagajjane nāma dite tava avatāra /
children.translated_text: Your descent (<s>avatāra</s>) is to bestow the Name upon the people of the world,

children.text: jagajjana-mājhe more kara aṅgīkāra // HNC_11.55 //
children.translated_text: so please accept me among the people of the world. // HNC 11.55 //

children.text: āmi ta adhama tumi adhama tāraṇa /
children.translated_text: I am the most fallen, and You are the deliverer of the fallen —

children.text: ubhaye sambandha ei patita pāvana // HNC_11.56 //
children.translated_text: this relationship between us is that of the purifier of the fallen (<s>patita-pāvana</s>). // HNC 11.56 //

children.text: acchedya sambandha ei tomāya āmāya /
children.translated_text: This bond between You and me is unbreakable,

children.text: yāra bale nāmāmṛta e adhama cāya // HNC_11.57 //
children.translated_text: and by its strength this fallen soul desires the nectar of the Name. // HNC 11.57 //

body.translated_text: Why the Name became the <s>yuga-dharma</s> (religion of the age) in <s>Kali-yuga</s>:

children.text: kali-yuge suduḥsādhya anya śubha karma /
children.translated_text: In <s>Kali-yuga</s>, other auspicious activities are extremely difficult to perform,

children.text: ataeva nāma āsi' ha-ila yuga dharma // HNC_11.58 //
children.translated_text: therefore the Name has come and become the <s>yuga-dharma</s> (religion of the age). // HNC 11.58 //

children.text: haridāsa-dāsa bhaktivinoda se jana /
children.translated_text: <s>Bhaktivinoda</s>, the servant of <s>Haridāsa</s>,

children.text: hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi gāya akiñcana // HNC_11.59 //
children.translated_text: sings the <s>Hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi</s> as one who possesses nothing (<s>akiñcana</s>). // HNC 11.59 //

body.translated_text: (12) Twelfth Chapter
Offenses to the Name arising from inattention (<s>pramāda</s>)
Inattention (<s>pramāda</s>):

children.text: jaya jaya mahāprabhu jaya bhakta-gaṇa /
children.translated_text: Glory, glory to <s>Mahāprabhu</s>! Glory to the devotees!

children.text: jāṅdera prasāde kari nāma-saṅkīrtana // HNC_12.1 //
children.translated_text: By whose grace I perform <s>nāma-saṅkīrtana</s> (congregational chanting of the Name). // HNC 12.1 //

body.translated_text: The offense called inattention (<s>pramāda</s>):

children.text: haridāsa bale prabhu hethā sanātane /
children.translated_text: <s>Haridāsa</s> says: O Lord, here You instructed <s>Sanātana</s>,

children.text: āra ta gopāla bhaṭṭa dakṣiṇa bhramaṇe // HNC_12.2 //
children.translated_text: and also <s>Gopāla Bhaṭṭa</s> during his travels in the south. // HNC 12.2 //

children.text: śikhāile apramāde śrī-kṛṣṇa-bhajane /
children.translated_text: You taught freedom from inattention in the worship of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: pramādake aparādhe karile gaṇana // HNC_12.3 //
children.translated_text: and counted inattention (<s>pramāda</s>) among the offenses. // HNC 12.3 //

children.text: anya aparādha tjyaji sadā nāma laya /
children.translated_text: Even if one abandons other offenses and always chants the Name,

children.text: tabu nāme prema nāhi haya ta udaya // HNC_12.4 //
children.translated_text: still, <s>prema</s> (divine love) does not arise in the Name. // HNC 12.4 //

children.text: tabe jāni pramāda nāmete aparādha /
children.translated_text: Then one should understand that inattention (<s>pramāda</s>) is an offense to the Name,

children.text: prema bhakti sādhanete kariteche bādha // HNC_12.5 //
children.translated_text: creating an obstacle in the practice of <s>prema-bhakti</s> (devotion born of love). // HNC 12.5 //

body.translated_text: Inattention means lack of careful attention (<s>anavadhāna</s>):

children.text: pramāda anavadhāna ei mūla artha /
children.translated_text: The root meaning of inattention (<s>pramāda</s>) is lack of careful attention (<s>anavadhāna</s>),

children.text: ihā haite ghaṭe prabhu sakala anartha // HNC_12.6 //
children.translated_text: from which, O Lord, all impediments (<s>anarthas</s>) arise. // HNC 12.6 //

body.translated_text: Three types of inattention (<s>anavadhāna</s>):

children.text: audāsīnya jāḍya āra vikṣepa e tina /
children.translated_text: Indifference (<s>audāsīnya</s>), laziness (<s>jāḍya</s>), and distraction (<s>vikṣepa</s>) — these three

children.text: prakāra anavadhāna bujhibe pravīṇa // HNC_12.7 //
children.translated_text: types of inattention the wise should understand. // HNC 12.7 //

body.text: anurāga nā haoā paryanta nāma grahaṇe yatnera āvaśyaka
body.translated_text: The necessity of effort in chanting the Name until attachment (<s>anurāga</s>) develops:

children.text: kona bhāgye kona jīvera śraddhā yadi haya /
children.translated_text: If by some good fortune a soul (<s>jīva</s>) develops faith (<s>śraddhā</s>),

children.text: tabe tiṅha harināma grahaṇa karaya // HNC_12.8 //
children.translated_text: then that person takes up the chanting of <s>Harināma</s>. // HNC 12.8 //

children.text: yatna kari smare nāma saṅkhyāra sahita /
children.translated_text: With effort one remembers the Name along with a fixed count (<s>saṅkhyā</s>),

children.text: tabe nāme anurāga haya ta udita // HNC_12.9 //
children.translated_text: and then attachment (<s>anurāga</s>) to the Name arises. // HNC 12.9 //

children.text: ye paryanta anurāga nā haya udaya /
children.translated_text: As long as attachment (<s>anurāga</s>) has not yet arisen,

children.text: se paryanta yatna kari nāma sadā laya // HNC_12.10 //
children.translated_text: until then one should make effort and always chant the Name. // HNC 12.10 //

body.text: yatnābhāve sādhakera citta sthira haya nā
body.translated_text: Without effort, the practitioner's mind does not become steady:

children.text: nisargataḥ loka saba viṣaye āsakta /
children.translated_text: By nature, all people are attached to sense objects,

children.text: smṛti-kāle viṣaya antare anurakta // HNC_12.11 //
children.translated_text: and at the time of remembrance, the heart remains attracted to worldly things. // HNC 12.11 //

children.text: ruci yāya anya sthāne nāme udāsīna /
children.translated_text: Taste goes elsewhere, and one becomes indifferent to the Name,

children.text: nāme citta magna nahe jape pratidina // HNC_12.12 //
children.translated_text: the mind is not absorbed in the Name though one chants daily. // HNC 12.12 //

children.text: citta eka dike āra anya dike nāma /
children.translated_text: The mind goes in one direction while the Name goes in another —

children.text: tāhāra maṅgala kise haya guṇa dhāma // HNC_12.13 //
children.translated_text: how then can auspiciousness come, how can the abode of divine qualities arise? // HNC 12.13 //

children.text: lakṣa nāma haile pūrṇa saṅkhyā mālā gaṇi /
children.translated_text: Even after completing a hundred thousand Names, counting the full number on the <s>mālā</s> (rosary),

children.text: hṛdaye nahila rasa bindu guṇa maṇi // HNC_12.14 //
children.translated_text: not a drop of <s>rasa</s> (spiritual flavor), not a jewel of divine quality, has appeared in the heart. // HNC 12.14 //

children.text: ei ta anavadhāna doṣera prakāra /
children.translated_text: This is the nature of the fault of inattention (<s>anavadhāna</s>) —

children.text: viṣayī hṛdaye prabhu baḍa durnivāra // HNC_12.15 //
children.translated_text: in the heart of one attached to worldly things, O Lord, it is very difficult to overcome. // HNC 12.15 //

body.translated_text: The method for making effort:

children.text: sādhu saṅge svalpa kāla chāḍiyā viṣaya /
children.translated_text: In the association of saints, for a short time, leaving aside worldly concerns,

children.text: nirjane la-ile nāma ei doṣa kṣaya // HNC_12.16 //
children.translated_text: if one chants the Name in a solitary place, this fault is destroyed. // HNC 12.16 //

children.text: krame krame kṛṣṇa nāme citta haya sthira /
children.translated_text: Gradually the mind becomes steady in <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name,

children.text: nirantara nāma rase haya ta adhīra // HNC_12.17 //
children.translated_text: and one becomes constantly restless for the <s>rasa</s> (flavor) of the Name. // HNC 12.17 //

children.text: tulasīra sannikaṭe kṛṣṇa līlā sthāne /
children.translated_text: Near <s>Tulasī</s>, in places of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s pastimes (<s>līlā</s>),

children.text: sādhu sannidhāne basi' sātvata-vidhāne // HNC_12.18 //
children.translated_text: seated in the presence of saints, following the <s>Sātvata</s> (Vaiṣṇava) method, // HNC 12.18 //

children.text: krame kāla vṛddhi kari sei nāma smare /
children.translated_text: gradually increasing the time, one remembers that Name,

children.text: ati śīghra viṣayera chanda ha-ite tare // HNC_12.19 //
children.translated_text: and very quickly one is delivered from the grip of worldly desires. // HNC 12.19 //

body.text: anya prakriyā | ei rūpa karile audāsīnya rūpa anavadhāna haya nā
body.translated_text: Another method — by following this, inattention in the form of indifference does not arise:

children.text: athavā nirjane basi' smari sādhu-rīti /
children.translated_text: Alternatively, sitting in a solitary place, remembering the ways of the saints,

children.text: indriya pidhāna kari' nāme kare mati // HNC_12.20 //
children.translated_text: restraining the senses, one directs the mind to the Name. // HNC 12.20 //

children.text: satvare nāmete niṣṭhā ruci krame haya /
children.translated_text: Quickly, firm faith and taste in the Name gradually develop,

children.text: audāsīnya doṣe tāra krame haya kṣaya // HNC_12.21 //
children.translated_text: and the fault of indifference (<s>audāsīnya</s>) is gradually destroyed. // HNC 12.21 //

body.translated_text: Characteristics of inattention born of laziness (<s>jāḍya</s>):

children.text: jāḍye ye anavadhānaa alasera mane /
children.translated_text: The inattention caused by laziness — in the mind of the slothful,

children.text: tāhe ruci nāhi haya śrī-nāma-grahaṇe // HNC_12.22 //
children.translated_text: there is no taste for chanting the Holy Name. // HNC 12.22 //

children.text: smṛti-kāle punaḥ śīghra virāme prayāsa /
children.translated_text: When remembrance occurs, one quickly seeks to cease,

children.text: ei doṣe nāma-rasa nā haya prakāśa // HNC_12.23 //
children.translated_text: and due to this fault, the <s>rasa</s> (flavor) of the Name does not manifest. // HNC 12.23 //

children.text: anya kārye vṛthā kāla nā haya yāpana /
children.translated_text: One should not waste time in other activities,

children.text: sādhu gaṇa ihā cinti' smare anukṣaṇa // HNC_12.24 //
children.translated_text: the saintly persons, reflecting on this, remember the Name at every moment. // HNC 12.24 //

children.text: nāma smare rase maje anya nāhi cāya /
children.translated_text: They remember the Name, become immersed in its <s>rasa</s>, and desire nothing else —

children.text: sei rūpa sādhu saṅge ei dosa yāya // HNC_12.25 //
children.translated_text: in the association of such saints, this fault departs. // HNC 12.25 //

children.text: anveṣiyā sei rūpa sādhu-saṅga kare /
children.translated_text: Seeking out such saintly association,

children.text: tad-anukaraṇe citta jāḍya parihare // HNC_12.26 //
children.translated_text: by imitating their conduct, the mind abandons laziness. // HNC 12.26 //

children.text: avyartha kālatva dharma sādhura carita /
children.translated_text: Not wasting a moment — this is the characteristic conduct of saints,

children.text: dekhile tāhāte ruci ha-ibe niścita // HNC_12.27 //
children.translated_text: and by seeing it, taste will certainly develop. // HNC 12.27 //

children.text: mane habe āhā kabe ihāra samāna /
children.translated_text: The thought will arise in the mind: 'Ah, when will I, like them,

children.text: smariba gāiba nāma haye bhāgyavān // HNC_12.28 //
children.translated_text: remember and sing the Name, becoming truly fortunate?' // HNC 12.28 //

children.text: sei ta utsāha āsi alasera mane /
children.translated_text: That enthusiasm, coming into the mind of the lazy,

children.text: jāḍya dūra kare kṛṣṇa-nāmera smaraṇe // HNC_12.29 //
children.translated_text: drives away laziness through remembrance of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name. // HNC 12.29 //

children.text: mane habe āja lakṣa nāma ye kariba /
children.translated_text: The thought will arise: 'Today I shall chant one <s>lakṣa</s> (hundred thousand) Names,

children.text: krame krame tina lakṣa nāma ye smariba // HNC_12.30 //
children.translated_text: and gradually I shall remember three <s>lakṣa</s> Names.' // HNC 12.30 //

children.text: mahāgraha habe citte nāmera saṅkhyāya /
children.translated_text: A great resolve will arise in the heart regarding the count of Names,

children.text: acire yāibe jāḍya sādhura kṛpāya // HNC_12.31 //
children.translated_text: and soon, by the grace of the saints, laziness will depart. // HNC 12.31 //

body.translated_text: Characteristics of inattention born of distraction (<s>vikṣepa</s>):

children.text: vikṣepa ha-ite yei pramāda udaya /
children.translated_text: The inattention that arises from distraction (<s>vikṣepa</s>) —

children.text: bahu yatne sei aparādha haya kṣaya // HNC_12.32 //
children.translated_text: that offense is destroyed only by great effort. // HNC 12.32 //

children.text: kanaka kāminī āra jaya parājaya /
children.translated_text: Wealth (<s>kanaka</s>), women (<s>kāminī</s>), victory and defeat,

children.text: pratiṣṭhāśā śāṭhya-vṛtti tāhāra nilaya // HNC_12.33 //
children.translated_text: ambition, and deceptive conduct — these are its abode. // HNC 12.33 //

children.text: e saba ākṛṣṭi hṛde ha-ile udaya /
children.translated_text: When these attractions arise in the heart,

children.text: nāmete anavadhāna svabhāvataḥ haya // HNC_12.34 //
children.translated_text: inattention to the Name naturally occurs. // HNC 12.34 //

body.translated_text: The means for abandoning distraction (<s>vikṣepa</s>):

children.text: krame krame sei saba cintā parihāre /
children.translated_text: Gradually abandoning all those anxieties,

children.text: yatibe saubhāgyavān vaiṣṇava ācāre // HNC_12.35 //
children.translated_text: the fortunate soul will strive to follow <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> conduct. // HNC 12.35 //

children.text: prathamete hari-dine bhoga-cintā tyaji' /
children.translated_text: First, on <s>Hari</s>'s holy days, abandoning thoughts of enjoyment,

children.text: sādhu saṅge rātra-dina harināma bhaji // HNC_12.36 //
children.translated_text: in the association of saints, day and night, one worships <s>Harināma</s>. // HNC 12.36 //

children.text: hari-kṣetre hari dāsa hari śāstre laye /
children.translated_text: In the holy field of <s>Hari</s>, with <s>Hari</s>'s servants, absorbed in <s>Hari</s>'s scriptures,

children.text: utsave majibe sukhe parama nirbhaye // HNC_12.37 //
children.translated_text: one immerses in festivals with joy and supreme fearlessness. // HNC 12.37 //

children.text: krame bhakti-kāla mana karibe vardhana /
children.translated_text: Gradually one increases the time devoted to <s>bhakti</s> (devotion),

children.text: hari-kathā mahotsave majāiyā mana // HNC_12.38 //
children.translated_text: immersing the mind in the great festivals of <s>Hari-kathā</s> (narrations about the Lord). // HNC 12.38 //

children.text: śreṣṭha rasa krame citte ha-ibe udaya /
children.translated_text: The highest <s>rasa</s> (spiritual flavor) will gradually arise in the heart,

children.text: jaḍera nikṛṣṭa rasa chāḍibe niścaya // HNC_12.39 //
children.translated_text: and the vile <s>rasa</s> of the material world will certainly be abandoned. // HNC 12.39 //

children.text: mahājana mukhe hari-saṅgīta śravaṇe /
children.translated_text: By hearing the sacred songs of <s>Hari</s> from the mouths of the great souls (<s>mahājanas</s>),

children.text: mugdha habe manaḥ karṇa rasa āsvādane // HNC_12.40 //
children.translated_text: the mind and ears will become enchanted by tasting that <s>rasa</s>. // HNC 12.40 //

children.text: nikṛṣṭa viṣaya-spṛhā ha-ibe vigata /
children.translated_text: The vile craving for sense objects will be dispelled,

children.text: nāma gāne citta sthira habe avirata // HNC_12.41 //
children.translated_text: and the mind will become steady and unceasing in singing the Name. // HNC 12.41 //

children.text: ataeva bahu yatne e pramāda tyaje /
children.translated_text: Therefore, with great effort one should abandon this inattention (<s>pramāda</s>),

children.text: sthira citte nāma rase cira dina maje // HNC_12.42 //
children.translated_text: and with a steady mind, immerse forever in the <s>rasa</s> of the Name. // HNC 12.42 //

body.translated_text: Determination (<s>āgraha</s>):

children.text: saṅkalpita nāma saṅkhyā pūrṇa karibāre /
children.translated_text: To complete the resolved count (<s>saṅkhyā</s>) of Names,

children.text: nā haya ayatna nāme dekhi bāre bāre // HNC_12.43 //
children.translated_text: I see again and again that without effort, the Name does not come. // HNC 12.43 //

children.text: satarka ha-iyā kari nāma saṅkīrtana /
children.translated_text: Being vigilant, I perform <s>nāma-saṅkīrtana</s> (congregational chanting),

children.text: pramāda chāḍiyā kari nāmera bhajana // HNC_12.44 //
children.translated_text: abandoning inattention, I worship the Name. // HNC 12.44 //

children.text: saṅkhyādhika spṛhā ekāgra-mānase /
children.translated_text: With a desire to exceed the count, with a one-pointed mind,

children.text: nirantara kari' nāma tava kṛpā-bale // HNC_12.45 //
children.translated_text: I chant the Name incessantly, by the power of Your grace. // HNC 12.45 //

children.text: ei kṛpā kara prabhu nāmete pramāda /
children.translated_text: Grant me this mercy, O Lord, that inattention toward the Name

children.text: nā bādhe āmāra citte nāma rasāsvāda // HNC_12.46 //
children.translated_text: may not obstruct the tasting of the Name's <s>rasa</s> in my heart. // HNC 12.46 //

body.translated_text: The method:

children.text: ekāgra mānase nirjanete svalpa kṣaṇa /
children.translated_text: With a one-pointed mind, in a solitary place, for a short while,

children.text: nāma smṛti abhyāsa karibe bhakta jana // HNC_12.47 //
children.translated_text: the devotee should practice remembrance of the Name. // HNC 12.47 //

children.text: ataeva spaṣṭa nāma bhāva lagna mane /
children.translated_text: Therefore, with a clear utterance of the Name, the mind fixed on <s>bhāva</s> (divine ecstasy),

children.text: sadā haya e prārthanā tomāra caraṇe // HNC_12.48 //
children.translated_text: this prayer is always offered at Your feet. // HNC 12.48 //

children.text: āpana yatnete keha nāhi pāre /
children.translated_text: No one can achieve this by one's own effort alone,

children.text: tomāra prasāda vinā e bhava-saṃsāre // HNC_12.49 //
children.translated_text: without Your grace, in this material world (<s>bhava-saṃsāra</s>). // HNC 12.49 //

body.text:
yatnāgrahera āvaśyakatā /
niṣkapaṭa nāma grahaṇe tāhā avaśya thāke, natuvā aparādha
body.translated_text:
The necessity of determined effort:
In sincere chanting of the Name, that effort must always be present; otherwise it is an offense.

children.text: yatna kari kṛpā māgi vyākula antare /
children.translated_text: Making effort, begging for mercy with an anxious heart,

children.text: tumi kṛpāmaya kṛpā kara ataḥpare // HNC_12.50 //
children.translated_text: You are full of compassion — please bestow Your grace hereafter. // HNC 12.50 //

children.text: tava kṛpā lābhe yadi nā kari yatana /
children.translated_text: If I do not make effort to obtain Your grace,

children.text: tabe āmi bhāgya hīna he śacīnandana // HNC_12.51 //
children.translated_text: then I am indeed unfortunate, O son of <s>Śacī</s> (<s>Śacīnandana</s>)! // HNC 12.51 //

children.text: hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi alaṅkāra yāra /
children.translated_text: The <s>Hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi</s> is the ornament of one

children.text: hari-dāsa-pada-yuga bharasā tāhāra // HNC_12.52 //
children.translated_text: whose trust rests upon the feet of <s>Haridāsa</s>. // HNC 12.52 //

body.translated_text: (13) Thirteenth Chapter

children.text: śrute'pi nāma-māhātmye
children.translated_text: Even after hearing the glories of the Name (<s>nāma-māhātmya</s>),

children.text: yaḥ prīti-rahito naraḥ /
children.translated_text: a person who remains devoid of love,

children.text: ahaṃ-mamādi-paramo
children.translated_text: who is overcome by false ego and possessiveness (<s>ahaṃ-mama</s>),

children.text: nāmni so'py aparādha-kṛt // HNC_13.
children.translated_text: such a person commits offense to the Name. // HNC 13. //

children.text: gadāi gaurāṅga jaya jāhnavā jīvana /
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Gadāi Gaurāṅga</s>! Glory to <s>Jāhnavā</s>, the life of all!

children.text: sītādvaita jaya jaya gaura-bhakta-jana // HNC_13.1 //
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Advaita</s>! Glory, glory to the devotees of <s>Gaura</s>! // HNC 13.1 //

children.text: preme gada gada haridāsa mahāśaya /
children.translated_text: With voice choked with <s>prema</s> (divine love), <s>Haridāsa Mahāśaya</s>

children.text: śeṣa nāma aparādha prabhu pade kaya // HNC_13.2 //
children.translated_text: speaks about the final offense to the Name at the Lord's feet. // HNC 13.2 //

children.text: śuna prabhu ei aparādha sarvādhama /
children.translated_text: Hear, O Lord, this offense is the worst of all,

children.text: ei doṣe nāma prema nā haya udgama // HNC_13.3 //
children.translated_text: due to this fault, <s>prema</s> (divine love) for the Name does not arise. // HNC 13.3 //

body.translated_text: The necessity of surrender (<s>śaraṇāpatti</s>) to the Name:

children.text: anya naya aparādha kariyā varjjana /
children.translated_text: After abandoning all other offenses,

children.text: nāmete śaraṇāpanna ha-ibe sajjana // HNC_13.4 //
children.translated_text: a saintly person should become surrendered (<s>śaraṇāpanna</s>) to the Name. // HNC 13.4 //

children.text: ṣaḍ-vidha śaraṇāgati sarva śāstre kaya /
children.translated_text: All scriptures speak of six-fold surrender (<s>ṣaḍ-vidha śaraṇāgati</s>),

children.text: vistārita balite āmāra sādhya naya // HNC_13.5 //
children.translated_text: but to elaborate fully is beyond my ability. // HNC 13.5 //

body.translated_text: The types of surrender (<s>śaraṇāpatti</s>):

children.text: saṃkṣepe caraṇe tava kari nivedana /
children.translated_text: In brief, I submit at Your feet:

children.text: ānukūlye saṅkalpa prātikūlya visarjana // HNC_13.6 //
children.translated_text: acceptance of what is favorable (<s>ānukūlya-saṅkalpa</s>) and rejection of what is unfavorable (<s>prātikūlya-visarjana</s>), // HNC 13.6 //

children.text: kṛṣṇe rakṣā-kārī buddhi pālaka bhāvana /
children.translated_text: the conviction that <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is the protector (<s>rakṣā-kārī</s>), the mood of seeing Him as the maintainer (<s>pālaka</s>),

children.text: nije dīna buddhi āra ātma-nivedana // HNC_13.7 //
children.translated_text: humility about oneself and complete self-surrender (<s>ātma-nivedana</s>). // HNC 13.7 //

children.text: e jīvana nā rahile nā haya bhajana /
children.translated_text: If this life does not remain, worship cannot be performed,

children.text: jīvana rakṣāya mātra viṣaya grahaṇa // HNC_13.8 //
children.translated_text: accepting sense objects only for the maintenance of life. // HNC 13.8 //

children.text: bhakti anukūla ye viṣaya anukṣaṇa /
children.translated_text: Those sense objects which are favorable to <s>bhakti</s> (devotion) one should accept;

children.text: tāhe rocamāna vṛttye jīvana yāpana // HNC_13.9 //
children.translated_text: with a taste for such things, one should pass one's life. // HNC 13.9 //

children.text: bhakti pratikūla ye viṣaye yabe haya /
children.translated_text: When sense objects are unfavorable to <s>bhakti</s> (devotion),

children.text: tāhāte aruci tāhā varjibe niścaya // HNC_13.10 //
children.translated_text: one should certainly develop distaste for them and reject them. // HNC 13.10 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa vinā rakṣā-kartā nāhi keha āra /
children.translated_text: There is no protector other than <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: kṛṣṇa se pālaka mātra jānibe āmāra // HNC_13.11 //
children.translated_text: one should know that <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> alone is my maintainer. // HNC 13.11 //

children.text: āmi dīna akiñcana sakalera chāra /
children.translated_text: I am lowly, possessing nothing, the most insignificant of all,

children.text: adhama durgata kichu nāhika āmāra // HNC_13.12 //
children.translated_text: fallen and wretched — nothing is mine. // HNC 13.12 //

children.text: kṛṣṇera saṃsāre āmi āchi cira dāsa /
children.translated_text: In the world of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, I am an eternal servant;

children.text: kṛṣṇa icchā mata kriyā āmāra prayāsa // HNC_13.13 //
children.translated_text: my endeavor is to act according to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s desire. // HNC 13.13 //

children.text: āmi kartā āmi dātā āmi pālayitā /
children.translated_text: 'I am the doer, I am the giver, I am the maintainer,

children.text: āmāra e deha geha santāna vanitā // HNC_13.14 //
children.translated_text: this body, home, children, and wife are mine' — // HNC 13.14 //

children.text: āmi vipra āmi śūdra āmi pitā pati /
children.translated_text: 'I am a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, I am a <s>śūdra</s>, I am a father, a husband,

children.text: āmi rājā āmi prajā santānera gati // HNC_13.15 //
children.translated_text: I am a king, I am a subject, the destiny of my children' — // HNC 13.15 //

children.text: ei saba buddhi chāḍi kṛṣṇe kari mati /
children.translated_text: abandoning all such conceptions and fixing the mind on <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: kṛṣṇa kartā kṛṣṇa icchā mātra balavatī // HNC_13.16 //
children.translated_text: one should understand that <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is the doer and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s will alone is powerful. // HNC 13.16 //

children.text: kṛṣṇera ye haya icchā tāhāi kariba /
children.translated_text: Whatever <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> desires, that I shall do;

children.text: nija icchā anusāre kichu nā cintiba // HNC_13.17 //
children.translated_text: I shall not think of anything according to my own desire. // HNC 13.17 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa icchā mate haya āmāra saṃsāra /
children.translated_text: By <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s will my worldly existence proceeds;

children.text: kṛṣṇa icchā mate āmi ha-i bhava-pāra // HNC_13.18 //
children.translated_text: by <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s will I shall cross beyond this material existence. // HNC 13.18 //

children.text: duḥkhe thāki sukhe thāki āmi kṛṣṇa dāsa /
children.translated_text: Whether I remain in suffering or in happiness, I am <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s servant;

children.text: kṛṣṇecchāya sarva jīve dayāra prakāśa // HNC_13.19 //
children.translated_text: by <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s will, compassion is manifest toward all living beings. // HNC 13.19 //

children.text: mama bhoga karma-bhoga kṛṣṇa icchā mata /
children.translated_text: My enjoyment and the fruits of <s>karma</s> (action) are according to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s will;

children.text: āmāra vairāgya kṛṣṇa icchā anugata // HNC_13.20 //
children.translated_text: my renunciation follows <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s desire. // HNC 13.20 //

body.translated_text: When <s>śaraṇāpatti</s> (surrender) takes place, <s>ātma-nivedana</s> (self-offering) arises.

children.text: sarala bhāvete yabe ei bhāva haya /
children.translated_text: When this mood arises with sincere feeling,

children.text: ātma nivedana tāre bali mahāśaya // HNC_13.21 //
children.translated_text: that is called <s>ātma-nivedana</s> (self-offering), O great soul. // HNC 13.21 //

body.translated_text: What occurs in taking shelter of the Name without <s>śaraṇāpatti</s> (surrender):

children.text: ṣaḍ-vidha śaraṇāgati nāhika yāhāra /
children.translated_text: One who does not possess the sixfold <s>śaraṇāgati</s> (surrender),

children.text: se adhama ahaṃ mama buddhi doṣe chāra // HNC_13.22 //
children.translated_text: that fallen person, due to the fault of <s>ahaṃ-mama</s> ('I' and 'mine') mentality, is contemptible. // HNC 13.22 //

children.text: se bale āmi ta kartā saṃsāra āmāra /
children.translated_text: He says, 'I am the doer, this world is mine,

children.text: nija karma phala bhoga sukha duḥkha āra // HNC_13.23 //
children.translated_text: the enjoyment of the fruits of my own <s>karma</s> (actions) — happiness and suffering.' // HNC 13.23 //

children.text: āmāra rakṣaka āmi, āmi ta pālaka /
children.translated_text: 'I am my own protector, I am the maintainer,

children.text: āmāra vanitā bhrātā bālikā bālaka // HNC_13.24 //
children.translated_text: my wife, brother, daughter, and son are mine.' // HNC 13.24 //

children.text: āmi ta arjana kari āmāra ceṣṭāya /
children.translated_text: 'I earn and by my efforts

children.text: sarva kāryya siddha haya sarva śobhā pāya // HNC_13.25 //
children.translated_text: all affairs are accomplished and everything obtains beauty.' // HNC 13.25 //

children.text: ahaṃ mama buddhi krame bahirmukha jana /
children.translated_text: Through the mentality of <s>ahaṃ-mama</s> ('I' and 'mine'), gradually becoming averse to the Lord,

children.text: nija jñāna bale bahu karaye mānana // HNC_13.26 //
children.translated_text: such a person takes great pride by the strength of his own knowledge. // HNC 13.26 //

children.text: sei jñāna bale śilpa vijñāna vistāre /
children.translated_text: By the strength of that knowledge, he expands arts and sciences,

children.text: īśvarera īśitā nā māne duṣṭācāre // HNC_13.27 //
children.translated_text: and in wicked conduct does not accept the sovereignty of the Lord. // HNC 13.27 //

children.text: śrī-nāma-māhātmya śuni viśvāsa nā kare /
children.translated_text: Hearing the glories of <s>Śrī Nāma</s> (the Holy Name), he does not develop faith;

children.text: loka vyavahāre kabhu kṛṣṇa-nāmoccāre // HNC_13.28 //
children.translated_text: in worldly dealings, he sometimes utters <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name. // HNC 13.28 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa nāma kare tabu nāhi pāya prīti /
children.translated_text: He chants <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name, yet does not obtain love;

children.text: dharma dhvajī śaṭha jana jīvane e rīti // HNC_13.29 //
children.translated_text: this is the way of the hypocrite who makes a show of religion, the wicked person. // HNC 13.29 //

children.text: helāya uccāre nāma kichu puṇya haya /
children.translated_text: When one chants the Name with negligence, some <s>puṇya</s> (piety) accrues,

children.text: prīti phala nāhi phale sarva śāstre kaya // HNC_13.30 //
children.translated_text: but the fruit of <s>prīti</s> (divine love) does not manifest — all scriptures declare this. // HNC 13.30 //

body.translated_text: What is the root cause of this?

children.text: māyā baddha haite ei aparādha haya /
children.translated_text: From being bound by <s>Māyā</s> (illusion), this offense arises;

children.text: ihāte niṣkṛti lābha kaṭhina niścaya // HNC_13.31 //
children.translated_text: deliverance from this is certainly very difficult. // HNC 13.31 //

children.text: śuddha bhakti phale yāṅra virakti ha-ila /
children.translated_text: One in whom detachment has arisen as a result of pure <s>bhakti</s> (devotion),

children.text: saṃsāra chāḍiyā sei nāmāśraya nila // HNC_13.32 //
children.translated_text: having abandoned worldly life, takes shelter of the Name. // HNC 13.32 //

body.translated_text: The method for abandoning this fault:

children.text: niṣkiñcana bhāve bhaje śrī kṛṣṇa caraṇa /
children.translated_text: In the spirit of possessing nothing, one worships the feet of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: viṣaya chāḍiyā kare nāma saṅkīrtana // HNC_13.33 //
children.translated_text: and giving up sense objects, performs <s>nāma-saṅkīrtana</s> (congregational chanting of the Holy Name). // HNC 13.33 //

children.text: sei sādhu jane anveṣiyā tāṅra saṅga /
children.translated_text: Seeking out such saintly persons and keeping their association,

children.text: karibe sevibe chāḍi viṣaya taraṅga // HNC_13.34 //
children.translated_text: one should serve them, abandoning the waves of sense enjoyment. // HNC 13.34 //

children.text: krame krame nāme mati ha-ibe sañcāra /
children.translated_text: Gradually, attachment to the Name will be awakened;

children.text: ahaṃtā mamatā yābe māyā habe pāra // HNC_13.35 //
children.translated_text: false ego and possessiveness will depart, and <s>Māyā</s> (illusion) will be overcome. // HNC 13.35 //

children.text: nāmera māhātmya śuni ahaṃ mama bhāva /
children.translated_text: Hearing the glories of the Name, the mentality of 'I' and 'mine',

children.text: chāḍiyā śaraṇātai bhaktera svabhāva // HNC_13.36 //
children.translated_text: abandoning it and surrendering — this is the nature of a devotee. // HNC 13.36 //

children.text: nāmera śaraṇāgata yei mahājana /
children.translated_text: Those great souls who have surrendered to the Name,

children.text: kṛṣṇa nāma kare pāya prema mahā dhana // HNC_13.37 //
children.translated_text: chanting <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s Name, obtain the great treasure of <s>prema</s> (divine love). // HNC 13.37 //

body.translated_text: Characteristics of a person free from the ten offenses:

children.text: ataeva sādhu nindā yatane chāḍiyā /
children.translated_text: Therefore, carefully abandoning criticism of <s>sādhus</s> (saints),

children.text: para tattva viṣṇu śuddha manete jāniyā // HNC_13.38 //
children.translated_text: knowing in a pure mind that <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the Supreme Truth, // HNC 13.38 //

children.text: nāma guru nāma śāstra sarvottama jāni /
children.translated_text: understanding the Name, the <s>guru</s> (spiritual master), and the scriptures of the Name to be supreme,

children.text: viśuddha cinmaya nāma hṛdayete māni // HNC_13.39 //
children.translated_text: accepting in the heart that the Name is purely spiritual, // HNC 13.39 //

children.text: pāpa spṛhā pāpa bīja tyajiyā yatane /
children.translated_text: carefully giving up the tendency to sin and the seed of sin,

children.text: pracāriyā śuddha nāma śraddhānvita jane // HNC_13.40 //
children.translated_text: preaching the pure Name to those endowed with faith, // HNC 13.40 //

children.text: anya śubha karma haite la-iyā virāma /
children.translated_text: ceasing from all other auspicious activities,

children.text: smare ye śaraṇāgata apramāde nāma // HNC_13.41 //
children.translated_text: one who remembers the Name with surrender and without carelessness — // HNC 13.41 //

body.text: niraparādhe nāme la-ile alpa dine bhāvodaya haya
body.translated_text: When the Name is chanted without offense, <s>bhāva</s> (ecstatic emotion) arises in a short time.

children.text: sei dhanya tri-jagate sei bhāgyavān /
children.translated_text: Such a person is blessed in the three worlds, such a person is fortunate,

children.text: kṛṣṇa kṛpā yogya sei guṇera nidāna // HNC_13.42 //
children.translated_text: worthy of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s grace — that is the source of all virtues. // HNC 13.42 //

children.text: ati alpa dine tāṅra śrī-nāma-granaṇe /
children.translated_text: In a very short time, by grasping <s>Śrī Nāma</s> (the Holy Name),

children.text: bhāvodaya haya āra pāya prema dhane // HNC_13.43 //
children.translated_text: <s>bhāva</s> (ecstatic emotion) arises, and one obtains the treasure of <s>prema</s> (divine love). // HNC 13.43 //

body.translated_text: The progression of advancement:

children.text: evambhūta janera sādhana daśā prāya /
children.translated_text: The <s>sādhana</s> (practice) stage of such a person

children.text: ati svalpa dine yāya kṛṣṇera icchāya // HNC_13.44 //
children.translated_text: passes very quickly by <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s will. // HNC 13.44 //

children.text: bhāva daśā haite haite prema daśā haya /
children.translated_text: From the stage of <s>bhāva</s> (ecstatic emotion), the stage of <s>prema</s> (divine love) arises;

children.text: prema daśā sarva siddhi sarva śāstra kaya // HNC_13.45 //
children.translated_text: the stage of <s>prema</s> is the perfection of all — so all scriptures declare. // HNC 13.45 //

children.text: tumi baliyācha nāma yei mahājana /
children.translated_text: You have said that those great souls who chant the Name

children.text: la-ibe niraparādhe pābe prema dhana // HNC_13.46 //
children.translated_text: without offense shall obtain the treasure of <s>prema</s> (divine love). // HNC 13.46 //

body.translated_text: Contemplation of this in the negative aspect:

children.text: aparādha nāhi chāḍi' nāma yadi laya /
children.translated_text: If one chants the Name without giving up offenses,

children.text: sahasra sādhane tāra bhakti nāhi haya // HNC_13.47 //
children.translated_text: even by thousands of practices, <s>bhakti</s> (devotion) will not arise. // HNC 13.47 //

children.text: jñāne mukti karme bhukti jñānī karmī jane /
children.translated_text: Through <s>jñāna</s> (knowledge) one obtains liberation, through <s>karma</s> (action) one obtains enjoyment — for <s>jñānīs</s> (philosophers) and <s>karmīs</s> (fruitive workers),

children.text: sudurlabhā kṛṣṇa bhakti nirmala sādhane // HNC_13.48 //
children.translated_text: pure <s>Kṛṣṇa bhakti</s> (devotion) through untainted practice is extremely rare. // HNC 13.48 //

children.text: bhukti mukti bhakti sama bhakti muktā phala /
children.translated_text: Enjoyment, liberation, and devotion are equal — devotion is the fruit of the liberated;

children.text: jīvera mahimā bhaki prāpti sunirmala // HNC_13.49 //
children.translated_text: the glory of the <s>jīva</s> (soul) is the attainment of pure <s>bhakti</s> (devotion). // HNC 13.49 //

children.text: sādhane naipuṇya yoge atyalpa sādhane /
children.translated_text: By expertise in practice and <s>yoga</s> (discipline), through very little practice,

children.text: bhakti latā prema phala dena bhakta jane // HNC_13.50 //
children.translated_text: the creeper of <s>bhakti</s> (devotion) yields the fruit of <s>prema</s> (divine love) to the devotee. // HNC 13.50 //

body.translated_text: Expertise in worship:

children.text: daśa aparādha chāḍi nāmera grahaṇa /
children.translated_text: Chanting the Name while abandoning the ten offenses —

children.text: ihāi naipuṇya haya sādhana bhajana // HNC_13.51 //
children.translated_text: this is the expertise in the practice of worship. // HNC 13.51 //

body.translated_text: The gravity of offenses to the Name:

children.text: ataeva bhakti lābhe yadi lobha haya /
children.translated_text: Therefore, if one has greed to attain <s>bhakti</s> (devotion),

children.text: daśa aparādha chāḍi kari nāmāśraya // HNC_13.52 //
children.translated_text: one should abandon the ten offenses and take shelter of the Name. // HNC 13.52 //

children.text: eka eka aparādha satarka ha-iyā /
children.translated_text: Being vigilant about each and every offense,

children.text: yatanete chāḍi citte vilāpa kariyā // HNC_13.53 //
children.translated_text: one should carefully abandon them, lamenting within the heart. // HNC 13.53 //

children.text: nāmera caraṇe kari dṛḍha nivedana /
children.translated_text: Making a firm supplication at the feet of the Name,

children.text: nāma kṛpā hale aparādha vidhvaṃsana // HNC_13.54 //
children.translated_text: by the grace of the Name, the offenses are destroyed. // HNC 13.54 //

children.text: anya śubha karme nāma aparādha kṣaya /
children.translated_text: By other auspicious activities, offenses to the Name are not destroyed;

children.text: kona prāyaścitta yogekabhu nāhi haya // HNC_13.55 //
children.translated_text: by no atonement or practice can they ever be removed. // HNC 13.55 //

body.translated_text: The means of abandoning offenses to the Name:

children.text: aviśrānta nāme nāma aparādha yāya /
children.translated_text: By incessant chanting of the Name, offenses to the Name depart;

children.text: tāhe aparādha kabhu sthāna nāhi pāya // HNC_13.56 //
children.translated_text: within such chanting, offense finds no place to remain. // HNC 13.56 //

children.text: divārātra nāma laya anutāpa kare /
children.translated_text: One who chants the Name day and night with remorse,

children.text: tabe aparādha yāya nāma phala dhare // HNC_13.57 //
children.translated_text: then the offenses go away and the Name bears its fruit. // HNC 13.57 //

children.text: aparādha gate śuddha nāmera udaya /
children.translated_text: When offenses have departed, the pure Name (<s>śuddha-nāma</s>) rises;

children.text: śuddha nāma bhāvamaya āra prema maya // HNC_13.58 //
children.translated_text: the pure Name is full of <s>bhāva</s> (ecstatic emotion) and full of <s>prema</s> (divine love). // HNC 13.58 //

children.text: daśa aparādha yena hṛdaye nā paśe /
children.translated_text: May the ten offenses never enter my heart —

children.text: kṛpā kara mahāprabhu maji nāma rase // HNC_13.59 //
children.translated_text: O <s>Mahāprabhu</s>, bestow Your mercy so that I may be immersed in the rasa of the Name. // HNC 13.59 //

children.text: e bhaktivinoda haridāsa kṛpā bale /
children.translated_text: This <s>Bhaktivinoda</s>, by the grace of <s>Haridāsa</s>,

children.text: hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi gāya kutūhale // HNC_13.60 //
children.translated_text: sings the <s>Hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi</s> with great delight. // HNC 13.60 //

body.translated_text:
(14)
Fourteenth Chapter
Offenses in Worship (<s>Sevāparādha</s>)

children.text: jaya gaura-gadādhara jāhnavā jīvana /
children.translated_text: All glories to <s>Gaura-Gadādhara</s>, the life of <s>Jāhnavā</s>!

children.text: jaya sītāpati śrīvāsādi-bhakta-jana // HNC_14.1 //
children.translated_text: All glories to <s>Sītāpati</s> (Lord <s>Nityānanda</s>) and the devotees headed by <s>Śrīvāsa</s>! // HNC 14.1 //

body.text: nāma-tattve śrī-haridāsa ṭhākurake ācārya baliyā ukti kariyāchen
body.translated_text: Addressing <s>Śrī Haridāsa Ṭhākura</s> as the <s>ācārya</s> (teacher) in the principles of the Name, He says:

children.text: mahāprabhu bale śuna bhakta haridāsa /
children.translated_text: <s>Mahāprabhu</s> says, 'Listen, O devotee <s>Haridāsa</s>,

children.text: nāma aparādha tattva karile prakāśa // HNC_14.2 //
children.translated_text: You have illuminated the principles of offenses to the Name. // HNC 14.2 //

children.text: ihāte kalira jīva labhibe maṅgala /
children.translated_text: By this, the souls of <s>Kali</s>-yuga will attain auspiciousness;

children.text: nāma-tattve tumi hao ācārya prabala // HNC_14.3 //
children.translated_text: in the principles of the Name, you are a powerful <s>ācārya</s> (teacher). // HNC 14.3 //

children.text: tava mukhe nāma-tattva karite śravaṇa /
children.translated_text: To hear the principles of the Name from your mouth

children.text: āmāra ullāsa baḍa śuna mahājana // HNC_14.4 //
children.translated_text: is my great delight — listen, O great soul! // HNC 14.4 //

children.text: ācāre ācārya tumi pracāre paṇḍita /
children.translated_text: You are an <s>ācārya</s> (teacher) in practice and learned in preaching;

children.text: tomāra carita nāma-ratne vibhūṣita // HNC_14.5 //
children.translated_text: your character is adorned with the jewel of the Name. // HNC 14.5 //

children.text: rāmānanda śikhāila more rasa-tattva /
children.translated_text: <s>Rāmānanda</s> taught Me the principles of <s>rasa</s> (divine mellow);

children.text: tumi śikhāile more nāmera mahattva // HNC_14.6 //
children.translated_text: you have taught Me the greatness of the Name. // HNC 14.6 //

children.text: ebe bala sevā aparādha ki prakāra /
children.translated_text: Now tell, what are the offenses in worship (<s>sevā-aparādha</s>)?

children.text: śuniyā ghucibe jīvera citta andhakāra // HNC_14.7 //
children.translated_text: By hearing this, the darkness of the souls' hearts will be dispelled.' // HNC 14.7 //

children.text: haridāsa bale se sevaka jana jāne /
children.translated_text: <s>Haridāsa</s> says, 'The servant who worships the deity knows these;

children.text: āmi nāmāśraye thāki jāniba kemane // HNC_14.8 //
children.translated_text: I remain sheltered only in the Name — how would I know? // HNC 14.8 //

children.text: tabu tava ājñā āmi laṅghibāre nāri /
children.translated_text: Yet I cannot transgress Your command;

children.text: yāhā balāibe tāhā baliba vistāri // HNC_14.9 //
children.translated_text: whatever You inspire me to say, that I shall speak in detail.' // HNC 14.9 //

body.translated_text: The enumeration of offenses in worship (<s>sevāparādha</s>):

children.text: sevā aparādha haya ananta prakāra /
children.translated_text: Offenses in worship are of unlimited varieties;

children.text: śrī-mūrti sambandhe saba śāstrera vicāra // HNC_14.10 //
children.translated_text: they all pertain to the sacred <s>mūrti</s> (deity form), as discussed in the scriptures. // HNC 14.10 //

children.text: kona śāstre dvātriṃśat aparādha gaṇi /
children.translated_text: In some scriptures, thirty-two offenses are counted;

children.text: kona śāstre pañcāśat gañe guṇa-maṇi // HNC_14.11 //
children.translated_text: in other scriptures, fifty are enumerated, O jewel among the virtuous. // HNC 14.11 //

body.translated_text: Four categories:

children.text: sei aparādha caturvidhādi prakāre /
children.translated_text: Those offenses are divided into four main categories

children.text: vibhāga karena budha gaṇa śāstre dvāre // HNC_14.12 //
children.translated_text: by the wise through the scriptures. // HNC 14.12 //

children.text: śrī-mūrti-sevaka niṣṭha kataguli tāra /
children.translated_text: Some pertain to the worshiper of <s>Śrī Mūrti</s> (the sacred deity);

children.text: śrī mūrti sthāpaka niṣṭha aparādha āra // HNC_14.13 //
children.translated_text: other offenses pertain to the installer of <s>Śrī Mūrti</s>. // HNC 14.13 //

children.text: śrī-mūrti darśaka niṣṭha āra katipaya /
children.translated_text: Some are committed by the beholder of <s>Śrī Mūrti</s>;

children.text: sarva niṣṭha aparādha katividha haya // HNC_14.14 //
children.translated_text: and there are offenses that apply to all. // HNC 14.14 //

body.translated_text: The thirty-two types of offenses in worship (<s>sevāparādha</s>):

children.text: pādukā sahita yāya īśvara mandire /
children.translated_text: Entering the temple of the Lord wearing shoes,

children.text: yāne caḍi' yāya tathā svacchanda śarīre // HNC_14.15 //
children.translated_text: or riding a conveyance, or walking carelessly — // HNC 14.15 //

children.text: utsave nā seve āra pragati nā kare /
children.translated_text: not serving during festivals, not offering obeisances,

children.text: ucchiṣṭha aśauca dehe vandana ācare // HNC_14.16 //
children.translated_text: offering salutations to the deity with remnants of food on one's body or in an impure state — // HNC 14.16 //

children.text: eka haste praṇāma sammukhe pradakṣiṇa /
children.translated_text: offering obeisances with one hand, circumambulating directly in front,

children.text: devāgre prasāre pada haya vīrāsīna // HNC_14.17 //
children.translated_text: stretching one's legs before the deity, or sitting in <s>vīrāsana</s> (heroic posture) — // HNC 14.17 //

children.text: devāgre śayana āra bhakṣaṇa karaya /
children.translated_text: lying down or eating before the deity,

children.text: mithyā kathā ucca bhāṣā jalpanā nicaya // HNC_14.18 //
children.translated_text: speaking falsehoods, loud speech, or idle chatter — // HNC 14.18 //

children.text: nigrahānugraha yuddha abhakti rodana /
children.translated_text: punishing or favoring others, quarreling, weeping without devotion,

children.text: krūra bhāṣā para nindā kambalāvaraṇa // HNC_14.19 //
children.translated_text: speaking harshly, criticizing others, or covering oneself with a blanket — // HNC 14.19 //

children.text: para stuti, aślīlatā, vāyu-vimokṣaṇa /
children.translated_text: praising others, using obscene language, passing wind,

children.text: śakti sattve gauṇa upacārera yojana // HNC_14.20 //
children.translated_text: employing inferior worship when one has the means for better — // HNC 14.20 //

children.text: devānivedita dravya bhakṣaṇe svīkāra /
children.translated_text: eating items not yet offered to the deity,

children.text: kālodita phalādira anarpaṇa āra // HNC_14.21 //
children.translated_text: and not offering seasonal fruits and other produce — // HNC 14.21 //

children.text: anya bhukta avaśiṣṭa khādya nivedana /
children.translated_text: offering to the deity food already eaten by others or leftover food,

children.text: deva prati pṛṣṭha kari sammukhe āsana // HNC_14.22 //
children.translated_text: sitting with one's back toward the deity — // HNC 14.22 //

children.text: devāgre anyera abhivādana pūjana /
children.translated_text: greeting or worshiping another person before the deity,

children.text: guru prati mauna nija stotra ālocana // HNC_14.23 //
children.translated_text: remaining silent before the <s>guru</s> (spiritual master), or reciting one's own prayers to praise oneself — // HNC 14.23 //

children.text: devatā nindana ei dvātriṃśa prakāra /
children.translated_text: and blaspheming the deity — these are the thirty-two types

children.text: sevā aparādha mahā purāṇe pracāra // HNC_14.24 //
children.translated_text: of offenses in worship, as declared in the great <s>Purāṇas</s>. // HNC 14.24 //

body.translated_text: Description of types according to other scriptures:

children.text: anyatra āchaye aparādha anyatama /
children.translated_text: In other texts, there are additional offenses;

children.text: saṃkṣepe baliba prabhu tava icchā mata // HNC_14.25 //
children.translated_text: I shall briefly state them, O Lord, as You desire. // HNC 14.25 //

children.text: rājānna bhojana āra andhakāra ghare /
children.translated_text: Eating food given by a king, or in a dark room

children.text: praveśiyā deva mūrti saṃsparśana kare // HNC_14.26 //
children.translated_text: entering and touching the deity form — // HNC 14.26 //

children.text: avidhi pūrvaka hari mṛtyu samarpaṇa /
children.translated_text: approaching <s>Hari</s> (the Lord) at the time of death without proper rites,

children.text: vinā vādye mandirera dvāra udghāṭana // HNC_14.27 //
children.translated_text: opening the temple door without musical instruments — // HNC 14.27 //

children.text: sārameya dṛṣṭa khādya deve samarpaṇa /
children.translated_text: offering to the deity food that has been seen by a dog,

children.text: arcana samaye mauna bhaṅga akāraṇe // HNC_14.28 //
children.translated_text: breaking silence without reason during <s>arcana</s> (worship) — // HNC 14.28 //

children.text: bahirdeśe gamanādi pūjāra samaye /
children.translated_text: going outside during the time of worship,

children.text: gandha mālya nāhi diyā dhūpana karaye // HNC_14.29 //
children.translated_text: offering incense without first offering flowers and garlands — // HNC 14.29 //

children.text: anarha-puṣpete kṛṣṇa pūjādi karaṇa /
children.translated_text: worshiping <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> with unworthy flowers,

children.text: adhauta vadane kṛṣṇa pūjā ārambhana // HNC_14.30 //
