children.translated_text: beginning the worship of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> without washing one's face — // HNC 14.30 //

children.text: strī saṅga kariyā kimbā rajaḥsvalā nārī /
children.translated_text: after having intimate relations with a woman, or a woman during her menstrual period,

children.text: dīpa, śaba sparśiyā, ayogya vastra pari' // HNC_14.31 //
children.translated_text: after touching a lamp or a corpse, or wearing improper garments — // HNC 14.31 //

children.text: śaba heri', adhovāyu kariyā mokṣaṇa /
children.translated_text: after seeing a corpse, after passing wind,

children.text: krodha kari' śmaśānete kariyā gamana // HNC_14.32 //
children.translated_text: after becoming angry, or after visiting a cremation ground — // HNC 14.32 //

children.text: ajīrṇa udare āra kusumbha paināka /
children.translated_text: with indigestion in the stomach, or wearing saffron-dyed or silk garments —

children.text: sevana kariyā āra tāmbula guvāka // HNC_14.33 //
children.translated_text: chewing betel leaf and areca nut [before worship]; // HNC 14.33 //

children.text: taila mākhi kari hari-śrī-mūrti-sparśana /
children.translated_text: applying oil and then touching the auspicious form of <s>Hari</s>;

children.text: eraṇḍa-patrastha puṣpe karaya arcana // HNC_14.34 //
children.translated_text: worshiping with flowers placed on castor-oil plant leaves; // HNC 14.34 //

children.text: āsurika kāle pūje pīṭhe bhūme basi /
children.translated_text: worshiping at an inauspicious time, sitting on the altar or on the ground;

children.text: snapana samaye mūrti vāma haste sparśi' // HNC_14.35 //
children.translated_text: touching the deity with the left hand at the time of bathing; // HNC 14.35 //

children.text: vāsi vā yācita phule devatā arcana /
children.translated_text: worshiping the deity with stale or begged flowers;

children.text: pūjā kāle garva ukti ayathā ṣṭhīvana // HNC_14.36 //
children.translated_text: speaking proudly during worship, and spitting inappropriately; // HNC 14.36 //

children.text: tiryak puṇḍra dhare āra adhauta caraṇe /
children.translated_text: wearing the <s>tilaka</s> mark horizontally, and with unwashed feet

children.text: mandire praveśa kare pūjāra kāraṇe // HNC_14.37 //
children.translated_text: entering the temple for the purpose of worship; // HNC 14.37 //

children.text: avaiṣṇava pakva kare deve nivedana /
children.translated_text: offering to the deity food cooked by a non-<s>Vaiṣṇava</s>;

children.text: avaiṣṇave dekhāiyā karaye pūjana // HNC_14.38 //
children.translated_text: performing worship while showing it to non-<s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>; // HNC 14.38 //

children.text: viśvaksene nā pūjiyā kāpāli dekhiyā /
children.translated_text: without first worshiping <s>Viśvaksena</s>, seeing a <s>Kāpālika</s> [skull-bearer];

children.text: hari pūje nakha jale śrī mūrti smariyā // HNC_14.39 //
children.translated_text: worshiping <s>Hari</s> with nail-water while remembering the sacred image; // HNC 14.39 //

children.text: gharmāmbu-saṃspṛṣṭa jale karaye arcana /
children.translated_text: performing worship with water touched by perspiration;

children.text: kṛṣṇera śapatha kare nirmālya laṅghana // HNC_14.40 //
children.translated_text: swearing by <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, and stepping over the remnants of offerings (<s>nirmālya</s>); // HNC 14.40 //

children.text: ei saba kāryye haya sevā aparādha /
children.translated_text: All these acts constitute offenses in service (<s>sevā-aparādha</s>),

children.text: sevākārī janera yāhāte bhakti bādha // HNC_14.41 //
children.translated_text: which obstruct the <s>bhakti</s> of the person engaged in service. // HNC 14.41 //

body.text: sevāparādha yāhāra pakṣe yāhā, tāhā tini varjjana karibena
body.translated_text: Regarding <s>sevāparādha</s> — whichever is applicable to whom, that one should be avoided.

children.text: śrī-mūrti sambandhe yāra bhajana pūjana /
children.translated_text: One whose worship and devotion is connected with the sacred image (<s>śrī-mūrti</s>) —

children.text: sevā aparādha teṅha karun varjjana // HNC_14.42 //
children.translated_text: let such a person carefully avoid the offenses of service (<s>sevā-aparādha</s>). // HNC 14.42 //

children.text: vaiṣṇava sarvadā nāma sevā aparādha /
children.translated_text: A <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> should always avoid offenses to the Name and offenses in service,

children.text: varjiyā śrī-kṛṣṇa-sevā karuna āsvāda // HNC_14.43 //
children.translated_text: and, avoiding them, should relish the service of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>. // HNC 14.43 //

children.text: ei saba aparādha madhye yāṅra yāhā /
children.translated_text: Among all these offenses, whichever is relevant

children.text: sambandhe paḍibe tāṅra varjjanīya tāhā // HNC_14.44 //
children.translated_text: to a particular person — that is what must be avoided by them. // HNC 14.44 //

body.translated_text: <s>Nāmāparādha</s> (offenses to the Name) must be avoided by every <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> without exception.

children.text: kintu nāma aparādha sakala vaiṣṇava /
children.translated_text: Indeed, all <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s> should avoid the offenses to the Name;

children.text: sarva kāla tyaji' labhe bhaktira vaibhava // HNC_14.45 //
children.translated_text: by abandoning them at all times, one attains the splendor of <s>bhakti</s>. // HNC 14.45 //

body.translated_text: In <s>bhāva-sevā</s> (worship in the mood of ecstatic love), consideration of <s>sevāparādha</s> is minimal.

children.text: śrī-mūrti virahe yini nirjjanete basi' /
children.translated_text: One who, in separation from the sacred image (<s>śrī-mūrti</s>), sits in seclusion

children.text: bhajana-kāraṇe bhāva mārge aharniśi // HNC_14.46 //
children.translated_text: and worships day and night on the path of <s>bhāva</s> (ecstatic emotion) — // HNC 14.46 //

children.text: nāma aparādha sadā varjjanīya tāṅra /
children.translated_text: for such a person, <s>nāma-aparādha</s> must always be avoided;

children.text: nāma aparādha daśa sarva kleśādhāra // HNC_14.47 //
children.translated_text: the ten offenses to the Name are the foundation of all afflictions (<s>kleśa</s>). // HNC 14.47 //

children.text: nāma aparādha gate bhāva sevā haya /
children.translated_text: When offenses to the Name are dispelled, <s>bhāva-sevā</s> arises;

children.text: ataeva aparādha tāhe nāhi raya // HNC_14.48 //
children.translated_text: therefore, in that [stage], offenses do not remain. // HNC 14.48 //

body.translated_text: For those who chant and remember the Name, <s>bhāva-sevā</s> alone is the duty.

children.text: śrī nāma smaraṇe bhāva sevāra udaya /
children.translated_text: Through the remembrance of the Holy Name, <s>bhāva-sevā</s> dawns;

children.text: tomāra kṛpāya prabhu jīve bhāgyodaya // HNC_14.49 //
children.translated_text: by Your mercy, O Lord, good fortune arises for the <s>jīva</s> (soul). // HNC 14.49 //

children.text: bhaktira sādhana yata āchaya prakāra /
children.translated_text: Whatever varieties of practices of <s>bhakti</s> exist,

children.text: se saba carame deya nāme prema sāra // HNC_14.50 //
children.translated_text: all of them ultimately bestow the essence of <s>prema</s> (divine love) through the Name. // HNC 14.50 //

children.text: ataeva nāma laya nāma rase maje /
children.translated_text: Therefore one chants the Name and becomes immersed in the rasa of the Name;

children.text: anya ye prakāra saba tāhā nāhi bhaje // HNC_14.51 //
children.translated_text: one does not worship through any other means whatsoever. // HNC 14.51 //

children.text: haridāsa ājñā bale akiñcana jana /
children.translated_text: By the command of <s>Haridāsa</s>, this destitute person

children.text: hari-nāma-cintāmaṇi karilā kīrtana // HNC_14.52 //
children.translated_text: has sung the glories of the <s>Harināma Cintāmaṇi</s> (the wish-fulfilling jewel of the Holy Name). // HNC 14.52 //

body.translated_text:
(15)
Fifteenth Chapter
The Methodology of Worship (<s>Bhajana-praṇālī</s>)

children.text: gadāi gaurāṅga jaya jaya nityānanda /
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Gadāi Gaurāṅga</s>! Glory, glory to <s>Nityānanda</s>!

children.text: jaya sītānātha jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda // HNC_15.1 //
children.translated_text: Glory to <s>Sītānātha</s>! Glory to the host of devotees of <s>Gaura</s>! // HNC 15.1 //

children.text: saba chāḍi hari-nāma je kare bhajana /
children.translated_text: One who, abandoning everything, worships through <s>Hari-nāma</s> (the Name of <s>Hari</s>) —

children.text: jaya jaya bhāgyavān sei mahājana // HNC_15.2 //
children.translated_text: glory, glory to that fortunate great soul (<s>mahājana</s>)! // HNC 15.2 //

children.text: prabhu bale hari-dāsa tumi bhakti-bale /
children.translated_text: The Lord says: '<s>Haridāsa</s>, by the power of your <s>bhakti</s>,

children.text: peyecha sakala jñāna e jagatī-tale // HNC_15.3 //
children.translated_text: you have obtained all knowledge upon this earth. // HNC 15.3 //

children.text: sarva-veda nāce dekhi tomāra jihvāya /
children.translated_text: I see all the <s>Vedas</s> dancing on your tongue;

children.text: sakala siddhānta dekhi tomāra kathāya // HNC_15.4 //
children.translated_text: I see all philosophical conclusions (<s>siddhānta</s>) in your words.' // HNC 15.4 //

body.translated_text: Inquiry into the Rasa of the Name (<s>Nāma-rasa-jijñāsā</s>)

children.text: ebe spaṣṭa bala nāma-rasa ki prakāra /
children.translated_text: 'Now tell clearly — what is the nature of the rasa of the Name?

children.text: ki rūpe labhibe jīva tāhe adhikāra // HNC_15.5 //
children.translated_text: In what manner does the <s>jīva</s> attain qualification for it?' // HNC 15.5 //

children.text: haridāsa mahā-preme kare nivedana /
children.translated_text: <s>Haridāsa</s>, with great <s>prema</s> (love), makes his submission:

children.text: tomāra preraṇā-bale kariba varṇana // HNC_15.6 //
children.translated_text: 'By the force of Your inspiration, I shall describe it.' // HNC 15.6 //

body.translated_text: The Principles of Rasa (<s>Rasa-tattva</s>)

children.text: śuddha-tattva para-tattva yei vastu siddha /
children.translated_text: That entity which is the pure reality, the supreme reality, the perfectly established substance —

children.text: rasa nāme sarva-vede tāhāi prasiddha // HNC_15.7 //
children.translated_text: is well-known in all the <s>Vedas</s> by the name 'rasa.' // HNC 15.7 //

children.text: sei se akhaṇḍa rasa para-brahma tattva /
children.translated_text: That undivided rasa is the reality of <s>Para-Brahman</s> (the Supreme Absolute),

children.text: ananta ānanda-dhāma carama mahattva // HNC_15.8 //
children.translated_text: the abode of infinite bliss, the ultimate greatness. // HNC 15.8 //

children.text: śakti śaktimān rūpe viśeṣa tāhāya /
children.translated_text: In It, there is a distinction in the form of <s>Śakti</s> (energy) and <s>Śaktimān</s> (the possessor of energy);

children.text: bheda nāi bheda sama darśanete bhāya // HNC_15.9 //
children.translated_text: there is no [real] difference — difference and non-difference appear equal in vision. // HNC 15.9 //

children.text: śaktimān sudurlakṣya śakti prakāśinī /
children.translated_text: The <s>Śaktimān</s> is most difficult to perceive; <s>Śakti</s> is the revealer;

children.text: trividha śaktira kriyā viśva-vikāśinī // HNC_15.10 //
children.translated_text: the activity of the threefold <s>Śakti</s> unfolds the universe. // HNC 15.10 //

body.translated_text: Manifestation of the Supreme Entity Through <s>Cit-śakti</s> (Spiritual Energy)

children.text: cic-chakti-svarūpe prakāśaye vastu rūpa /
children.translated_text: Through <s>cit-śakti</s> in its essential form, the Supreme Entity's form is revealed —

children.text: vastu nāma vastu dhāma tat-kriyā svarūpa // HNC_15.11 //
children.translated_text: Its name, Its abode, and Its activities are all the nature of that [energy]. // HNC 15.11 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa se parama vastu śyāma tāra rūpa /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is that Supreme Entity; His form is <s>Śyāma</s> (dark-complexioned);

children.text: kṛṣṇa-dhāma golokādi līlāra svarūpa // HNC_15.12 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s abode — <s>Goloka</s> and the rest — is the essential nature of His <s>līlā</s> (divine pastimes). // HNC 15.12 //

children.text: nāma dhāma rūpa guṇa līlā ādi yata /
children.translated_text: His Name, abode, form, qualities, pastimes, and all the rest —

children.text: sakala-i akhaṇḍādvaya jñāna antargata // HNC_15.13 //
children.translated_text: all are included within the non-dual, undivided knowledge. // HNC 15.13 //

children.text: vicitratā yata saba parā śakti karma /
children.translated_text: All the variety is the work of the <s>parā-śakti</s> (supreme energy);

children.text: kṛṣṇa dharmī parā śakti kṛṣṇa nitya karma // HNC_15.14 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is the possessor of qualities (<s>dharmī</s>); the <s>parā-śakti</s> is <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s eternal activity. // HNC 15.14 //

children.text: dharma-dharmī bheda nāi akhaṇḍa advaye /
children.translated_text: There is no difference between <s>dharma</s> and <s>dharmī</s> in the undivided non-dual [reality];

children.text: vicitra viśeṣa mātra sac-cin-nilaye // HNC_15.15 //
children.translated_text: manifold distinctions are merely [aspects] within the abode of <s>sat</s> (being) and <s>cit</s> (consciousness). // HNC 15.15 //

body.translated_text: The Nature of <s>Māyā-śakti</s> (Illusory Energy)

children.text: sei śakti-chāyā eka māyā saṃjñā pāya /
children.translated_text: A shadow of that <s>Śakti</s> receives the designation <s>Māyā</s>;

children.text: bahiraṅga viśva sṛje kṛṣṇera icchāya // HNC_15.16 //
children.translated_text: it creates the external universe by the will of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // HNC 15.16 //

body.translated_text: <s>Jīva-śakti</s> (the Energy of the Living Entities)

children.text: bhedābheda-mayī jīva-śakti jīva-gaṇe /
children.translated_text: The <s>jīva-śakti</s>, consisting of simultaneous oneness and difference (<s>bhedābheda</s>), [manifests] the living entities;

children.text: tāṭasthye prakāśe kṛṣṇa sevāra kāraṇe // HNC_15.17 //
children.translated_text: at the marginal plane (<s>tāṭasthya</s>), <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> manifests them for the purpose of His service. // HNC 15.17 //

children.text: dui prakāra daśā viśiṣṭa jīva
children.translated_text: Two Conditions Distinguished in the <s>Jīva</s>

children.text: nitya-baddha nitya-mukta jīva dvi-prakāra /
children.translated_text: The <s>jīvas</s> are of two kinds: eternally bound (<s>nitya-baddha</s>) and eternally liberated (<s>nitya-mukta</s>);

children.text: nitya mukte nitya kṛṣṇa sevā adhikāra // HNC_15.18 //
children.translated_text: the eternally liberated have eternal qualification for <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s service. // HNC 15.18 //

children.text: nitya baddha māyā guṇe karaye saṃsāra /
children.translated_text: The eternally bound wander in <s>saṃsāra</s> (material existence) under the modes of <s>Māyā</s>;

children.text: bahirmukha antarmukha bhede dvi-prakāra // HNC_15.19 //
children.translated_text: they are of two kinds: turned outward (<s>bahirmukha</s>) and turned inward (<s>antarmukha</s>). // HNC 15.19 //

children.text: antarmukha sādhu-saṅge kṛṣṇa-nāma pāya /
children.translated_text: The inward-turned soul obtains <s>Kṛṣṇa-nāma</s> (the Name of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>) in the company of saints (<s>sādhu-saṅga</s>);

children.text: kṛṣṇa-nāma-prabhāvete kṛṣṇa-dhāme yāya // HNC_15.20 //
children.translated_text: by the power of <s>Kṛṣṇa-nāma</s>, one goes to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s abode. // HNC 15.20 //

body.translated_text: The Name as the Essential Form of Rasa

children.text: nāma ta akhaṇḍa rasa kalikā tāhāra /
children.translated_text: The Name is the undivided rasa; It is the bud of that [rasa];

children.text: kṛṣṇa ādi saṃjñā-rūpe viśvete pracāra // HNC_15.21 //
children.translated_text: in the form of the designation '<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>' and so on, It is spread throughout the universe. // HNC 15.21 //

children.text: rasa rūpa-svarūpa
children.translated_text: Rasa as the Essential Form of Beauty (<s>Rūpa</s>)

children.text: svalpa sphuṭa kalikā se rūpa manohara /
children.translated_text: That slightly blossomed bud is the enchanting form (<s>rūpa</s>);

children.text: śrī-goloke vṛndāvane śrī-śyāmasundara // HNC_15.22 //
children.translated_text: in <s>Śrī Goloka</s>, in <s>Vṛndāvana</s>, is <s>Śrī Śyāmasundara</s>. // HNC 15.22 //

body.translated_text: Rasa as the Essential Form of Qualities (<s>Guṇa</s>)

children.text: saurabhita kalikā se catuḥ-ṣaṣṭhi-guṇa /
children.translated_text: That fragrant bud consists of sixty-four qualities;

children.text: prakāśe nāmera tattva jānena nipuṇa // HNC_15.23 //
children.translated_text: it reveals the truth of the Name — this the expert knows. // HNC 15.23 //

body.translated_text: Rasa as the Essential Form of Pastimes (<s>Līlā</s>)

children.text: pūrṇa prasphuṭita nāma kusuma sundara /
children.translated_text: The fully bloomed Name is a beautiful flower;

children.text: aṣṭa-kāla nitya-līlā prakṛtira para // HNC_15.24 //
children.translated_text: the eternal pastimes of the eight periods of the day (<s>aṣṭa-kāla</s>) are beyond material nature. // HNC 15.24 //

body.translated_text: The Essential Nature of <s>Bhakti</s>

children.text: jīve nāma kṛpodaye svarūpa hlādinī /
children.translated_text: When the Name bestows its mercy upon the <s>jīva</s>, the <s>hlādinī-śakti</s> (pleasure potency) in its essential form,

children.text: saṃvitera sāra-yutā bhakti-svarūpiṇī // HNC_15.25 //
children.translated_text: combined with the essence of <s>saṃvit</s> (knowledge potency), becomes the embodiment of <s>bhakti</s>. // HNC 15.25 //

body.translated_text: The Activity of <s>Bhakti</s>

children.text: āvirbhūta haye nāme prasphuṭita kari /
children.translated_text: Manifesting and fully blossoming in the Name,

children.text: rasera sāmagrī prakāśaye sarveśvarī // HNC_15.26 //
children.translated_text: [<s>bhakti</s>], the sovereign mistress of all, reveals the accessories of rasa. // HNC 15.26 //

children.text: viśuddha cinmaya jīva labhiyā svarūpa /
children.translated_text: The <s>jīva</s>, becoming a purely spiritual being, attaining its true form (<s>svarūpa</s>),

children.text: sei rase praveśe ei aparūpa // HNC_15.27 //
children.translated_text: enters into that rasa — this is most wondrous! // HNC 15.27 //

body.translated_text: The <s>Vibhāva</s> of Rasa: <s>Ālambana</s> (Foundational Stimulus)

children.text: rasera vibhāva sei tattva ālambana /
children.translated_text: The <s>vibhāva</s> (determinant) of rasa — that reality is the <s>ālambana</s> (foundation);

children.text: tad-āśraya bhakta, tad-viṣaya kṛṣṇa-dhana // HNC_15.28 //
children.translated_text: the devotee is its shelter (<s>āśraya</s>), and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the treasure, is its object (<s>viṣaya</s>). // HNC 15.28 //

children.text: nāma kare avirata bhakta mahāśaya /
children.translated_text: The great-souled devotee chants the Name incessantly;

children.text: kṛpā kari rūpa-guṇa-līlāra udaya // HNC_15.29 //
children.translated_text: by [the Name's] mercy, the form, qualities, and pastimes dawn. // HNC 15.29 //

body.translated_text: The <s>Vibhāva</s> of Rasa: <s>Uddīpana</s> (Exciting Stimulus)

children.text: uddīpana kṛṣṇa-rūpa guṇādika yata /
children.translated_text: The <s>uddīpana</s> (excitant) consists of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s form, qualities, and the rest;

children.text: ālambana uddīpana vibhāve saṃyuta // HNC_15.30 //
children.translated_text: <s>ālambana</s> and <s>uddīpana</s> together make up the <s>vibhāva</s>. // HNC 15.30 //

body.translated_text: From <s>Vibhāva</s> Arises <s>Anubhāva</s>

children.text: vibhāva sampūrṇa haile anubhāva haya /
children.translated_text: When the <s>vibhāva</s> is complete, <s>anubhāva</s> (ensuant ecstatic symptoms) arise;

children.text: premera vikāra saba śuddha prema-maya // HNC_15.31 //
children.translated_text: all the transformations of <s>prema</s> are purely constituted of <s>prema</s>. // HNC 15.31 //

body.text: sañcāri-bhāva o sāttvika-miśre vibhāva kriyā kare, sthāyī-bhāva-i rasa haya
body.translated_text: <s>Sañcāri-bhāva</s> and <s>sāttvika</s> [symptoms], mixed with <s>vibhāva</s>, produce activity; the <s>sthāyī-bhāva</s> (permanent ecstatic mood) itself becomes rasa.

children.text: sañcārī sāttvika krame udita ha-ile /
children.translated_text: When <s>sañcārī</s> (transitory ecstatic emotions) and <s>sāttvika</s> (ecstatic bodily transformations) progressively arise,

children.text: sthāyībhāva rasa haya sarva-śāstra bale // HNC_15.32 //
children.translated_text: the <s>sthāyī-bhāva</s> becomes rasa — so declare all the scriptures. // HNC 15.32 //

body.translated_text: The Sequence for Attaining That [Rasa]

children.text: sei rasa sarva-sāra siddhi-sāra jāni /
children.translated_text: That rasa is the essence of everything, the essence of all perfection — know this;

children.text: parama puruṣa artha sarva-śāstre māni // HNC_15.33 //
children.translated_text: it is acknowledged in all scriptures as the supreme goal of human life. // HNC 15.33 //

children.text: bhakty-unmukha jīva śuddha-gurura kṛpāya /
children.translated_text: The <s>jīva</s> inclined toward <s>bhakti</s>, by the mercy of a pure <s>guru</s>,

children.text: śrī-yugala brahma-nāma saubhāgyete pāya // HNC_15.34 //
children.translated_text: receives the divine Name of the Holy Couple (<s>Śrī Yugala</s>), the <s>Brahma-nāma</s>, by good fortune. // HNC 15.34 //

children.text: tulasī-mālāya nāma saṅkhyā kari smare /
children.translated_text: Counting the Name on a <s>tulasī</s>-bead rosary, one remembers;

children.text: athavā kīrtana kare parama ādare // HNC_15.35 //
children.translated_text: or one performs <s>kīrtana</s> (congregational chanting) with the utmost reverence. // HNC 15.35 //

children.text: eka grantha saṅkhyā kari ārambhibe nāma /
children.translated_text: Counting one round (<s>grantha</s>), one should begin the Name;

children.text: krame tina lakṣa smari pūre manaskāma // HNC_15.36 //
children.translated_text: gradually remembering three <s>lakṣa</s> (300,000 Names), one fulfills one's heart's desire. // HNC 15.36 //

children.text: saṅkhyā madhye kichu nāma karibe kīrtana /
children.translated_text: Within the counted rounds, some Names should be chanted aloud as <s>kīrtana</s>;

children.text: tāte sarvendriya sphūrti ānanda-nartana // HNC_15.37 //
children.translated_text: thereby all the senses become enlivened, and ecstatic dancing ensues. // HNC 15.37 //

children.text: nāma nava-vidha aṅga karaya āśraya /
children.translated_text: The Name takes shelter of the nine limbs of <s>bhakti</s>;

children.text: tathāpi kīrtana smṛti sarva-śreṣṭha haya // HNC_15.38 //
children.translated_text: yet among all, <s>kīrtana</s> and <s>smaraṇa</s> (remembrance) are the most excellent. // HNC 15.38 //

body.translated_text: Difference of Practice According to Qualification: the Path of <s>Arcana</s> (Deity Worship) versus <s>Śravaṇa-kīrtana</s> (Hearing and Chanting)

children.text: arcana-mārgete gāḍhatara ruci yāṅra /
children.translated_text: One who has deeper relish in the path of <s>arcana</s> (deity worship) —

children.text: śravaṇa-kīrtana-siddhi tāhāte tāṅhāra // HNC_15.39 //
children.translated_text: for that person too, perfection comes through hearing and chanting. // HNC 15.39 //

children.text: nāme aikāntikī rati ha-ibe yāṅhāra /
children.translated_text: One who will develop exclusive attachment (<s>aikāntikī rati</s>) to the Name —

children.text: śravaṇa-kīrtana-smṛti kevala tāṅhāra // HNC_15.40 //
children.translated_text: for that person, hearing, chanting, and remembrance alone [are prescribed]. // HNC 15.40 //

body.translated_text: The Sequence of Hearing, Chanting, and Remembering the Name

children.text: sevā nati dāsya sakhya ātma-nivedana /
children.translated_text: Service, obeisance, servitorship (<s>dāsya</s>), friendship (<s>sakhya</s>), and self-surrender (<s>ātma-nivedana</s>) —

children.text: sahaje nāmera saṅge haya pravartana // HNC_15.41 //
children.translated_text: all these naturally come into practice along with the Name. // HNC 15.41 //

children.text: nāma-nāmī eka tattva viśvāsa kariyā /
children.translated_text: Having faith that the Name and the Named are one and the same reality,

children.text: daśa aparādha chāḍi nirjane basiyā // HNC_15.42 //
children.translated_text: abandoning the ten offenses, sitting in seclusion — // HNC 15.42 //

children.text: ati svalpa dine nāma ha-iyā sadaya /
children.translated_text: in a very short time, the Name, becoming merciful,

children.text: śrī-śyāmasundara-rūpe hayena udaya // HNC_15.43 //
children.translated_text: rises in the form of <s>Śrī Śyāmasundara</s>. // HNC 15.43 //

children.text: yabe nāma-rūpe aikya hayata sādhane /
children.translated_text: When, in one's practice (<s>sādhana</s>), the Name and the form become unified,

children.text: nāma laite rūpa āise citte sarva-kṣaṇe // HNC_15.44 //
children.translated_text: upon chanting the Name, the form appears in the mind at every moment. // HNC 15.44 //

children.text: tāra kichu dine rūpe guṇa kari yoga /
children.translated_text: After some time, qualities (<s>guṇa</s>) become conjoined with the form;

children.text: śrī-nāma smaraṇe guṇa karaya sambhoga // HNC_15.45 //
children.translated_text: in the remembrance of the Holy Name, one relishes the qualities. // HNC 15.45 //

body.translated_text: The Unity of Name, Form, and Qualities

children.text: svalpa-dine nāma rūpa guṇa eka haya /
children.translated_text: In a short time, the Name, form, and qualities become one;

children.text: nāma laite sarva-kṣaṇe tinera udaya // HNC_15.46 //
children.translated_text: upon chanting the Name, all three arise at every moment. // HNC 15.46 //

body.translated_text: Worship Consisting of Mantra and Meditation (<s>Mantra-dhyāna-mayī Upāsanā</s>)

children.text: mantra dhyāna mayī ei nāma upāsanā /
children.translated_text: This worship of the Name consists of mantra and meditation;

children.text: prāthamika dhārā jāni kare vibhāvanā // HNC_15.47 //
children.translated_text: understand it as the initial current [of practice], and contemplate accordingly. // HNC 15.47 //

children.text: smṛti kāle yoga pīṭhe kalpa-druma-tale /
children.translated_text: At the time of remembrance, beneath the wish-fulfilling tree on the <s>yoga-pīṭha</s> (seat of divine union),

children.text: gopa-gopī-vṛte kṛṣṇe dekhe kutūhale // HNC_15.48 //
children.translated_text: one beholds <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> surrounded by <s>gopas</s> and <s>gopīs</s>, with wonder. // HNC 15.48 //

children.text: sāttvika-vikāra saba haya prasphuṭita /
children.translated_text: All the <s>sāttvika-vikāras</s> (ecstatic bodily transformations) become fully manifest;

children.text: bhajana ānande bhakta haya pulakita // HNC_15.49 //
children.translated_text: in the bliss of worship, the devotee becomes thrilled with <s>pulaka</s> (horripilation). // HNC 15.49 //

children.text: krame yabe nāma sva-saurabhe praphullita /
children.translated_text: Gradually, when the Name blossoms with its own fragrance,

children.text: aṣṭa-kāla kṛṣṇa-līlā ha-ibe udita // HNC_15.50 //
children.translated_text: the pastimes of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> during the eight periods of the day (<s>aṣṭa-kāla līlā</s>) will dawn. // HNC 15.50 //

body.translated_text: Spontaneous Worship (<s>Svārasikī Upāsanā</s>)

children.text: svārasikī upāsanā ha-ibe udaya /
children.translated_text: Spontaneous worship (<s>svārasikī upāsanā</s>) will arise;

children.text: līlocita pīṭhe kṛṣṇe darśana karaya // HNC_15.51 //
children.translated_text: one beholds <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> on the seat appropriate to each pastime. // HNC 15.51 //

children.text: saṅge saṅge guru-kṛpā siddha-svarūpete /
children.translated_text: Along with this, by the <s>guru</s>'s mercy, in one's perfected spiritual form (<s>siddha-svarūpa</s>),

children.text: līlāya praveśe bhakta sakhīra saṅgete // HNC_15.52 //
children.translated_text: the devotee enters the pastimes in the company of the <s>sakhīs</s> (divine girlfriends). // HNC 15.52 //

children.text: mahābhāva svarūpiṇī vṛṣabhānu-sutā /
children.translated_text: <s>Vṛṣabhānu-sutā</s> (<s>Śrī Rādhā</s>), the embodiment of <s>mahābhāva</s> (the supreme ecstatic love) —

children.text: tāṅra anugata bhakti sadā prema-yutā // HNC_15.53 //
children.translated_text: <s>bhakti</s> following in Her footsteps is always endowed with <s>prema</s>. // HNC 15.53 //

children.text: sakhī ājñā mate kare yugala-sevana /
children.translated_text: By the order of the <s>sakhīs</s>, one renders service to the Divine Couple (<s>Yugala</s>);

children.text: mahā-preme magna haya se rasika jana // HNC_15.54 //
children.translated_text: that connoisseur of rasa (<s>rasika</s>) becomes immersed in great <s>prema</s>. // HNC 15.54 //

body.translated_text: Ontological Realization (<s>Vastu-siddhi</s>) at the Dissolution of the Subtle Body (<s>Liṅga-bhaṅga</s>)

children.text: sādhana-bhajana-siddhi lāgālāgi tāya /
children.translated_text: The perfection of <s>sādhana-bhajana</s> (devotional practice) is closely connected to that [state];

children.text: liṅga-bhaṅge vastu-siddhi tomāra kṛpāya // HNC_15.55 //
children.translated_text: at the dissolution of the subtle body (<s>liṅga-bhaṅga</s>), ontological realization (<s>vastu-siddhi</s>) comes by Your mercy. // HNC 15.55 //

body.text: tad-uttarāvasthā varṇana haya nā, kevala anubhūta haya
body.translated_text: Description of the state beyond that is not possible; it can only be experienced.

children.text: ihāra adhika āra vākya nāhi cale /
children.translated_text: Beyond this, words no longer function;

children.text: tad uttara anubhava labhi kṛpā-bale // HNC_15.56 //
children.translated_text: the experience beyond that is obtained by the power of grace. // HNC 15.56 //

children.text: ei ta ujjvala rasa parama sādhana /
children.translated_text: This is the <s>ujjvala-rasa</s> (brilliant conjugal rasa), the supreme practice;

children.text: ihāte niścaya mile kṛṣṇa prema dhana // HNC_15.57 //
children.translated_text: through firm conviction in it, one obtains the wealth of <s>Kṛṣṇa-prema</s>. // HNC 15.57 //

body.translated_text: The Eleven <s>Bhāvas</s> in <s>Sādhana</s>

children.text: sādhite ujjvala-rasa āche bhāva ekādaśa
children.translated_text: In practicing <s>ujjvala-rasa</s>, there are eleven <s>bhāvas</s> (aspects of identity):

children.text: sambandha vayasa nāma rūpa /
children.translated_text: relationship (<s>sambandha</s>), age (<s>vayasa</s>), name (<s>nāma</s>), form (<s>rūpa</s>),

children.text: yūtha veśa ājñā-vāsa sevā parākāṣṭhāśvāsa
children.translated_text: group (<s>yūtha</s>), dress (<s>veśa</s>), command-residence (<s>ājñā-vāsa</s>), service (<s>sevā</s>), the highest aspiration (<s>parākāṣṭhā</s>), refuge (<s>āśvāsa</s>),

children.text: pālya-dāsī ei aparūpa // HNC_15.58 //
children.translated_text: and being a dependent maidservant (<s>pālya-dāsī</s>) — this is most wondrous! // HNC 15.58 //

body.translated_text: The Five Stages in the Practice of <s>Bhāva</s>

children.text: ei ekādaśa bhāva sampūrṇa sādhane /
children.translated_text: In the complete practice of these eleven <s>bhāvas</s>,

children.text: pañca daśā lakṣya haya sādhaka jīvane // HNC_15.59 //
children.translated_text: five stages are observable in the practitioner's life. // HNC 15.59 //

children.text: śravaṇa varaṇa āra smaraṇa āpana /
children.translated_text: Hearing (<s>śravaṇa</s>), acceptance (<s>varaṇa</s>), remembrance (<s>smaraṇa</s>), and appropriation (<s>āpana</s>) —

children.text: sampatti e pañca-vidha daśāya gaṇana // HNC_15.60 //
children.translated_text: along with realization (<s>sampatti</s>), these five stages are counted as the progressive levels. // HNC 15.60 //

body.translated_text: The First Stage: Hearing (<s>Śravaṇa-daśā</s>)

children.text: nijāpekṣā śreṣṭha śuddha-bhāvuka ye jana /
children.translated_text: A person who is a pure practitioner of <s>bhāva</s>, superior to oneself —

children.text: bhāva-mārge gurudeva sei mahājana // HNC_15.61 //
children.translated_text: on the path of <s>bhāva</s>, that <s>gurudeva</s> is the great soul (<s>mahājana</s>). // HNC 15.61 //

children.text: tāṅhāra śrīmukhe bhāva-tattvera śravaṇa /
children.translated_text: When one hears the principles of <s>bhāva-tattva</s> from his holy lips,

children.text: ha-ile śravaṇa-daśā haya prakaṭana // HNC_15.62 //
children.translated_text: the stage of hearing (<s>śravaṇa-daśā</s>) becomes manifest. // HNC 15.62 //

body.translated_text: The Principles of <s>Bhāva</s> (<s>Bhāva-tattva</s>)

children.text: bhāva-tattva dvi-prakāra karaha vicāra /
children.translated_text: Consider the principles of <s>bhāva</s> as twofold:

children.text: nija ekādaśa bhāva kṛṣṇa-līlā āra // HNC_15.63 //
children.translated_text: one's own eleven <s>bhāvas</s> (spiritual identities), and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s <s>līlā</s>. // HNC 15.63 //

body.translated_text: The Gradual Attainment of the Stage of Acceptance (<s>Varaṇa-daśā</s>)

children.text: rādhā-kṛṣṇa aṣṭa-kāla yei līlā kare /
children.translated_text: The <s>līlā</s> that <s>Rādhā</s> and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> perform during the eight time-periods (<s>aṣṭa-kāla</s>) —

children.text: tāhāra śravaṇe lobha haya ataḥpare // HNC_15.64 //
children.translated_text: upon hearing it, spiritual greed (<s>lobha</s>) arises thereafter. // HNC 15.64 //

children.text: lobha ha-ile guru-pade jijñāsā udaya /
children.translated_text: When greed arises, inquiry at the <s>guru</s>'s feet dawns:

children.text: kemane pāiba līlā kaha mahāśaya // HNC_15.65 //
children.translated_text: 'How shall I attain this <s>līlā</s>? Please tell me, O <s>mahāśaya</s>.' // HNC 15.65 //

children.text: gurudeva kṛpā kari karibe varṇana /
children.translated_text: The <s>gurudeva</s>, mercifully, will describe

children.text: līlā-tattve ekādaśa bhāva-saṅghaṭana // HNC_15.66 //
children.translated_text: the composition of the eleven <s>bhāvas</s> in the reality of <s>līlā</s>. // HNC 15.66 //

children.text: prasanna ha-iyā prabhu karibe ādeśa /
children.translated_text: Being pleased, the master will give the instruction:

children.text: ei bhāve līlā-madhye karaha praveśa // HNC_15.67 //
children.translated_text: 'In this <s>bhāva</s>, enter into the <s>līlā</s>.' // HNC 15.67 //

children.text: śuddha rūpe siddha bhāva kariyā śravaṇa /
children.translated_text: Having heard the perfected <s>bhāva</s> (<s>siddha-bhāva</s>) in its pure form,

children.text: sei bhāva svīya citte karibe varaṇa // HNC_15.68 //
children.translated_text: one should accept that <s>bhāva</s> within one's own heart. // HNC 15.68 //

body.translated_text: One Should Inform the <s>Śrī Gurudeva</s> of One's Own Inclination

children.text: varaṇa kālete nija ruci vicāriyā /
children.translated_text: At the time of acceptance, considering one's own taste (<s>ruci</s>),

children.text: guru-pade jānāibe sarala ha-iyā // HNC_15.69 //
children.translated_text: one should inform the <s>guru</s>'s feet with sincerity. // HNC 15.69 //

children.text: prabhu tumi kṛpā kari yei paricaya /
children.translated_text: 'O master, whatever identity You have mercifully

children.text: dile more tāhe mora pūrṇa prīti haya // HNC_15.70 //
children.translated_text: given me — in that I have complete love. // HNC 15.70 //

children.text: svabhāvataḥ mora ei bhāve āche ruci /
children.translated_text: By nature I have taste in this <s>bhāva</s>;

children.text: ataeva ājñā śire dhari hye śuci // HNC_15.71 //
children.translated_text: therefore I bear Your command upon my head, becoming purified.' // HNC 15.71 //

children.text: anya-ruci ha-ile gurudeva anya-bhāva dibena
children.translated_text: If There Is a Different Taste, the <s>Gurudeva</s> Will Give a Different <s>Bhāva</s>

children.text: ruci yadi nahe tabe akapaṭa mane /
children.translated_text: If there is no taste, then with a guileless heart,

children.text: nivedibe nija-ruci śrī-guru-caraṇe // HNC_15.72 //
children.translated_text: one should submit one's own inclination at the feet of <s>Śrī Guru</s>. // HNC 15.72 //

children.text: vicāriyā gurudeva dibe anya-bhāva /
children.translated_text: Considering, the <s>gurudeva</s> will give a different <s>bhāva</s>;

children.text: tāhe ruci ha-ile prakāśibe nija-bhāva // HNC_15.73 //
children.translated_text: if taste arises in it, one's own <s>bhāva</s> will be revealed. // HNC 15.73 //

body.translated_text: One Should Inform the <s>Gurudeva</s> of One's Own Perfected <s>Bhāva</s> (<s>Siddha-bhāva</s>)

children.text: ei rūpe guru śiṣya saṃvāde ghaṭane /
children.translated_text: In this manner, through dialogue between <s>guru</s> and disciple,

children.text: nija-siddha-bhāva sthira ha-ibe ye kṣaṇe // HNC_15.74 //
children.translated_text: one's own perfected <s>bhāva</s> (<s>nija-siddha-bhāva</s>) will become firmly established at a certain moment. // HNC 15.74 //

children.text: śiṣya guru-pade paḍi karibe minati /
children.translated_text: The disciple, falling at the <s>guru</s>'s feet, will make supplication,

children.text: māgibe bhāvera siddhi kariyā kākuti // HNC_15.75 //
children.translated_text: earnestly requesting the perfection of that <s>bhāva</s>. // HNC 15.75 //

children.text: kṛpā kari gurudeva karibe ādeśa /
children.translated_text: Mercifully, the <s>gurudeva</s> will give the instruction,

children.text: śiṣya sei bhāve tabe karibe praveśa // HNC_15.76 //
children.translated_text: and the disciple will then enter into that <s>bhāva</s>. // HNC 15.76 //

body.translated_text: Firm Acceptance (<s>Dṛḍha Varaṇa</s>)

children.text: śrī-guru-caraṇe paḍi balibe takhana /
children.translated_text: Falling at the feet of <s>Śrī Guru</s>, one will say at that time:

children.text: tavādiṣṭa bhāva āmi karimu varaṇa // HNC_15.77 //
children.translated_text: 'I shall accept the <s>bhāva</s> that You have instructed. // HNC 15.77 //

children.text: e bhāva kakhana āmi nā chāḍiba āra /
children.translated_text: I shall never abandon this <s>bhāva</s>;

children.text: jīvane maraṇe ei saṅgī ye āmāra // HNC_15.78 //
children.translated_text: in life and in death, this alone is my companion.' // HNC 15.78 //

body.translated_text: Consideration of Obstacles to Worship (<s>Bhajana</s>)

children.text: nija siddha ekādaśa bhāve vratī haye /
children.translated_text: Having taken a vow in one's own perfected eleven <s>bhāvas</s>,

children.text: smaribe sudṛḍha-citte nija-bhāva-caye // HNC_15.79 //
children.translated_text: one should remember them with a firmly resolved heart. // HNC 15.79 //

children.text: smaraṇe vicāra eka āche ta sundara /
children.translated_text: Regarding <s>smaraṇa</s> (remembrance), there is one beautiful consideration:

children.text: āpanera yogya-smṛti kara nirantara // HNC_15.80 //
children.translated_text: constantly practice remembrance that is appropriate to yourself. // HNC 15.80 //

children.text: āpanera ayogya smaraṇa yadi haya /
children.translated_text: If the remembrance is not appropriate to oneself,

children.text: bahu yuga sādhile-o siddhi kabhu naya // HNC_15.81 //
children.translated_text: even practicing for many ages, perfection (<s>siddhi</s>) will never come. // HNC 15.81 //

body.translated_text: The Stage of Appropriation (<s>Āpana-daśā</s>)

children.text: āpana-sādhane smṛti yabe haye vratī /
children.translated_text: When one becomes devoted to remembrance in one's own practice,

children.text: acire āpana-daśā haya śuddha ati // HNC_15.82 //
children.translated_text: the stage of appropriation (<s>āpana-daśā</s>) becomes exceedingly pure very soon. // HNC 15.82 //

children.text: nija śuddha-bhāvera ye nirantara smṛti /
children.translated_text: The continuous remembrance of one's own pure <s>bhāva</s> —

children.text: tāhe dūra haya śīghra jaḍa-baddha-mati // HNC_15.83 //
children.translated_text: through it, the materially bound mentality is quickly dispelled. // HNC 15.83 //

body.text: baddha-jīva ye krame bhāva prāpta hana
body.translated_text: The Sequence by Which the Bound <s>Jīva</s> Attains <s>Bhāva</s>

children.text: jaḍa-baddhajīva bhuli nija siddha-sattva /
children.translated_text: The materially bound <s>jīva</s>, forgetting its own perfected nature (<s>siddha-sattva</s>),

children.text: jaḍa abhimāne haya jaḍa-dehe matta // HNC_15.84 //
children.translated_text: through material false ego (<s>jaḍa-abhimāna</s>), becomes intoxicated with the material body. // HNC 15.84 //

children.text: tabe yadi kṛṣṇa-līlā kariyā śravaṇa /
children.translated_text: Then, if by hearing <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s <s>līlā</s>,

children.text: lobha haya pāibāre nija siddha-dhana // HNC_15.85 //
children.translated_text: greed arises to attain one's own perfected treasure — // HNC 15.85 //

children.text: tabe bhāva-tattva-smṛti anukṣaṇa kare /
children.translated_text: then one remembers the principles of <s>bhāva</s> at every moment;

children.text: bhāva yata bāḍe tāra bhrānti tata hare // HNC_15.86 //
children.translated_text: the more <s>bhāva</s> increases, the more one's delusion is removed. // HNC 15.86 //

body.text: smaraṇa daśā | tāhāte vaidha o rāgānugatā bhāvera bheda | śeṣaṭīra-i prayojana
body.translated_text: The Stage of Remembrance (<s>Smaraṇa-daśā</s>) | The Distinction Between Regulated (<s>Vaidhī</s>) and Spontaneous (<s>Rāgānugā</s>) <s>Bhāva</s> | The Latter Alone Is the Goal

children.text: smaraṇa dvividha vaidha rāgānuga āra /
children.translated_text: <s>Smaraṇa</s> (remembrance) is of two kinds: regulated (<s>vaidhī</s>) and spontaneous (<s>rāgānugā</s>);

children.text: rāgānugā smṛti yukti-śāstra haite pāra // HNC_15.87 //
children.translated_text: <s>rāgānugā</s> remembrance is beyond logic and scripture. // HNC 15.87 //

children.text: mādhurya ākṛṣṭa haye karaye smaraṇa /
children.translated_text: Attracted by the sweetness (<s>mādhurya</s>), one practices remembrance;

children.text: acirāte prāpta haya daśā bhāvāpana // HNC_15.88 //
children.translated_text: soon one attains the stage of <s>bhāvāpana</s> (appropriation of <s>bhāva</s>). // HNC 15.88 //

body.translated_text: The Progressive Advancement of the Regulated Devotee (<s>Vaidha-bhakta</s>)

children.text: vaidha-bhakta smṛti-kāle sadā vicāraya /
children.translated_text: The regulated devotee, at the time of remembrance, always deliberates

children.text: anukūla yukti-śāstra yakhana ye haya // HNC_15.89 //
children.translated_text: on whatever logic and scripture are favorable at that time. // HNC 15.89 //

children.text: bhāvāpane haya bhāva āvirbhāva-kāla /
children.translated_text: At the stage of <s>bhāvāpana</s>, <s>bhāva</s> manifests;

children.text: śāstra-yukti chāḍe tabe jāniyā jañjāla // HNC_15.90 //
children.translated_text: then one abandons logic and scripture, knowing them to be encumbrances. // HNC 15.90 //

children.text: śraddhā niṣṭhā rucy-āsakti-krame yei bhāva /
children.translated_text: Through the sequence of faith (<s>śraddhā</s>), steadfastness (<s>niṣṭhā</s>), taste (<s>ruci</s>), and attachment (<s>āsakti</s>), the <s>bhāva</s>

children.text: āpana samaye tāhā haya āvirbhāva // HNC_15.91 //
children.translated_text: manifests at the stage of appropriation (<s>āpana</s>). // HNC 15.91 //

body.text: āpana-daśāya rāgānuga o vaidha-bhaktera bheda nāi
body.translated_text: At the Stage of Appropriation, There Is No Difference Between <s>Rāgānugā</s> and <s>Vaidhī</s> Devotees

children.text: bhāvāpane rāgānugā vaidha-bhakta bheda /
children.translated_text: At the stage of <s>bhāvāpana</s>, the difference between <s>rāgānugā</s> and <s>vaidhī</s> devotees

children.text: nāhi thāke kona mate gāya smṛti veda // HNC_15.92 //
children.translated_text: does not remain in any way — so declare the <s>Smṛtis</s> and Vedas. // HNC 15.92 //

body.translated_text: The Five Types of Remembrance (<s>Pañca-vidhā Smaraṇa</s>)

children.text: smaraṇa dhāraṇā dhyāna anusmṛti āra /
children.translated_text: <s>Smaraṇa</s> (remembering), <s>dhāraṇā</s> (retaining), <s>dhyāna</s> (meditating), <s>anusmṛti</s> (constant recollection), and

children.text: samādhi e pañcavidha smaraṇa prakāra // HNC_15.93 //
children.translated_text: <s>samādhi</s> (absorption) — these are the five types of remembrance. // HNC 15.93 //

body.translated_text: The Time of the Arising of the <s>Bhāvāpana-daśā</s> (Stage of Appropriation)

children.text: samādhi svarūpa smṛti ye samaye haya /
children.translated_text: When <s>samādhi</s> in the form of essential remembrance (<s>svarūpa-smṛti</s>) occurs,

children.text: bhāvāpana daśā āsi ha-ibe udaya // HNC_15.94 //
children.translated_text: the stage of <s>bhāvāpana</s> arises. // HNC 15.94 //

body.translated_text: The Condition That Prevails at That Time

children.text: sei kāle nija siddha-deha abhimāna /
children.translated_text: At that time, the identification with one's own perfected body (<s>siddha-deha</s>)

children.text: parājiyā jaḍa-deha habe adhiṣṭhāna // HNC_15.95 //
children.translated_text: overcomes the material body and becomes the seat of consciousness. // HNC 15.95 //

children.text: takhana svarūpe vraja-vāsa kṣaṇe kṣaṇa /
children.translated_text: Then, in one's true form (<s>svarūpa</s>), one resides in <s>Vraja</s> moment by moment;

children.text: bhāvāpane sva-svarūpe heri vraja-vana // HNC_15.96 //
children.translated_text: at the stage of <s>bhāvāpana</s>, in one's own identity, one beholds the forest of <s>Vraja</s>. // HNC 15.96 //

body.translated_text: Self-realization of One's True Form (<s>Svarūpa-siddhi</s>); Ontological Realization (<s>Vastu-siddhi</s>) at the Dissolution of the Subtle Body (<s>Liṅga-bhaṅga</s>)

children.text: āpane svarūpa-siddhi labhe bhāgyavān /
children.translated_text: The fortunate one attains self-realization of the true form (<s>svarūpa-siddhi</s>);

children.text: liṅga-bhaṅge vastu-siddhi sampatti vidhāna // HNC_15.97 //
children.translated_text: at the dissolution of the subtle body (<s>liṅga-bhaṅga</s>), ontological realization (<s>vastu-siddhi</s>) is granted as the final attainment (<s>sampatti</s>). // HNC 15.97 //

body.translated_text: The Fruit of Perfection Through Practice (<s>Sādhana-siddhi</s>)

children.text: ha-iyā sādhana-siddhā nitya-siddhā saha /
children.translated_text: Becoming perfected through practice (<s>sādhana-siddhā</s>), together with the eternally perfected (<s>nitya-siddhā</s>),

children.text: samatā labhiyā kṛṣṇa-seve aharahaḥ // HNC_15.98 //
children.translated_text: attaining equality, one serves <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> day after day. // HNC 15.98 //

body.translated_text: Attainment of Perfection Through the Name (<s>Nāma-dvārā Siddhi-lābha</s>)

children.text: sevā-bhaṅga āra tāra kabhu nāhi haya /
children.translated_text: There is never again any interruption of service;

children.text: parama ujjvala rase satata mātaya // HNC_15.99 //
children.translated_text: one is perpetually intoxicated in the most brilliant <s>ujjvala-rasa</s> (conjugal rasa). // HNC 15.99 //

children.text: nāma se parama dhana nāmera āśraye /
children.translated_text: The Name is the supreme treasure; by taking shelter of the Name,

children.text: eta siddhi pāya jīva śuddha-sattva haye // HNC_15.100 //
children.translated_text: the <s>jīva</s> attains such perfection, becoming one of pure goodness (<s>śuddha-sattva</s>). // HNC 15.100 //

body.translated_text: A Brief Summary of the Sequence

children.text: ataeva bhakty-unmukha-jana sādhu-saṅge /
children.translated_text: Therefore, a person inclined toward <s>bhakti</s>, in the company of saints (<s>sādhu-saṅga</s>),

children.text: nirjane karibe nāma kramera abhaṅge // HNC_15.101 //
children.translated_text: should chant the Name in seclusion without breaking the sequence. // HNC 15.101 //

children.text: krame krame alpa-kāle sarva-siddhi haya /
children.translated_text: Gradually, in a short time, all perfection is attained;

children.text: kusaṅga varjiyā sādhu-saṅge phalodaya // HNC_15.102 //
children.translated_text: shunning bad association, the fruit arises through <s>sādhu-saṅga</s>. // HNC 15.102 //

body.translated_text: (1) <s>Sādhu-saṅga</s> (saintly association), (2) seclusion (<s>sunirjana</s>), (3) firm <s>bhāva</s> (<s>dṛḍha-bhāva</s>)

children.text: sādhu-saṅga sunirjana nija dṛḍha-bhāva /
children.translated_text: <s>Sādhu-saṅga</s>, seclusion, and firm <s>bhāva</s> —

children.text: ei tina bale labhi mahimā svabhāva // HNC_15.103 //
children.translated_text: by the power of these three, one attains glory and one's true nature. // HNC 15.103 //

children.text: āmi hīna kṣudra-mati viṣaye vibhora /
children.translated_text: I am lowly, of small intelligence, absorbed in sense objects,

children.text: sādhu-saṅga vivarjita sadā ātma-cora // HNC_15.104 //
children.translated_text: bereft of <s>sādhu-saṅga</s>, always a thief of the self. // HNC 15.104 //

children.text: ahaitukī kṛpā kabhu kariyā vistāra /
children.translated_text: Spreading causeless mercy,

children.text: bhakti-rase gati deha prārthanā āmāra // HNC_15.105 //
children.translated_text: give me progress in the rasa of <s>bhakti</s> — this is my prayer. // HNC 15.105 //

children.text: eta bali haridāsa preme acetana /
children.translated_text: Saying this, <s>Haridāsa</s> becomes unconscious in <s>prema</s> (divine love),

children.text: śrī-gaurāṅga pade kare deha samarpaṇa // HNC_15.106 //
children.translated_text: and surrenders his body at the feet of <s>Śrī Gaurāṅga</s>. // HNC 15.106 //

children.text: preme gadgada prabhu tāṅhāre uṭhāya /
children.translated_text: The Lord, His voice choked with <s>prema</s>, lifts him up,

children.text: āliṅgana diyā citta-kathā bale tāya // HNC_15.107 //
children.translated_text: embraces him, and speaks the innermost words. // HNC 15.107 //

body.translated_text: The Lord's Command

children.text: śuna haridāsa ei līlā saṃgopane /
children.translated_text: 'Listen, <s>Haridāsa</s> — this <s>līlā</s> is to be kept hidden;

children.text: viśva andhakāra karibeka duṣṭa jane // HNC_15.108 //
children.translated_text: wicked people will spread darkness over the world. // HNC 15.108 //

children.text: sei kāle tomāra e caramopadeśa /
children.translated_text: At that time, this, your final teaching,

children.text: avaśiṣṭa sādhu-jane bujhibe viśeṣa // HNC_15.109 //
children.translated_text: the remaining saintly persons will understand in its special significance. // HNC 15.109 //

children.text: ei tattva nāmāśraye niṣkiñcana jana /
children.translated_text: This truth — a person who takes shelter of the Name, possessing nothing,

children.text: nirjane basiyā kṛṣṇa karibe bhajana // HNC_15.110 //
children.translated_text: sitting in seclusion, will worship <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // HNC 15.110 //

children.text: nija nija bhāgya-bale jīva pāya bhakti /
children.translated_text: By the power of one's own fortune, the <s>jīva</s> receives <s>bhakti</s>;

children.text: bhakti labhibāre sakalera nāhi śakti // HNC_15.111 //
children.translated_text: not everyone has the capacity to obtain <s>bhakti</s>. // HNC 15.111 //

children.text: sukṛti janera bhakti dṛḍha karibāre /
children.translated_text: To make firm the <s>bhakti</s> of the meritorious,

children.text: āilāma yuga-dharma nāmera pracāre // HNC_15.112 //
children.translated_text: I have come to propagate the <s>yuga-dharma</s> (the religion of the age) — the Name.' // HNC 15.112 //

body.translated_text: <s>Haridāsa Ṭhākura</s> — the Helper in Propagating the Name

children.text: tumi ta sahāya mora e kārya sādhane /
children.translated_text: 'You are My helper in accomplishing this task;

children.text: tava mukhe nāma-tattva śuni e kāraṇe // HNC_15.113 //
children.translated_text: for this reason I hear the principles of the Name from your mouth.' // HNC 15.113 //

children.text: harināma cintāmaṇi akhila amṛta khani
children.translated_text: The <s>Harināma Cintāmaṇi</s> — a mine of complete nectar!

children.text: kṛṣṇa-kṛpā bale ye pāila /
children.translated_text: One who obtained it by the power of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s grace —

children.text: kṛtārtha se mahāśaya sadā pūrṇānanda-maya
children.translated_text: that fulfilled great soul, always full of perfect bliss,

children.text: rāga-bhāve śrī-kṛṣṇa bhajila // HNC_15.114 //
children.translated_text: worshiped <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s> in the mood of spontaneous love (<s>rāga-bhāva</s>). // HNC 15.114 //

children.text: tāṅhāra caraṇa dhari sadā kākuti kari
children.translated_text: Clasping his feet, always supplicating,

children.text: kāṅde ei akiñcana chāra /
children.translated_text: this destitute wretch weeps.

children.text: e amṛta-rasa-leśa piyāiyā avaśeṣa
children.translated_text: 'Making me drink even a drop of this nectarean rasa,

children.text: kara sāra ānanda vistāra // HNC_15.115 //
children.translated_text: spread the essence of bliss far and wide.' // HNC 15.115 //

body.text:
iti śrī-hari-nāma-cintāmaṇau bhajana-praṇālī-pradarśanaṃ nāma
pañcadaśaḥ paricchedaḥ
body.translated_text:
Thus ends the Fifteenth Chapter of <s>Śrī Harināma-cintāmaṇi</s>,
entitled 'Demonstration of the Methodology of Worship (<s>Bhajana-praṇālī</s>).'
